label: Talk to Fred the Farmer (start Sheep Shearer)
detail: Fred's house by the sheep pen north of Lumbridge Castle; he supplies shears if you don't already carry any.

label: Shear 20 sheep in Fred's pen
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own 'fastest route is buying 20 balls of wool' shortcut (flagged GE-violation) -- shear + spin instead.

hints.note: Sheep can slip away mid-shear; keep trying, avoid the horned rams and "The Thing" (unshearable).

label: Spin 20 wool into balls of wool
detail: Spinning wheel in the south bedroom, 1F Lumbridge Castle. Deliveries can be split if inventory space is short.

label: Talk to Fred the Farmer (hand in 20 balls of wool)
detail: Noted balls of wool are rejected -- must be unnoted.

label: Talk to Father Aereck (start The Restless Ghost)
detail: Lumbridge chapel, east of Bob's Brilliant Axes. He points you to Father Urhney as a ghost expert.

label: Go to Father Urhney's house (Lumbridge Swamp)
detail: West through the swamp to a small coastal house.

label: Talk to Father Urhney (get amulet of ghostspeak)
detail: Keep this amulet -- reused across several later quests, per the wiki's own note.

label: Go to the Lumbridge graveyard
detail: Small building in the south-east corner of the graveyard, beside the chapel.

label: Equip amulet of ghostspeak
detail: Required before the coffin will yield the ghost.

label: Search the marble coffin (free the ghost)
detail: Ghost emerges and explains a warlock at the Wizards' Tower stole his skull.

label: Go to the Wizards' Tower
detail: Island south of Draynor Village; climb down the ladder in the room beside the entrance.

label: Search the altar for the ghost's skull
detail: Basement altar, opposite the entrance ladder.

hints.note: A level-13 skeleton spawns and attacks -- fighting it is not required, simply leave the room with the skull.

label: Return to the Lumbridge graveyard
Use the ghost's skull on the coffin
detail: Completes the quest -- ghost's spirit departs into the river.

label: Talk to Veos (start X Marks the Spot)
detail: The Sheared Ram pub, Lumbridge. Requires an owned spade (Eastfloor spade does not work).

label: Dig at the first clue location (Bob's Brilliant Axes)
detail: From Bob's Brilliant Axes: 1 east, 7 north, 5 west, 1 south, then dig; exact tile "??".

label: Dig at the second clue location (behind Lumbridge Castle)
detail: Tile south-west of the large crate by the Cook's kitchen door.

label: Go to Draynor Village area
Feel the orb and dig at the warm spot (east of Draynor)
detail: Four tiles north of the bush near Leela, NW of the jail, south of the wheat field.

hints.note: Chebyshev-distance hot/cold feedback -- walk and re-feel the orb to home in, same mechanic as Hot Cold Treasure Trails.

label: Decode the cipher and dig in the Draynor pig pen
detail: Caesar-shift cipher decodes to 'DRAYNOR PIG PEN'; dig centre of the pen north of the market.

label: Go to Port Sarim docks (Rusty Anchor Inn)
Talk to Veos (hand in the ancient casket)
detail: Northernmost dock outside the Rusty Anchor Inn.

label: Read the notice board (start A Porcine of Interest)
detail: Behind Fortunato's Wine Shop, Draynor Village -- bounty posted by Sarah.

label: Go to the Falador Farm
Talk to Sarah (learn about the cart attack)
Go to the crossroads north of Draynor Village
Investigate the overturned cart and follow the trail
detail: Trail of produce + broken trees leads north-east to a hole by the River Lum.

label: Use rope on the hole and climb down
detail: Cave leads to a skeleton with a note; a Pig Thing then knocks you out -- Spria rescues you.

label: Talk to Spria (get reinforced goggles)
detail: She explains the sourhog's acid attack and gives protective goggles.

label: Return to the Sourhog Cave
Kill the sourhog
detail: Level 37, reinforced goggles required to negate acid attack.

hints.note: Weak to stab/ranged; a bronze scimitar spawns near the entry skeleton if no knife/slash weapon carried. Immune to poison this fight.

label: Cut the sourhog for its foot (bounty proof)
detail: Knife or slashing weapon on the carcass.

label: Return to the Falador Farm
Talk to Sarah (claim the bounty)
Go to Spria's house in Draynor Village
Talk to Spria (finish the quest)
Talk to Launa (start A Soul's Bane)
detail: East of Varrock, south of the Earth Altar. She is searching for her son Tolna and husband.

label: Use rope on the rift and climb down
detail: Triggers a cutscene into the instanced rift -- don't click during cutscenes or they replay.

label: Clear the Rage room

hints.note: Four weapons on a rack each only damage one of four monster types (unicorn/bear/rat/goblin) -- wield the matching weapon per kill, one weapon held at a time.

label: Clear the Fear room (5 fear reapers)

hints.note: Reapers jump from a random dark hole each time; circle the room and search holes until one triggers.

label: Clear the Confusion room (kill the real beast per door)

hints.note: Infobox 'kills' lists 6 confusion beasts as untankable-only, but the walkthrough has you kill the one REAL beast among 5 illusions repeatedly (one door closes per kill) until a single door remains -- exact kill count left "??" pending a reconciled source.

label: Clear the Hopelessness room (5 creatures, 3 phases each)

hints.note: Ranged attacks are much weaker than their melee phase-2/3 -- fight from distance where possible.

label: Defeat Tolna's three heads

hints.note: Multicombat room, all three heads attack at once; northern head melees rapidly up close, ranged/magic recommended.

label: Talk to Tolna (return to the surface, finish quest)
Bank: withdraw Death Plateau loadout
detail: Withdraw: 60+ coins for the dice game (up to 1000 recommended), 10 unnoted bread, 10 unnoted cooked trout, an iron bar, and an Asgarnian ale (or buy one at the Burthorpe pub).

label: Talk to Denulth (start Death Plateau)
detail: Tent south-east of the Warriors' Guild, Burthorpe.

label: Talk to Eohric (learn about Harold)
detail: Top floor of Burthorpe Castle.

label: Talk to Harold at the Toad and Chicken (first attempt)
detail: Upstairs, west side of the pub south-east of the castle. He refuses to discuss the combination.

label: Talk to Eohric again (beer + gambling advice)
Give Harold an Asgarnian ale
detail: Buy or take from the bar downstairs; loosens him up for gambling.

label: Gamble dice with Harold until he offers an IOU
detail: Keep betting until Harold runs out and hands over an IOU.

hints.note: Bets must be 60-1000 coins to trigger the IOU outcome; a Blurberry special/Premade blurb' sp. makes Harold drunk enough to auto-lose every round (optional shortcut, not modeled as required).

label: Read the IOU (reveal the combination)
detail: IOU is replaced in-inventory by the Combination item.

label: Pick up the 5 coloured stones (Burthorpe castle grounds)
detail: Blue, yellow, red, purple, green -- yellow ball sits just south of the green one.

label: Place the stones in the storage-room door (correct order)
detail: Blue bottom-left, yellow bottom-right, red middle-left, purple middle-right, green top-right -- must be done AFTER reading the Combination or the door stays locked.

label: Go to Saba's cave (north-west of Burthorpe)
Talk to Saba (learn of the secret path)
Follow the southern fork to Tenzing's house
detail: Northern fork is the dangerous troll-guarded route -- do not take it.

label: Talk to Tenzing (ask for help)
detail: He wants 10 loaves of bread and 10 cooked trout in exchange, and hands over climbing boots on account.

label: Go to Dunstan (north-east Burthorpe)
detail: Marked by an anvil, north-east of the castle.

label: Talk to Dunstan (learn his condition)
detail: Wants his son inducted into the Imperial Guard, plus an iron bar, before he'll spike the boots.

label: Talk to Denulth (get the induction certificate)
Give Dunstan the iron bar and certificate
Return to Tenzing with the supplies
Give Tenzing the bread, trout and spiked boots

hints.note: Wiki states all 21 items must be handed over in one go -- exact item breakdown beyond the 10+10 food is "??".

label: Walk the secret path east (ignore the troll warning popup)
detail: Exit Tenzing's backyard, over the stile, north then east past the second Mountain Goat; the warning popup is harmless on this path.

label: Talk to Denulth (report the secret path, finish quest)
Talk to Doric (start Doric's Quest)
detail: Small house on the crossroads north of Falador, east of the Taverley gate.

label: Gather 6 clay

hints.note: Clay/copper/iron/tin rocks sit together in the Dwarven Mine south of Doric's house; Rimmington mine (south of Falador) has all three ore types adjacent as an alternate site.

label: Gather 4 copper ore
Gather 2 iron ore

hints.note: Iron ore needs 15 Mining; ironmen below that can pickpocket H.A.M. members (uncommon iron-ore chance) or kill sand/rock crabs (drop both copper and iron) instead.

label: Talk to Doric (hand in the materials)
detail: All materials must be turned in at once (12 inventory slots); unlocks free use of Doric's anvils.

label: Bank: withdraw Dragon Slayer I loadout
detail: Withdraw: unfired bowl, wizard's mind bomb, lobster pot, silk, hammer, 90 steel nails, 3 planks, 2000 coins, 10,000 coins (or air+law runes if Magic 33+), anti-dragon shield once obtained, combat gear + food, antifire potions if members.

label: Talk to the Guildmaster (start Dragon Slayer I)
detail: Champions' Guild, south of Varrock. Requires 32 quest points to enter.

label: Talk to Oziach (get tasked with slaying Elvarg)
detail: North-west Edgeville, near the Wilderness ditch.

label: Talk to the Guildmaster (ask all follow-up questions)

hints.note: Must ask about the map route, each map piece's location, the ship, AND dragonfire protection -- each answer unlocks a stage; skipping one forces a return trip.

label: Get an anti-dragon shield from Duke Horacio

hints.note: 1F Lumbridge Castle; the drop trick can bank extra spares in case of death during the Elvarg fight.

label: Go to Melzar's Maze
Clear Melzar's Maze (5-key gauntlet) for the first map piece

hints.note: Sequential room puzzle: zombie rat (red key) -> ghost weak to air (orange) -> skeleton weak to earth (yellow) -> zombies weak to fire (blue) -> Melzar the Mad (magenta) -> lesser demon weak to water, safespottable in the corridor (green) -> open+search the green-door chest.

label: Go to the Oracle (Ice Mountain)
Talk to the Oracle (ask about the map piece)
detail: Only available to ask if the Guildmaster follow-up about Thalzar's piece was already asked.

label: Go to the magic door room (Dwarven Mine, NE)
Use silk, mind bomb, bowl and pot on the magic door

hints.note: Using the wrong item first does not fail the puzzle -- simply leave and return with the missing item, progress is kept.

label: Go to Port Sarim jail
Pay Wormbrain for the map piece
detail: Third cell from the jail entrance. Requires having asked the Guildmaster about Lozar's piece first.

label: Kill Wormbrain and telegrab the map piece
detail: Alternative to paying 10,000 coins: Ranged/Magic attack (5 HP) then Telekinetic Grab (33+ Magic, law+air runes) the dropped piece.

label: Combine the three map pieces into the Crandor map
Go to Port Sarim docks
Buy the Lady Lumbridge from Klarense
detail: Klarense, second-most-southern dock.

label: Patch the hull (3 clicks)
detail: Board the ship, climb down, click the hole 3 times.

label: Go to Ned's house (Draynor Village)
Talk to Ned (sail to Crandor)
detail: Requires the ship already repaired and the Crandor map handed over; triggers the voyage cutscene with Cabin Boy Jenkins.

label: Kill Elvarg
detail: Avoid aggressive skeletons/moss giants/hobgoblins/lesser demons en route to the volcano hole; opens the Karamja-volcano shortcut back afterward.

hints.note: Level 83; anti-dragon shield + Protect from Magic mandatory, antifire potions members-only bonus. Weak to stab (melee), water spells (magic, 30% bonus) and ranged. SE-corner flinch spot exists for melee (see wiki image).

label: Return to Edgeville (Oziach)
detail: Teleport out, or exit via the Karamja-volcano shortcut past red spiders and climb the rope.

label: Talk to Oziach (report Elvarg slain, finish quest)
detail: Unlocks purchase/wear of rune platebody, green d'hide body, dragon platebody.

label: Talk to Captain Lawgof (start Dwarf Cannon)
detail: South of the Coal Trucks, north-west of the Fishing Guild. Enter the fenced area from the south, or cross the log from the east (20 Agility).

label: Repair all 6 broken railings

hints.note: Inspect (not hammer) each bent railing; failed attempts can cost 1-2 HP or temporarily lower Strength/Crafting.

label: Talk to Captain Lawgof (learn the watchtower is silent)
Go to the watchtower south of the gate
Retrieve Gilob's remains (top floor)
Return the remains to Captain Lawgof
detail: Devastated, he asks you to find Gilob's still-missing son Lollk in the goblin hideout.

label: Go to the Goblin Cave
detail: South-east corner of the Fishing Guild; take the centre passage north-west to the goblin outpost.

label: Search the northernmost crate for Lollk
detail: Room filled with crates past the outpost; Lollk runs back to Captain Lawgof after being found.

label: Talk to Captain Lawgof (accept the cannon-repair task)
Repair the cannon with the toolkit (3-part puzzle)

hints.note: Fixed order: pliers on the safety switch, hooked tool on the spring, toothed tool on the gear at the base of the hammer.

label: Talk to Captain Lawgof (told to ask Nulodion)
Go to Nulodion (dwarf base, south of Ice Mountain)
Talk to Nulodion (get ammo mould and notes)
detail: Western building of the dwarf base.

label: Return to Captain Lawgof
Hand over the ammo mould and notes (finish quest)
Talk to Lady Servil (start Fight Arena)
detail: South-west of the Ardougne Monastery, NE corner of the Tree Gnome Village maze.

label: Search the chest for Khazard armour
detail: Most north-eastern house of the building group south of the Monastery.

label: Equip the Khazard armour
detail: Required to be let into the prison; do not remove it once inside or guards stop talking to you.

label: Go to the Khazard prison
Talk to Sammy Servil (northernmost east-wing cell)
detail: He directs you to the Head Guard for the cell keys.

label: Talk to the Head Guard (south-east staircase)
detail: Mentions a craving for Khali brew.

label: Buy Khali brew from the Khazard barman
detail: Bar west of the jail's western entrance; requires finishing the head-guard dialogue first.

label: Give the Head Guard the brew (get the cell keys)
Use the keys on Sammy's cell door
detail: Triggers the arena cutscene -- Sammy runs to find his father Justin.

label: Kill the Khazard ogre

hints.note: Level 63; safespottable behind a nearby skeleton for Magic/Ranged/halberd.

label: Talk to Hengrad (cellmate, between fights)
Kill the Khazard scorpion
detail: Level 44, non-poisonous, closes distance quickly -- same safespot or Protect from Melee.

label: Kill Bouncer
detail: Level 137 hellhound; counts toward Hellhound Slayer tasks.

label: Kill General Khazard (optional)
detail: Level 142; quest progresses identically if you leave via the door's Quick-escape instead.

label: Return to Lady Servil
Talk to Lady Servil (finish quest)
Talk to Gertrude (start Gertrude's Cat)
detail: Her house west of Varrock, south of the Cooks' Guild. Fluffs is missing; her children saw her last.

label: Buy a raw sardine (Gerrant's Fishy Business)
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own 'seasoned sardine bought from the GE' item note.

label: Gather doogle leaves
detail: South of Gertrude's house.

label: Combine doogle leaves with the raw sardine
Pay Wilough or Shilop for Fluffs' location
detail: Varrock Square -- their secret playground is the Lumber Yard, north-east of Varrock.

label: Go to the Lumber Yard
detail: Climb the broken fence on the south side, then the ladder in the centre.

label: Use bucket of milk on Fluffs
detail: She still hisses -- milk alone is not enough.

label: Use the seasoned sardine on Fluffs
detail: She becomes too afraid to leave -- kittens can be heard mewing nearby.

label: Search the crates for the kitten
detail: Down the ladder; do not drop the kitten or it runs away and must be re-found.

hints.note: The 'Mew!' icon moves between crates but the kitten's actual location is fixed -- keep searching different crates.

label: Use the kitten on Fluffs
detail: Both cat and kitten return home.

label: Return to Gertrude's house
Talk to Gertrude (finish quest)

hints.note: Wearing a ring of charos (a) lets you pick the kitten's colour; ironmen should keep the chocolate cake for A Tail of Two Cats and the stew for The Queen of Thieves.

label: Talk to General Bentnoze or Wartface (start Goblin Diplomacy)
detail: Goblin Village, north of Falador, east of Taverley -- goblins want orange armour instead of their usual colour.

label: Search the 3 village crates for goblin mail
detail: Behind the generals' hut, inside the western hut, and up the ladder near the village gate. Dye only 2 of the 3 (1 orange, 1 blue) -- keep the third plain.

label: Kill goblins until goblin mail drops (alternate source)
detail: Village goblins drop red/green goblin mail (dyeable); a plain brown mail must still come from the ladder crates.

label: Buy woad leaves from Wyson the gardener
detail: Falador Park; offer 'about 20 coins' in dialogue for 2 leaves -- the cheapest blue-dye source.

label: Gather 2 onions
detail: Field north of Rimmington, or Farmer Fred's backyard in Lumbridge (next to the sheep paddock).

label: Buy 3 redberries (Wydin's Food Store)
detail: Port Sarim, Wydin's Food Store.

label: Pick 3 redberries (west of Varrock)
detail: West of Varrock's south-east mine -- free alternative to Wydin's.

label: Go to Aggie's house (Draynor Village)
Have Aggie make yellow, red and blue dye
Combine yellow and red dye into orange dye
detail: Must mix the dyes BEFORE using them on mail -- using yellow dye directly on brown mail makes red mail instead, and vice versa.

label: Dye one goblin mail orange and one blue
detail: Leave the third goblin mail plain/brown -- do not dye all 3.

label: Return to Goblin Village
Give the generals the orange mail (rejected)
detail: Grubfoot models it; the generals dislike it and ask for blue.

label: Give the generals the blue mail (rejected)
detail: Also rejected -- they ask for the original brown.

label: Give the generals the plain brown mail (finish quest)
detail: They decide brown was best all along.

label: Speak to Elena to begin the quest
detail: Talk to Elena in her East Ardougne house, directly west of the shortcut log, to start the quest and agree to retrieve her distillator.

hints.value: 1I'll try to retrieve it for you.

label: Speak to Jerico
detail: Speak to Jerico in the house just south of the northern Ardougne bank (the house with pigeon cages in the backyard).

label: Search Jerico's cupboard for bird feed
detail: Search the cupboard to obtain bird feed; click continue or it won't be added to your inventory.

label: Take a pigeon cage from the backyard
detail: Grab a pigeon cage from Jerico's backyard.

label: Walk to the West Ardougne watchtower
detail: Go south-west of Ardougne Castle to speak with Omart, then north to the small watchtower in front of the West Ardougne gates and stand in the corner where the two spiked fences meet.

label: Distract the watchtower guard with bird feed
detail: Use bird feed on the watchtower fence to lure the guard's attention.

label: Open the pigeon cage
detail: Click open on the pigeon cage in your inventory while the guard is distracted.

label: Equip the gas mask
detail: Equip your gas mask before crossing into West Ardougne.

label: Cross into West Ardougne with Omart
detail: Run south from the watchtower and speak to Omart; after a short delay you arrive in West Ardougne.

label: Squeeze into the Mourner HQ backyard
detail: Head around the Mourner Headquarters to the north-eastern area with the vat and mangle, then squeeze through the fence into the backyard.

label: Pick up the rotten apple
detail: Pick up the rotten apple in the backyard.

label: Use the rotten apple on the cauldron
detail: Use the rotten apple on the cauldron, then squeeze back through the fence.

label: Walk to Nurse Sarah's house
detail: Go to Nurse Sarah's house, south-west of the West Ardougne church.

label: Search the cupboard for a medical gown
detail: Search the cupboard in the northern part of the house for a medical gown.

label: Equip the medical gown
detail: Equip the medical gown, go back to the Mourner Headquarters and open the door.

label: Kill a mourner upstairs
detail: Go upstairs inside the headquarters and kill a mourner; a key is placed in your inventory automatically.

label: Unlock the caged room
detail: Use the key on the gate to get into the caged room.

label: Search the crate for the distillator
detail: Search the crate third from the left on the northern wall to find Elena's distillator.

label: Return the distillator to Elena
detail: With 3 empty inventory spaces, return to Elena and give her the distillator (via Ardougne Teleport, Skills necklace to the Fishing Guild, over the wall by Kilron, or via the Plague City sewers).

label: Walk to the Rimmington chemist
detail: Go to the chemist in south-western Rimmington (ship from Captain Barnaby at the Ardougne Dock for 30gp, or teleport).

label: Get the touch paper from the chemist
detail: Speak to the Chemist about your quest; he gives you the touch paper.

label: Give Chancy the liquid honey
detail: Find Chancy, Da Vinci and Hops around a fire outside the Chemist's house and give Chancy the vial of liquid honey.

hints.value: 2You give him the vial of liquid honey...

label: Give Da Vinci the ethenea
detail: Give Da Vinci the vial of ethenea. Giving any henchman the wrong vial forces you to redo the round with all three in Varrock before retrying.

hints.value: 1You give him the vial of ethenea...

label: Give Hops the sulphuric broline
detail: Give Hops the vial of sulphuric broline.

hints.value: 3You give him the vial of sulphuric broline...

label: Walk to the fenced area south-east of Varrock bank
detail: Teleport or travel to Varrock and head to the fenced area south-east of the bank; the guard searches you but lets the plague sample and touch paper through.

label: Get a free priest gown from Asyff (optional)
detail: (Optional) Speak to Asyff, the Fancy Dress Shop owner, in the building south-east for a free priest gown top and bottom, or buy one from him.

label: Equip the priest gown
detail: Equip the priest gown top and bottom.

label: Walk to the Dancing Donkey Inn
detail: Head to the Dancing Donkey Inn to reclaim the vials.

label: Reclaim the vial from Hops
detail: Talk to Hops to get the processed vial back; make sure you have free inventory space. Do not pass back through the Varrock gate or the vials are confiscated and you must get new samples from Elena.

label: Reclaim the vial from Da Vinci
detail: Talk to Da Vinci to get the processed vial back.

label: Reclaim the vial from Chancy
detail: Talk to Chancy to get the processed vial back.

label: Walk to Guidor's house
detail: With the priest gown equipped, head to Guidor's house in the south-east of the fenced area.

label: Deliver the sample to Guidor
detail: Speak to Guidor and tell him Elena has sent a sample that needs to be processed.

hints.value: 1I've come to ask your assistance in stopping a plague.

label: Report back to Elena
detail: Return to Ardougne and speak to Elena.

label: Walk to King Lathas' floor in Ardougne Castle
detail: Go to the first floor of Ardougne Castle.

label: Report to King Lathas to finish
detail: Speak to King Lathas to complete the quest.

label: Talk to Ceril Carnillean to start Hazeel Cult
detail: Ceril Carnillean is on the ground floor of his house south-west of East Ardougne castle. Ask what's wrong and agree to help.

label: Enter the Ardougne sewers
detail: Sewer entrance is east of the East Ardougne clocktower, south of Valve 3.

label: Talk to Clivet and refuse to help revive Hazeel
detail: Clivet explains Hazeel's history and asks for help reviving him; choose to refuse. He sails off on a raft.

hints.note: Player's own side-choice, not a requisite gate.

label: Turn all 5 sewer valves (Ceril route)
detail: Valve 1 (across the bridge south of the Carnilleans' house): right. Valve 2 (behind the house): right. Valve 3 (north of the cave): left. Valve 4 (south of the zoo penguin cage): right. Valve 5 (south-east of valve 4, past the monk): right.

label: Kill Alomone in the cave hideout
detail: Board the raft to the southernmost room and talk to Alomone; he reveals the butler is a cultist, then attacks.

label: Search the chest for Carnillean armour
detail: Open the chest in Alomone's room. Extra pieces are obtainable via the drop trick, but only during the quest.

label: Return the armour to Ceril Carnillean
detail: Board the raft back to the entrance, return to the Carnilleans' house and hand over the armour. This is a fake ending screen -- the real reward comes next.

label: Search the upstairs cupboard for evidence
detail: Search the cupboard on the first floor of the Carnilleans' house to find the Mark of Hazeel and a bottle of poison -- evidence against Butler Jones.

label: Show Ceril the evidence to finish Hazeel Cult
detail: Show Ceril the Mark of Hazeel and poison bottle; he fires Butler Jones and gives the real quest reward.

label: Talk to Clivet and accept helping revive Hazeel
detail: Free up an inventory slot first. Clivet explains Hazeel's history and asks for help; accept. He gives a bottle of poison and asks you to poison Ceril's food.

hints.value: Alright, how do I do it?
hints.note: Player's own side-choice, not a requisite gate.

label: Turn sewer valves 1 and 2 (Hazeel route)
detail: Valve 1 (across the bridge south of the house): right. Valve 2 (behind the house): right.

label: Poison the cooking range in Ceril's basement
detail: Go to the basement of the Carnilleans' house and use the bottle of poison on the cooking range.

label: Talk to Ceril upstairs about the accident
detail: Ceril reveals his son fed the poisoned meal to Scruffy the family dog instead of him.

label: Talk to Clivet to receive Hazeel's mark
detail: Clivet accepts the accidental dog-poisoning as proof of loyalty and gives you Hazeel's mark, then directs you to meet Alomone.

label: Turn sewer valves 3, 4 and 5 (Hazeel route)
detail: Valve 3 (north of the cave): left. Valve 4 (south of the zoo penguin cage): right. Valve 5 (south-east of valve 4, past the monk): right.

label: Talk to Alomone in the hideout
detail: Board the raft to the main hideout and talk to Alomone. He asks you to help the Carnilleans' butler retrieve a magical scroll from the house.

label: Talk to Butler Jones in the Carnilleans' house
detail: Butler Jones believes the scroll is hidden where the family won't find it.

label: Search the basement crate for a chest key
detail: Search the crate in the basement; finish the dialogue fully or the key won't be added to your inventory.

label: Retrieve the scroll of restoration
detail: Go up the ladder then the stairs, knock on the wall in the east room's north side, go up the ladder again, then unlock and search the chest.

label: Return the scroll to Alomone to finish Hazeel Cult
detail: Deliver the scroll of restoration to Alomone, starting Hazeel's resurrection and completing the quest.

label: Talk to the Strange Old Man at the Barrows
detail: He wanders the Barrows mounds east of Mort'ton and asks you to retrieve an icon guarded by the Barrows Brothers for an unnamed entity.

label: Defeat all six Barrows Brothers
detail: Verac the Defiled, Dharok the Wretched, Ahrim the Blighted, Torag the Corrupted, Karil the Tainted and Guthan the Infested must all be killed in one crypt run before the chest can be opened.

hints.note: Leave at least 6 inventory spaces open before searching the chest -- the strange icon will not drop to the ground, and a full inventory means refighting all six brothers.

label: Search the Barrows chest for the strange icon
detail: Open the reward chest after all six brothers are dead.

label: Return the strange icon to the Strange Old Man
detail: Completes the miniquest.

label: Bank: withdraw the Icthlarin's Little Helper loadout
detail: Withdraw a cat/kitten, tinderbox, willow log, bag of salt (or empty bucket), bucket of sap, a full waterskin(4), linen, and your chosen desert-entry method.

label: Talk to the Wanderer about your cat
detail: She is north-east of Sophanem, near the Agility Pyramid, and objects to your cat.

hints.value: Why? What's your problem with it? / Ok I'll get your supplies.

label: Give the Wanderer a tinderbox and waterskin(4)
detail: Hand over the requested supplies.

hints.value: Yes. I have them all here.

label: Enter the pyramid
detail: Touch the door of the pyramid; you black out and wake up inside for the first flashback.

label: Navigate the trapped corridor via the minimap
detail: Click the minimap rather than the main viewport to auto-avoid the aggressive level-84 mummies and poison scarabs.

label: Jump the pit (first crossing)
detail: Requires at least 20% run energy; higher Agility raises the success chance.

hints.note: Success chance scales with Agility level; exact rate not sourced.

label: Solve the golden bird puzzle
detail: West of the pit: click the golden bird to reset it until it lands on the pictured solution, then click the indicated tiles.

label: Answer the Sphinx's riddle
detail: Drop your cat first, then ask the Sphinx for help. Riddle answer: 9. Wrong answers make the cat disappear.

label: Talk to the High Priest
detail: He is south-west of the Sphinx.

label: Re-enter the pyramid for the second flashback
detail: Open the door and jump the pit again to trigger it.

label: Take the canopic jar from the western room
detail: Open the western door directly south and take back the correct canopic jar -- only the right one can be picked up.

label: Defeat the guardian apparition
detail: A level 75-81 apparition (Apmeken/Crondis/Scabaras/Het, matched to the jar taken) appears and must be killed before the jar can be kept.

hints.note: Which of the four guardians appears is fixed per-account by the jar taken, not random per attempt; combat style needed varies (magic vs melee).

label: Return the jar and re-solve the door puzzle
detail: Leave the room, jump the pit both ways, solve the western door puzzle again, and drop the jar back where it was found.

label: Exit the pyramid
detail: Jump the pit once more and leave via the entrance ladder.

label: Agree to help prepare the ceremony
detail: Talk to the High Priest back in Sophanem.

label: Give the Embalmer linen, salt and sap
detail: House south of the church, south of Sophanem.

label: Buy linen from Raetul if missing
detail: Raetul runs the Spinning Wheel shop north-east of the Embalmer's house; 30 coins per linen. Ask the Embalmer where to find linen first, or Raetul won't sell it.

label: Give the Carpenter your willow logs
detail: East of the Embalmer's house. He returns a holy symbol.

label: Re-enter the pyramid for the third flashback
detail: Right-click open the door and jump the pit again.

label: Use the holy symbol on a sarcophagus
detail: East door room; use the holy/unholy symbol on any sarcophagus, then leave the room.

label: Defeat the Possessed Priest
detail: Jump back across the pit, re-enter the eastern room, and kill the level-91 Possessed Priest.

label: Talk to the High Priest
detail: Report after defeating the Possessed Priest.

label: Exit the pyramid
detail: Leave via the entrance ladder.

label: Talk to the High Priest in the temple to finish
detail: Completes Icthlarin's Little Helper.

label: Talk to Wizard Mizgog to start Imp Catcher
detail: Top floor of the Wizards' Tower. He explains Wizard Grayzag's imps stole his 4 coloured magic beads (black, red, white, yellow).

label: Kill imps until all 4 coloured beads drop
detail: Beads are random imp drops, never a Grand Exchange purchase (gather/produce-never-GE hard rule -- the quick guide's own GE bullet is not modelled). Imp clusters: south entrance of Falador, top of the Karamja volcano, east of the Ardougne Monastery, the Chasm of Fire entrance, or the Charcoal furnace area.

hints.note: Per-colour drop rate not sourced from the fetched pages.

label: Give Wizard Mizgog all four beads to finish
detail: Return to the top of the Wizards' Tower with all four beads in your inventory.

hints.value: Give me a quest please. / Yes.

label: Reach the outpost north-west of Ardougne
detail: Walk there or use a necklace of passage to teleport directly.

label: Talk to Jorral to start the quest
detail: He assigns 3 independent historical leads, completable in any order.

hints.value: Ok, I'll make a stand for history!

label: Talk to the Silver merchant in the East Ardougne market
detail: Ask about the outpost to learn where to dig.

label: Dig for the buried chest north of Castle Wars
detail: Requires a spade.

label: Open the chest with the enchanted key to get a journal
detail: Reveals Erin's lead.

hints.value: The enchanted key's acquisition point is never stated in the fetched Quick guide text -- modelled as a pre-existing consumed item.

label: Equip the Ghostspeak amulet
detail: Needed to understand Droalak.

label: Talk to Droalak outside the Port Phasmatys general store
detail: Starts the ghost's lead.

label: Give Melina a strung sapphire amulet
detail: She is in the building east of the general store, directly south of the pub.

label: Talk to Droalak again to receive the scroll
detail: Completes Droalak's lead.

label: Talk to Blanin east of the longhall in Rellekka
detail: Introduces Dron's lead.

label: Answer Dron's trivia quiz
detail: He tests knowledge gathered from Blanin and around town: iron mace (weapon), rats (breakfast), kittens (lunch), bunnies (tea), red spider blood (favourite drink), 36 years 8 months 21 days (his age), Fifth and Fourth ages (his study), north-east side of town (house location), Blanin (brother's name), Fluffy (pet cat's name), 12 (5 plus 7).

hints.value: Why, you're the famous warrior Dron!
12, but what does that have to do with anything?

label: Report back to Jorral at the outpost with the scroll and journal
detail: All 3 leads must be complete first.

label: Talk to King Lathas on the first floor of Ardougne Castle
detail: Relays the findings to the King.

label: Talk to Jorral back at the outpost
detail: Completes Making History.

label: Talk to Abigale to start Misthalin Mystery
detail: South-east corner of Lumbridge Swamp, near the fishing spots. Agree to help.

hints.value: What has happened here? / What do you want me to do?

label: Take the boat to the manor
detail: Board the boat further south of the swamp.

label: Take a bucket from the fountain
detail: West of the manor, if not already carrying one.

label: Empty the rainwater barrel and take the manor key
detail: Use the bucket on the barrel of rainwater west of the manor, then take the key from the bottom of the emptied barrel.

label: Unlock and enter the manor
detail: Use the manor key on the manor doors.

label: Take the knife from the table
detail: Just inside the entry hall, if not already carrying one.

label: Read the note by the pink-knob door
detail: Attempting the pink-knob door north fails; the note beside it is the real clue.

label: Slash the gloomy-valley painting for the ruby key
detail: South-west room from the entry hall: use the knife on the painting of a gloomy valley (east wall), then search the slashed canvas.

label: Take a tinderbox from the shelves
detail: South-east room from the entry hall, if not already carrying one.

label: Light the four unlit candles
detail: All four are in the south-eastern room.

label: Light the fused barrel and flee the room
detail: Use the tinderbox on the barrel with the fuse, then exit to trigger the explosion.

label: Climb through the damaged wall
detail: Re-enter the south-eastern room and climb over the wall broken by the explosion.

label: Observe the tree across from Lacey
detail: Head north then west; the response option content doesn't matter.

label: Read the second note
detail: On the ground near the tree.

label: Play D-E-A-D on the piano for the emerald key
detail: North-eastern corner of the manor; play the notes, then search the piano.

label: Return to the mansion through the damaged wall
detail: Climb back over the wall into the main house.

label: Open the green-knob door
detail: North of the entrance, west of the pink-knob door.

label: Read the note by the godsword room
detail: Attempting the door west (with the Bandos godsword inside) fails; the note beside it is the clue.

label: Open the unlit fireplace with the knife
detail: Room north of the damaged-wall room.

label: Enter the gem sequence for the sapphire key
detail: Sapphire, Diamond, Zenyte, Emerald, Onyx, Ruby -- in that order -- then search the fireplace again.

label: Open the blue-knob door
detail: Westernmost door in the room where the painting was slashed.

hints.note: Which key opens which door is never stated explicitly by the source -- all three keys are modelled as consumed by this final door rather than guessing a colour-to-door mapping.

label: Push the mirror toward the killer's wardrobe
detail: Watch for a brief black shadow around a wardrobe, then push the mirror to face it before a knife is thrown. Repeat until the cutscene triggers.

label: Take the killer's knife after the cutscene
detail: Dropped once the killer is revealed.

label: Wield the killer's knife
Attack Abigale with the killer's knife
detail: Reveals the true killer.

label: Attempt to exit the room
Talk to Mandy outside the manor to finish
detail: Completes Misthalin Mystery.

label: Talk to Brother Omad to start Monk's Friend
detail: Ardougne Monastery, south of East Ardougne. He can't sleep -- his son's blanket was stolen and the birthday party isn't ready.

hints.value: Why can't you sleep, what's wrong? / Yes

label: Enter the stone circle west of the monastery
detail: Slightly south-west of the Clock Tower; go down the ladder in the middle of the circle.

label: Follow the path south and pick up the child's blanket
detail: The thieves' den beneath the stone circle.

label: Return the blanket to Brother Omad
detail: Talk to him twice; he mentions his brother Cedric.

hints.value: Who's Brother Cedric? / Where should I look?

label: Walk to Brother Cedric
detail: North of the monastery, directly south of the Ardougne Zoo, near the well.

label: Give Brother Cedric a jug of water
Give Brother Cedric the logs or plank
Return to Brother Omad to finish Monk's Friend
detail: Completes the quest; he'll now throw parties for you on request.

label: Talk to a guard to start Murder Mystery
detail: Any guard around the Sinclair Mansion, north of Seers' Village and Camelot. Agree to investigate.

label: Search the shed sacks for flypaper
detail: North-west of the mansion; take 4 flypapers.

label: Take the pungent pot and criminal's dagger
detail: Both are inside the mansion.

label: Investigate the smashed window for a criminal's thread
detail: Eastern side of the mansion. Thread colour is randomised per playthrough and determines which two suspects to search next.

hints.note: Colour (red/green/blue) is randomised per playthrough; see the cited walkthrough's colour table rather than a fixed pairing.

label: Search the two matching suspects' barrels
detail: Red thread -> Bob and Carol's rooms. Green thread -> Anna and David's rooms. Blue thread -> Elizabeth and Frank's rooms. Search both barrels for a silver item each.

hints.note: Which pair of suspects is searched depends on the thread colour rolled in mdm-04.

label: Fill the pot with flour
detail: Kitchen barrel of flour.

label: Dust the silver items and dagger for prints
detail: Use flour and flypaper on each silver item and the dagger to lift a print from each.

label: Compare prints until you find a match
detail: Test each suspect's print against the dagger's print (Anna, Bob, Frank, David, Carol, Elizabeth). Remember whoever matches.

hints.note: Which of the 6 named suspects matches is randomised per playthrough -- never fabricated to a fixed name.

label: Ask Gossip who he thinks is responsible
detail: Outside the front gate of the mansion.

hints.value: Who do you think was responsible?

label: Ask the poison salesman who bought poison
detail: Seers' Village pub. Select the Murder Mystery quest option, not Fremennik Trials.

hints.value: Who did you sell Poison to at the house?

label: Ask the matched suspect why they bought poison
detail: They claim an item they used it on -- confirm by searching that item next.

hints.value: Why'd you buy poison the other day?

label: Search the claimed poisoned item
detail: Anna -> compost heap. Bob -> beehive in the cow pen. Frank -> Family Crest east of the front door. David -> spiders' nest upstairs. Carol -> kitchen drain west of the front door. Elizabeth -> the fountain.

hints.note: Which item is searched depends on which suspect matched in mdm-08.

label: Accuse the killer to finish Murder Mystery
detail: Drop the silver necklace first if you searched Anna's barrel and want to keep it -- it can't be reclaimed after this step.

hints.note: Only relevant if Anna's barrel was the one searched.

label: Talk to Orlando Smith to start the natural history quiz
detail: He is on the basement floor, centre of the Varrock Museum. Starts the 14-display quiz (28 kudos total).

label: Answer 3 questions correctly at each north-room display (4 displays)
detail: Click each display's plaque and answer 3 of its questions correctly. North room displays: Lizard, Battle tortoise, Dragon, Wyvern. Each display draws from a larger question pool per attempt (own-words summary; consult the cited page for the full per-display answer key rather than assuming a fixed 3-question order).

hints.note: Which 3 of each display's question pool are asked varies per attempt.

label: Answer 3 questions correctly at each east-room display (4 displays)
detail: Click each display's plaque and answer 3 of its questions correctly. East room displays: Snail, Snake, Sea slug, Monkey. Each display draws from a larger question pool per attempt (own-words summary; consult the cited page for the full per-display answer key rather than assuming a fixed 3-question order).

hints.note: Which 3 of each display's question pool are asked varies per attempt.

label: Answer 3 questions correctly at each south-room display (2 displays)
detail: Click each display's plaque and answer 3 of its questions correctly. South room displays: Kalphite Queen, Terrorbird. Each display draws from a larger question pool per attempt (own-words summary; consult the cited page for the full per-display answer key rather than assuming a fixed 3-question order).

hints.note: Which 3 of each display's question pool are asked varies per attempt.

label: Answer 3 questions correctly at each west-room display (4 displays)
detail: Click each display's plaque and answer 3 of its questions correctly. West room displays: Penguin, Mole, Camel, Leech. Each display draws from a larger question pool per attempt (own-words summary; consult the cited page for the full per-display answer key rather than assuming a fixed 3-question order).

hints.note: Which 3 of each display's question pool are asked varies per attempt.

label: Talk to Orlando Smith to finish the quiz
detail: Once all 14 displays are complete (28 kudos), report back for 1000 Hunter and 1000 Slayer experience. If this is your first Slayer xp, the first assignment's enchanted gem must be bought for 1 coin instead of given free.

label: Bank: withdraw the Plague City loadout
detail: Dwellberries, a rope, 1-4 buckets of water (or refill en route), a hangover cure or its ingredients (chocolate dust, bucket of milk, snape grass), and a spade if not spawned nearby.

label: Talk to Edmond to start Plague City
detail: North-western house of East Ardougne, behind the wall. His daughter Elena vanished three weeks ago after crossing into plague-stricken West Ardougne to heal the sick.

label: Talk to Alrena about a gas mask
detail: Edmond's wife, inside or near the house. She'll make a mask if given dwellberries.

label: Give Alrena the dwellberries for a gas mask
detail: Spare masks are also in the house cupboard.

label: Take the picture of Elena
detail: Inside Alrena and Edmond's house.

label: Talk to Edmond about digging under the wall
detail: He explains the plan to soften the ground with water, then dig through.

label: Soften the mud patch with water
detail: Behind Edmond's house, between the cabbages and potatoes; refill buckets at the sink inside.

label: Dig through the softened ground
detail: You and Edmond fall underground together.

label: Free the blocked pipe grill with a rope
detail: Walk south underground to find the grill; pulling by hand fails first.

label: Talk to Edmond to pull the grill off together
Equip the gas mask and climb into West Ardougne
Show Jethick the picture of Elena
detail: East, in the same plaza. He gives a book borrowed from the Rehnisons.

label: Walk to the Rehnison house
detail: North, the grey-plank building set against the wall.

label: Talk to the Rehnisons about Elena
detail: Mention the borrowed book to be let in; talk to Martha or Ted downstairs, then Milli upstairs.

label: Walk to the marked plague house
detail: South past the town square, near the southern wall -- the house with a black X on its doors and a central stairwell down.

label: Ask the Mourners about the kidnapped girl
detail: They refuse entry without Bravek's permission; you must select the ask-again dialogue option to progress.

label: Convince the clerk to let you see Bravek
detail: Large building north side, north of the manhole. State the urgency of a kidnapping.

hints.value: This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!

label: Make the hangover cure
detail: Add chocolate dust to the bucket of milk, then add snape grass. Do not left-click the chocolate bar or the chocolatey milk or you'll eat/drink it by mistake.

label: Give Bravek the hangover cure
detail: He's badly hung over and can barely talk until cured; he'll give a warrant granting entry to the plague house.

label: Show the Mourners the warrant
detail: They stand aside, letting you sneak into the plague house.

label: Search the barrel for a small key
detail: West of the staircase inside the plague house.

label: Unlock the door downstairs
Talk to Elena to free her
Return to Edmond's garden
detail: Climb down the central manhole and up the mud pile back to the surface.

label: Talk to Edmond to finish Plague City
Talk to the Odd Old Man to start Rag and Bone Man I
detail: Silvarea, north-east of Varrock by the Limestone Mine, north of the Digsite. He mentions boiling bones in vinegar.

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man I/Quick guide

label: Kill 8 named creatures for their bones
detail: One bone type per monster: giant rat bone, unicorn bone, bear ribs, ram skull, goblin skull, big frog leg, monkey paw, giant bat wing. The cited walkthrough's own zone table lists several spawn locations per monster along a rough south-from-Silvarea-through-Lumbridge-Swamp-to-Karamja route.

hints.note: Per-monster bone drop rate not sourced from the fetched pages.

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man I/Quick guide

label: Buy 8 jugs of vinegar from Fortunato
detail: Draynor Village marketplace, a named non-GE vendor; 1 coin each per the quest's own item list.

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man I/Quick guide

label: Combine vinegar with pots
detail: Use each jug of vinegar with a pot to make 8 pots of vinegar. (Buy 27 extra jugs -- 35 total -- now if planning to also do Rag and Bone Man II.)

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man I/Quick guide

label: Soak each bone in vinegar
detail: Use each of the 8 gathered bones with a pot of vinegar.

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man I/Quick guide

label: Bank: withdraw a tinderbox and 8 logs
detail: Any log type works, or bring an axe to cut them en route instead.

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man I/Quick guide

label: Boil each bone-in-vinegar on the pot-boiler
detail: Per bone: place a set of logs on the pot-boiler next to the Odd Old Man, use the bone-in-vinegar with the pot-boiler, light the logs, then wait roughly 12 seconds for the fire to burn out before removing the pot (world-hopping after lighting also works, finishing on relog).

hints.note: Hopping worlds after lighting the logs lets the boil finish while you're away instead of waiting the ~12s out.

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man I/Quick guide

label: Return the boiled bones to finish Rag and Bone Man I
detail: Completes the quest.

refs.title: Rag and Bone Man I/Quick guide

label: Read the Canifis signpost (start Creature of Fenkenstrain)
detail: Advertises a 'Braindead Butler' job; talk to Dr Fenkenstrain directly if the signpost claims requirements aren't met.

label: Take the pickled brain from the pub table (or buy it from Roavar)
detail: Pub south of the signpost. Roavar offers to sell it for 50 coins if not taken free; Telekinetic Grab (33 Magic) also avoids paying.

label: Talk to Dr Fenkenstrain (job interview: 'braindead', 'grave-digging')
detail: Inside Fenkenstrain's Castle. He needs a brain, head, torso, arms and legs to build a body.

label: Search both castle bookcases for the marble and obsidian amulets, combine them
detail: West bookcase ('The Joy of Grave Digging') gives marble amulet, east bookcase ('Handy Maggot Avoidance Techniques') gives obsidian amulet; use them on each other.

label: Dig Ed Lestwit's grave for a decapitated head
detail: South-east of fairy ring ALQ. Read the grave first to confirm it, then dig with a spade.

label: Use the pickled brain on the decapitated head
Use the star amulet on the eastern memorial (enter the cave)
detail: Tombstones east of the castle, west of the Farming patches. Unaggressive level 25/51 Experiments inside.

label: Kill a level 51 Experiment for the cavern key
detail: South-west crevice; safespottable with ranged/magic or flinchable with melee from the entrance.

hints.note: Kill extra level-25 Experiments here for Experiment bones if that quest is in progress.

label: Dig the three northern graves for legs, arms and a torso
detail: Through the north-west passage past the gate, up the ladder.

label: Give Fenkenstrain all body parts and the sewing kit
detail: Requires a needle (costume needle does not work) and 5 thread, brought as owned items.

label: Talk to the Gardener Ghost (get the shed key)
detail: Requires an equipped ghostspeak amulet.

label: Search the shed cupboard for the garden brush
Combine 3 garden canes and bronze wire with the brush
detail: Garden canes are east of the shed. 20 Crafting.

label: Sweep the west-room fireplace for a conductor mould
detail: 1F west room. Aim for the centre of the fireplace, not the surround.

label: Make a lightning rod at a furnace (silver bar + mould)
detail: Port Phasmatys furnace (2 ecto-tokens, free after Ghosts Ahoy) is nearest; any furnace works with a return method to the castle.

label: Fix the lightning conductor on the castle roof
detail: Climb to the roof via the southernmost 1F room; lightning strikes and the creature comes alive.

label: Talk to Dr Fenkenstrain (get the tower key)
Climb to the tower and talk to Lord Rologarth
detail: Reveals the true story -- Fenkenstrain sold him and his subjects to the vampyres.

label: Pickpocket Dr Fenkenstrain for the ring of charos
detail: 25 Thieving.

label: Talk to Dr Fenkenstrain or Lord Rologarth (finish quest)
Talk to Austri or Vestri (start Fishing Contest)
detail: East or west side of White Wolf Mountain. Ask about the stairs, offer friendship, learn about the Hemenster fishing contest trophy.

hints.note: Fixed 5-line dialogue chain to reach the fishing-pass offer.

label: Pick up garlic (house south-west of the Seers' Village bank)
Check the red vine for 2+ red vine worms (McGrubor's Wood)
detail: West of the fairy ring inside McGrubor's Wood; beware aggressive level-44 guard dogs. Fairy ring code als also completes a medium Kandarin Diary task.

label: Buy a fishing rod from Grandpa Jack (if not already carried)
detail: House north-east of Hemenster.

label: Show Morris the fishing pass (enter Hemenster)
Place the garlic in the south-wall pipe
detail: North building, next to the gate.

label: Pay Bonzo the contest fee (5 coins, swap places with the Sinister Stranger)
Fish at the pipe spot with a red vine worm (catch the giant carp)
detail: Unique catch, not obtainable by normal fishing.

label: Give Bonzo the giant carp (win the fishing competition)
Return to the dwarf and hand over the trophy (finish quest)
Talk to Trufitus (start Jungle Potion)
detail: North-east hut, Tai Bwo Wannai. He needs 5 herbs to commune with the island's gods -- must return after each one.

label: Search the marshy jungle vine for grimy snake weed
detail: South-west of the village near the ocean; take 2 extra if planning Legends' Quest/Zogre Flesh Eaters.

hints.note: Search time scales inversely with Herblore level.

label: Give Trufitus the cleaned snake weed
Search a palm tree for grimy ardrigal
detail: North-east peninsula, south of the agility shortcut; avoid the level-46 Harpie Bug Swarms. Take an extra for Legends' Quest.

label: Give Trufitus the cleaned ardrigal
Search the scorched earth for grimy sito foil
detail: Immediately south of the village; aggressive poisoning tribesmen (11+ starting damage) nearby.

label: Give Trufitus the cleaned sito foil
Search an empty rock for grimy volencia moss
detail: Mining area south-east of the hut. Take an extra for Fairytale I - Growing Pains.

label: Give Trufitus the cleaned volencia moss
Search the fungus-covered cavern wall for grimy rogue's purse
detail: Through the searchable-rock cave entrance north-east of the village, run south past aggressive level-53 Jogres. Optional: kill a Jogre here for an easy Karamja Diary task (Jogre bones needed for Tai Bwo Wannai Trio). Take an extra for Zogre Flesh Eaters.

label: Return to Trufitus with the final herb (finish quest)
Go to the Mountain Camp (east of Rellekka)
detail: Use rope on the boulder marked 'push boulder' north up the slope above the guard to climb down.

label: Talk to Hamal the Chieftain (start Mountain Daughter)
detail: Ask 'Why is everyone so hostile?' in the longhouse east of the entrance.

label: Gather mud from the pond roots (or bring swamp paste)
detail: South of Hamal's house, along the bubbling mud pond edge.

label: Pick up the pole at Jokul's place (if no staff carried)
detail: North of Hamal's house.

label: Cross to the island in the Shining pool (mud, tree, pole-vault, plank)
detail: Use mud on the tall tree to avoid slipping, climb and crawl the branch, pole-vault the rock clump, cross the flat stone with a plank.

label: Listen to the Shining pool bubbles (talk to Asleif's spirit)
detail: She asks for peace between the tribes and a new food source; both tasks can be started in parallel.

label: Find and talk to Svidi (outside Keldagrim, near the black unicorns)
detail: Choose 'Can't I persuade you to go in there somehow?' -- the other option makes him flee.

label: Talk to Brundt the Chieftain in Rellekka (get a safety promise)
detail: He wants the stolen ancient rock relic returned first.

label: Mine the ancient rock in the Mountain Camp's southern tent
detail: Right-click the rock with a pickaxe -- left-click does not work.

label: Give Brundt the rock (receive the safety guarantee)
Give Svidi the safety guarantee (peace talks begin)
Talk to Jokul (learn a White pearl fruit seed could feed the camp)
Pick a White pearl fruit on White Wolf Mountain's peak (wear gloves)
detail: Thorny bushes near the gnome glider; gloves required or 4 damage is taken and no fruit obtained. Eating the fruit auto-spits the seed.

label: Give Hamal the White pearl seed
Talk to Asleif again (learn about the Kendal)
detail: Requires both peace and food tasks complete; cross via tree/pole-vault/plank again.

label: Chop the dead trees blocking the cave entrance
detail: North side of the pool, path east; stand west of the first tree to avoid getting stuck on the stump.

label: Talk to the Kendal (accuse him, trigger the fight)
detail: Dialogue: 'no one special' -> 'a sacrifice?' -> call out the bearsuit -> demand her remains -> threaten to kill him.

label: Kill the Kendal (level 70, 50 HP)
detail: Protect from Melee blocks all damage; Ranged/Magic can safespot around the skeletons. A new Kendal spawns after each kill if repeating the safespot -- a cannon will re-aggro it.

label: Take Asleif's corpse (south-eastern pillar corner)
Gather 5 muddy rocks (mountain goat pen)
detail: Rocks respawn quickly -- fine to reuse the same one repeatedly.

label: Talk to Ragnar (receive Asleif's necklace)
detail: Just past the tall tree, up the path from the pen.

label: Cross to the island again and bury Asleif's corpse
detail: Tall tree, pole-vault, plank -- same crossing as before.

label: Use the muddy rocks on the burial mound (build the cairn, finish quest)
Bank: withdraw Sleeping Giants loadout
detail: Withdraw: 3 oak logs, 1 wool (ball of wool does not work), 10 nails, a hammer or Imcando hammer, a chisel, and 1 bucket of water or ice gloves. 20 free inventory spaces for the crate-search step.

label: Strike the odd Hill Giant (Kovac) to start Sleeping Giants
detail: Giants' Plateau, east of Al Kharid, by a giant anvil. He has a 'Strike' option instead of 'Attack'.

label: Repair the trip hammer (1 oak log, 5 nails)
Repair the grindstone (chisel)
Repair the polishing wheel (2 oak logs, 5 nails, 1 wool)
Talk to Kovac (accept the practice-sword commission)
Drop items, search the crate for bronze/iron pieces
detail: Instanced room -- pick up any dropped items before talking to Kovac or they're lost. Needs 20 empty inventory spaces for up to 20 seconds.

label: Use the metal pieces on the crucible until full
Talk to Kovac, set the forte/blade/tip mould to match the commission
Talk to Kovac, pour the crucible into the mould jig (get the preform)
detail: No weapon/shield equipped when cooling with the bucket of water; ice gloves skip the bucket step.

label: Refine the preform: heat, hammer, cool, grind, cool, polish
detail: Heat on the lava pool to red, hit with the Trip Hammer while staying red, cool at the waterfall to near-green, use the Grindstone to green, cool again to high-green, then use the Polishing Wheel to finish. Any quality sword satisfies Kovac.

label: Talk to Kovac (deliver the sword, learn of Obor, finish quest)
Talk to Brundt the Chieftain (start The Fremennik Trials)
detail: Rellekka longhall. Explains 7 of 12 council members must vote for you; trials can be done in any order.

label: Talk to Manni the Reveller (accept the drinking challenge)
detail: Bar next to the longhall. Take the keg of beer and beer tankard off the bar.

label: Talk to Manni again (lose the drinking contest)
detail: You always lose; Manni barely gets drunk.

label: Buy a low alcohol keg of beer (Poison Salesman, Seers' Village)
detail: Seers' Village bar. Skip if the beer tankard was already grabbed.

label: Give the council workman a beer (get the strange object)
detail: Council workman at the Rellekka end of the footbridge.

label: Light the strange object with a tinderbox
Hide the lit strange object in the pipe (east wall of the longhall)
detail: Distraction primed; grab a fresh keg of beer from the longhall table before it goes off (skip if one is already banked).

label: Swap the kegs (use the low alcohol keg on the normal keg of beer)
detail: Explosion distracts the Fremennik, letting you switch the contents.

label: Talk to Manni (drink the swapped keg, receive his vote)
Talk to Olaf the Bard (learn a lyre is needed)
detail: East of the Rellekka bar. Must be spoken to first if collecting the lyre as a monster drop.

label: Gather potato, cabbage and onion from the Rellekka vegetable patch
detail: Grab all three before leaving Rellekka's gates.

label: Cut a branch from the swaying tree (east of Rellekka)
detail: Requires an axe (blessed axes do not work) and 40 Woodcutting.

label: Cut the branch into an unfinished lyre
detail: Knife on the swaying branch; 40 Crafting to make the unfinished lyre.

label: Talk to Lalli (ask for golden wool)
detail: South-east of the swaying tree, near the golden sheep/tree. He already gave his wool to Askeladden.

label: Talk to Askeladden (get the pet rock)
detail: Child at the Rellekka longhall entrance.

label: Use the vegetables and pet rock on Lalli's stew
detail: Stew pot just outside Lalli's cave home.

label: Talk to Lalli (offer the stew, receive golden fleece)
detail: Take extra fleece now via the drop trick if crafting spare lyres -- Lalli charges 1,000gp/fleece once the trial is done.

label: Spin the golden fleece into golden wool
detail: Seers' Village spinning wheel (the Rellekka spinning wheel is locked until the quest is finished).

label: String the unfinished lyre with golden wool
Kill a council worker (Lanzig/Borrokar/Lensa/Freidir) until a lyre drops
detail: Eastern Rellekka buildings; each has a 1/17 chance, quick respawns, safespottable near the central fires.

hints.note: Alternative to crafting a lyre -- skips the vegetable/wool chain entirely.

label: Buy a raw shark (Rufus' Meat Emporium, Canifis)
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to fishing it yourself (Fishing 76); Frankie's Fishing Emporium (Port Piscarilius) also sells raw shark. One fish needed per lyre to enchant.

label: Use the raw fish on the strange altar (enchant the lyre)
detail: Small peninsula south-west of Rellekka. Fossegrimen the spirit enchants the lyre. Drop any spare enchanted lyres before entering the stage or they un-enchant.

label: Play the lyre on stage and talk to Olaf (receive his vote)
detail: Enter through the door the Longhall Bouncer guards.

label: Talk to Sigli the Huntsman (get the hunters' talisman)
detail: Near the Rellekka entrance gate.

label: Locate and defeat the Draugen (level 69)
detail: Use the talisman like a Runecraft talisman to get directional chat clues; the Draugen roams the Fremennik Province and crosses bridges. 48 Agility unlocks a log-balance shortcut. Weak to air spells (50%) despite high magic defence; Ranged is least effective.

hints.note: Random roaming location; camp near the bridge east of the strange altar as a slow fallback.

label: Talk to Sigli (return the charged talisman, receive his vote)
Talk to Sigmund the Merchant (learn he wants an exotic flower)
detail: Rellekka marketplace. A reverse fetch-quest chain of 12 NPCs follows -- do not lose any item or restart from Askeladden's note.

label: Talk to the Sailor (learn he wants a romantic ballad)
detail: Second pier from the left.

label: Talk to Olaf the Bard (learn he wants new boots)
Talk to Yrsa (learn she needs taxes lowered first)
detail: Clothing store west of Sigmund.

label: Talk to Brundt (learn he needs Sigli to show him hunting spots)
Talk to Sigli (learn he wants a custom bowstring)
detail: South of the longhall.

label: Talk to Skulgrimen (learn she wants a rare fish)
detail: Helmet store north of the longhall.

label: Talk to the fisherman (learn he wants a map of the best fish spots)
detail: Northern end of the dock west of the helmet shop.

label: Talk to Swensen the Navigator (learn he wants a weather forecast)
detail: Building south of the marketplace.

label: Talk to Peer the Seer (learn he wants Thorvald as bodyguard)
detail: North-west of Swensen.

label: Talk to Thorvald the Warrior (learn he wants a longhall seat)
detail: Helmet store.

label: Talk to Manni the Reveller (learn he wants a cocktail)
Talk to Thora the Barkeep (learn she wants a signed note from Askeladden)
Pay Askeladden for the signed note
detail: South of the longhall.

label: Deliver every item back down the chain, ending with the flower to Sigmund
detail: Reverse order: note to Thora, cocktail to Manni, seat token to Thorvald, bodyguard contract to Peer, forecast to Swensen, chart to the fisherman, fish to Skulgrimen, bowstring to Sigli, hunting map to Brundt, tax slip to Yrsa, boots to Olaf, ballad to the sailor, then the flower to Sigmund.

hints.note: One continuous reverse-delivery round; no combat, purely sequential hand-offs.

label: Talk to Swensen the Navigator (learn about the portal maze)
detail: House south-west of the longhall; enter the maze via the ladder inside.

label: Navigate the portal maze (spell SWENSEN: S,W,E,N,S,E,N)
detail: Each room has 4 portals (N/S/E/W); lit-torch rooms hold the correct portal, dark dead-end rooms send you back to the start via a rope climb.

hints.note: Keep the minimap oriented north-up while tracking room order.

label: Talk to Swensen (receive his vote)
Talk to Thorvald the Warrior (learn about the Koschei fight)
detail: Helmet store. No weapons/armour/fletching materials/runes allowed; only food, Prayer, god books and jewellery.

label: Talk to Peer the Seer (bank forbidden items before the fight)
detail: Optional but recommended; drop wanted items first if you want to keep them for the fight instead of banking them.

label: Defeat Koschei the deathless (forms 1-3)
detail: Unarmed/unarmoured; rings of recoil, god books and prayer potions are the main tools. Form 3 has a 10-minute time limit before despawn.

hints.note: Form 1 can be trapped over a hole while HP regenerates; no safespot exists once armed with nothing.

label: Defeat Koschei's 4th form (optional, safe death on failure)
detail: 255 HP, hits 1 damage every tick, drains prayer instantly. Losing just ends the fight (safe death, even for HCIM) and still passes the trial.

hints.note: Each ring breaks after 40 damage soaked; 7 needed to tank the full 255 HP fight.

label: Talk to Thorvald (receive his vote)
detail: Grants a Fremennik blade if the 4th form was also defeated.

label: Talk to Peer the Seer (deposit ALL items, start the trial)
detail: Do this trial last -- every equipped and inventory item is banked, saving a walk to/from the bank for the other trials.

label: Solve Peer's four-letter riddle to enter the house
detail: Answer is one of: time, life, mage, fire, wind, mind, tree -- the specific clue quatrain varies per playthrough.

hints.note: Seven possible riddle/answer pairs are documented on the quest page; read the given clue each time rather than memorizing one answer.

label: Solve the water-balance chest puzzle (jug/bucket/vase/frozen key)
detail: Fill/pour the bucket and jug between the tap and drain to measure exactly 4/5 bucket for the chest (vase); burn the red herring on the range for sticky goop, apply it to the wooden disk for a second red disk, use both disks on the mural for the vase lid, seal the vase, freeze it on the frozen table, then cook the frozen key to thaw it.

hints.note: Bucket/jug ratio sequence for exactly 4/5 -- search every room object first (old red disk, wooden disk, red herring, empty jug, empty bucket).

label: Exit via the correct east ladder (receive Peer's vote)
detail: Use the east ladder nearest the frozen table -- the other exit repeats earlier puzzle parts.

label: Talk to Brundt the Chieftain (submit all 7 votes, finish the quest)
Buy papyrus from Ali Morrisane
Gather 4 soft clay (mine with a bracelet of clay, or clay + water)
detail: North-west of the ruins with a bracelet of clay + pickaxe, or use a jug of water from the Oasis south of Uzer on mined clay (world-hop to respawn the jug).

label: Steal a phoenix feather from the Desert Phoenix
detail: North-west of the ruins near the clay mine; 25 Thieving. Also completes a medium Desert Diary task.

label: Talk to the clay golem (start The Golem)
detail: Ruins of Uzer, east of Shantay Pass.

label: Use soft clay on the golem (repair it)
Ask the golem how to open the portal (learn of the 4 temple statuettes)
Take and read the letter outside the temple ruins
detail: Describes a discontinued expedition after the Digsite (Varrock) opened.

label: Pick a black mushroom just inside the temple entrance
detail: Pick a second one now to save a return trip for Shadow of the Storm.

label: Pick up the strange implement (north-western corner of the temple)
Go to the Digsite (talk to Elissa)
detail: North-eastern corner of the Digsite; fastest via digsite pendant or gnome glider.

label: Talk to Elissa about the letter (learn of Varmen's notes)
Search the Exam Centre's south-eastern bookshelf for Varmen's notes
Return to Elissa (ask where the statuette went)
detail: Points to the Varrock Museum.

label: Pickpocket Curator Haig Halen for the display cabinet key
detail: Varrock Museum ground floor; 25 Thieving.

label: Unlock Display Case 30 and take the statuette
detail: Upstairs, first row, fourth case. Re-use the key on the empty cabinet if the statuette is lost.

label: Return to the Ruins of Uzer
Use the statuette on the alcove and turn all 4 statues to face the doors
detail: East statues face right, west statues face left, all facing north toward the double doors.

label: Use chisel and hammer on the throne (2 rubies, 2 emeralds, 2 sapphires)
detail: Optional bonus loot, not required for the quest.

label: Grind the black mushroom into black dye (pestle and mortar)
Use the phoenix feather on the ink, then on the papyrus (write the Golem program)
Use the strange implement then the golem program on the golem (finish quest)
Talk to the Squire (start The Knight's Sword)
detail: Courtyard of the White Knights' Castle, Falador. He lost Sir Vyvin's ceremonial sword.

label: Talk to Reldo (learn of Thurgo the Imcando dwarf)
detail: Varrock Palace library, ground floor. Skip if The Giant Dwarf is already complete.

label: Cook a redberry pie
detail: Pie dish from the Varrock Palace kitchen, redberries just west of the South-east Varrock mine. 10 Cooking.

label: Go to Thurgo's hut (Mudskipper Point, south of Port Sarim)
Give Thurgo the redberry pie (ask about a special sword)
Search Sir Vyvin's cupboard for the portrait
detail: Upper floor of the White Knights' Castle; wait for Sir Vyvin to leave the room or hop worlds.

hints.note: He blocks the search if inside and facing you.

label: Give Thurgo the portrait
Mine 1-3 blurite ore (Asgarnian Ice Dungeon)
detail: All enemies aggressive -- run past pirates north then east to the icy room; safespot in front of the wyvern-section entrance. 10 Mining. Mine 2-3 for Falador Diary/an extra sword.

label: Give Thurgo the iron bars and blurite ore (craft the sword)
detail: Ask for a replacement after dropping the first if you want your own blurite sword.

label: Give the Squire the blurite sword (finish quest)
Talk to King Bolren (start Tree Gnome Village)
detail: Centre of the Tree Gnome Village maze, south-east of East Ardougne. Three orbs of protection have been stolen by Khazard troops.

label: Gather 6 normal logs (or kill goblins for them)
detail: Chop with an axe, kill maze goblins for spawns, or retrieve stored logs from the canoe station near the north entrance.

label: Talk to Commander Montai (give the 6 logs)
detail: North of the maze at the battlefield; wears red clothing.

label: Talk to Commander Montai again (learn 3 trackers are missing)
Talk to the first tracker gnome (get a coordinate)
detail: Behind/beside the biggest north-west building.

label: Talk to the second tracker gnome (Khazard Prison Cell, get a coordinate)
detail: North-east building.

label: Talk to the third tracker gnome (decode the riddled coordinate)
detail: Roaming outside the south-west stronghold corner; driven mad, gives a riddle instead of a number.

hints.note: Riddled number 1-4, e.g. 'less than my hands'=1, 'more than my head less than my fingers'=2.

label: Fire the ballista using the third tracker's coordinate
detail: South-west corner of the battlefield (not the catapult next to Montai); retry if you miss.

label: Talk to Commander Montai (proceed to the stronghold)
Fight through the stronghold to the chest (2 level-48 Khazard commanders, optional)
detail: Low HP (22 each); both fights can be skipped by simply running past them to the chest.

hints.note: Optional fight; skip both and head straight to the ladder/chest if you prefer.

label: Search the chest for the first orb of protection
Talk to King Bolren (report; learn the Warlord has the other two orbs)
detail: Return via Elkoy at the north-west maze entrance.

label: Kill the Khazard warlord (level 112, drops the last 2 orbs)
detail: North past the stronghold, near the West Ardougne wall; 170 HP. Unaggressive until spoken to.

hints.note: Ranged/Magic can wedge him against the wall near the large dead tree; melee flinch also works at the large skull to the south.

label: Talk to King Bolren (hand over all 3 orbs, finish quest)
Talk to Morgan (start Vampyre Slayer)
detail: His house just north of Ned's in Draynor Village. Search the upstairs cupboard for garlic if not already carried.

label: Go to the Blue Moon Inn (Varrock)
Talk to Dr Harlow (he wants a drink first)
Buy a beer from the bartender
Give Dr Harlow the beer (receive the stake and advice)
detail: He advises the stake, a hammer to drive it in, and that vampyres dislike garlic.

label: Buy a hammer (Varrock General Store)
Go to Draynor Manor
Kill Count Draynor (level 34, in the coffin room)
detail: Open the coffin in the centre of the east basement room to start the fight. Garlic deals 10 dmg + debuffs his stats on first hit; without a hammer you cannot finish the kill. He heals to full and resets if the fight drags on too long.

hints.note: South-western corner between the staircase and skeleton; Magic recommended if flinching, since he regenerates ~6x normal rate.

label: Automatically stake Count Draynor (quest completes on the kill)
Talk to Almera (start Waterfall Quest)
detail: House north-east of Baxtorian Falls; worried about her son Hudon across the river.

label: Board the log raft (crash onto the small island)
Talk to Hudon (finish all dialogue)
detail: He refuses to leave; complete every dialogue line or the book won't spawn downstream.

label: Swim south (wash ashore near the fisherman's building)
Search the southernmost bookcase (get the book on Baxtorian)
detail: Eastern wall, upstairs.

label: Read the book on Baxtorian
detail: Reveals Glarial's pebble is hidden under Tree Gnome Village. Must be read or the key won't appear later.

label: Go to the Tree Gnome Village maze
Find the key in the east room of the maze basement
detail: Slightly different-coloured crate next to the two stacked crates, south-east corner.

label: Unlock the door and talk to Golrie (receive Glarial's pebble)
detail: West room. Use the drop trick here for spare pebbles if planning Roving Elves later.

label: Go to Glarial's Tomb (south-east of Baxtorian Falls)
detail: Bank any prohibited items first (weapons, armour, capes, runes, arrows, logs) -- strict item restrictions inside.

label: Use Glarial's pebble on the tombstone (enter the tomb)
Search the western chest for Glarial's amulet (past the moss guardians)
detail: Attack a lower-level skeleton/zombie first to avoid aggroing the level-84 moss guardians in this single-combat area.

label: Search the southern coffin for Glarial's urn
detail: You cannot act while searching the coffin, but can still be attacked. Drop trick for spares recommended at low levels.

label: Return to Almera's house and board the raft again
Use rope on the grey rock (small patch of land downstream)
detail: Do not swim or touch the tree without the rope prepared first.

label: Use rope on the dead tree and climb it
Kill a Fire Giant (level 86, optional Kandarin Diary task)
detail: Single-combat cavern; attacking a shadow spider instead prevents Fire Giants from engaging if skipping this.

label: Search the crates in the eastern passage for a key
detail: Room with level-16 skeleton mages.

label: Place air, water and earth runes on each of the 6 pillars
detail: Follow the order carefully -- misplaced runes wash you out or deal up to 20 damage.

label: Use Glarial's amulet on the Statue of Glarial
detail: Warning: any item dropped in the pillar chamber becomes unretrievable after this.

label: Use Glarial's urn on the Chalice of Eternity (finish the dialogue)
Take the reward from the chalice (5 free inventory slots required)
Talk to Hetty (start Witch's Potion)
detail: South-east Rimmington. She needs a rat's tail, burnt meat, an eye of newt, and an onion.

label: Kill a level 1 rat for a rat's tail
detail: Archery shop west of Hetty's house. Rat's tail only drops once the quest is started; giant rats never drop it.

label: Burn a piece of meat (cook on Hetty's fireplace or purposely overcook)
detail: Kill a giant rat near the chapel graveyard or a cow south of Falador for raw meat; a player-lit fire also works.

label: Buy an eye of newt (Port Sarim magic shop)
Gather an onion
detail: Field north of Rimmington/east of Melzar's Maze, or Fred the Farmer's Lumbridge backyard.

label: Talk to Hetty (hand in all 4 ingredients, drink from the cauldron)
Search the bookcase for a battered book (Seers' Village)
detail: House immediately south-west of the Seers' Village bank; the bookcase is on the east wall.

label: Read the battered book (start Elemental Workshop I)
detail: Reveals the Fifth Age history of the ore and the sealed workshop.

label: Cut the battered book open with a knife or slash weapon
detail: A knife spawns in the house north of the church if none is carried. Produces a slashed book plus a battered key -- do not drop the slashed book, it is needed again at the end.

label: Enter the workshop (northern anvil-icon building)
detail: Enter the northern building with the anvil icon; use the key on the cracked wall and climb down the stairs into the workshop.

label: Turn the water controls and start the water wheel
detail: Turn the east water control first, then the west one, so both show green (order matters -- reset the west one if it was turned first), then pull the lever beside the wheel.

label: Repair the bellows with thread and leather
detail: Bellows are in the eastern chamber. Thread and leather spawn in crates (north-west of the central room, and the western room) if not carried; use both on the bellows (Crafting 20) then pull its lever to start it pumping.

label: Mine an elemental rock and kill the earth elemental it wakes
detail: West cavern (Mining 20 to attempt). The rock springs to life as a level-35 earth elemental on the mining attempt -- kill it and pick up the elemental ore it drops (the elementals already walking around do not count).

hints.note: Killing 2-3 extra earth elementals here banks spare elemental ore for Elemental Workshop II and a spare shield -- optional, not required for this quest alone.

label: Fill a stone bowl with lava and light the furnace
detail: Search the boxes north-east of the hatch for a stone bowl, fill it with lava from the trough in the southern chamber, then use the filled bowl on the furnace in the same chamber -- the inside should glow orange.

label: Smelt the elemental ore into elemental metal
detail: Use the elemental ore with 4 coal on the lit furnace (Smithing 20). Bring 4 more coal per extra shield you want to make now.

label: Smith the elemental shield on the workbench
detail: With the slashed book in your inventory, use the elemental metal on the central workbench (Smithing 20) -- quest complete. If the shield option is unavailable, destroy the slashed book and re-fetch a fresh one from the bookcase.

label: Search the Exam Centre bookcase for a beaten book
