detail: Level 84; only takes damage from ice arrows (or a throwing weapon with at least 1 ice arrow equipped, which bypasses the Ranged 40 requirement). Uses only Magic -- Protect from Magic recommended.

label: Talk to Winelda (pay the lava crossing)
detail: Give all 20 unnoted limpwurt roots at once -- she teleports the player across the lava.

label: Push the brick wall to reveal the hidden room
detail: Past the skeletons -- opens into the room where the choice is made.

label: Side with the Guardians of Armadyl
detail: Unequip the Pendant of Lucien first. Tell them Lucien wants the staff for a reward, accept their cleansing, then agree to help defeat Lucien -- given the Armadyl pendant (must be worn to fight him).

label: Side with Lucien
detail: Take the Staff of Armadyl from the north-west table -- a level 43 Guardian attacks; defeat it and take the staff. (Killing rather than talking to the Guardians preserves the option to still obtain the Armadyl pendant later.)

label: Defeat Lucien (Guardians' side)
detail: His house between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange, Armadyl pendant equipped -- level 14 -- quest complete.

label: Give the staff to Lucien (Lucien's side)
detail: His house between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange -- quest complete.

label: Search the tent and camping equipment (start)
detail: Campsite south of the lizardman settlement, Kebos Lowlands (fairy ring BLS closest). Search the tent for Kasonde's journal (Old Ones lore) and the camping equipment for secateurs if not already carried, then climb down the hole.

label: Search the camp dungeon's tablets, carvings and vase
detail: Stone tables (1st stone tablet), two more stone tables (2 wood carvings), one vase (a dirty note hinting at translation), and the stone chest (phrase 'Miki Toka').

label: Translate the camp dungeon's words
detail: Own-words: input the discovered word-pairs for island/lake/time/vessel/garden/north per the carvings' illustrations -- directs the player north, under the island on Lake Molch.

label: Travel to Molch Island
detail: Fairy ring DJR then south-west to the east dock, boat across; or Kharedst's memoirs to Shayzien and run north-west.

label: Search the Molch Island dungeon's tablets, carvings and vase
detail: Climb down behind the hut; a dirty note on the vines hints Kasonde returned to camp. Cut the vines with secateurs; search tables (2nd stone tablet), one more table (3rd wood carving), the east vases (4th wood carving + phrase 'Tlane Kualt'), the chest (phrase 'Olkat'), and rubble by the farming patches (5th wood carving).

label: Translate the Molch Island words
detail: Own-words: input the 8 discovered word-pairs (west/poison/animal/body/food/earth/air/fire) -- directs the player west of the lake, to Xeric's Shrine.

label: Travel to Xeric's Shrine
detail: Board the boat back to Molch, then south-west to Xeric's Shrine.

label: Search Xeric's Shrine dungeon's tablets, carvings and compass
detail: Climb down at the shrine's east side. South-east stone table (3rd stone tablet), the adjacent open chest (a compass giving the cardinal-direction words), a north vase, two more stone tables, and the central mushroom (4 more wood carvings).

label: Translate Xeric's Shrine words
detail: Own-words: input the 7 discovered word-pairs (build/yes/no/move/arrive/east/south) -- directs the player to a structure south-east, in a forest: the Ruins of Morra.

label: Travel to the Ruins of Morra
detail: Boat to Shayzien then south-east past the Shayziens' Wall, or teleport to Shayzien via Kharedst's memoirs and run south.

label: Search the Ruins of Morra dungeon's final tablet and carvings
detail: Hole in front of the step pyramid. Southern stone table (final stone tablet), remaining tables/vase/chest/rubble for the last wood carvings and a warning note.

label: Translate the final words and read the warning
detail: Own-words: input the final 8 word-pairs (small/big/light/dark/life/death/knowledge/home). Read the completed tablet, then the warning note revealing Kasonde reached the same conclusion about the Old Ones and soul transference -- quest complete.

label: Talk to Bert (start The Hand in the Sand)
detail: Bert works the sandpit east of the Yanille POH portal; found a severed hand and is afraid to report it. Agree to help -> receive sandy hand.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Buy a pint of beer
detail: Ye Olde Dragon Inn bartender, Yanille, 2 coins.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to the captain of the guards (give beer, hand)
detail: Ye Olde Dragon Inn; give the beer, he drops the sandy hand in it -> beer-soaked hand; suspects the wizards.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (Wizards' Guild)
detail: Ring the guild bell if under 66 Magic; show the hand -> identified as student wizard Clarence's; asks about Bert's recent working hours.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Bert (ask about his schedule)
detail: He gives his copy of the sand-hauling rota (Sandy's Sand Corp, Brimhaven) -> compare against Sandy's original in Brimhaven (30 coins via Ardougne ferry, or teleport).

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Search Sandy's desk (Brimhaven office)
detail: Sandy's office, north-west of the Dead Man's Chest bar, Brimhaven; search the desk for his original rota to compare against Bert's copy.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Pickpocket Sandy for sand
detail: Sandy's office, Brimhaven; keep the sand pinched from his pocket -- needed later as the personal item for the truth serum.

hints.note: May take multiple pickpocket attempts.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Bert (hand over both rotas)
detail: Yanille; give Bert's and Sandy's rotas -- he doesn't remember the change, blames wizard magic leaking nearby -> exchanges a mind-altering magic scroll found in his house.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (give the magic scroll)
detail: Confirms it's a mind-altering scroll explaining Bert's forgetting; suspects Sandy -- tasks the player with getting a truth serum from Betty in Port Sarim and recording Sandy with a magical orb. Offers one free teleport to Betty's shop for an empty vial.

hints.note: Zavistic offers one free teleport to Betty's shop in exchange for an empty vial.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Buy redberries (Food Store, Port Sarim)
detail: Port Sarim Food Store.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Betty (about the quest)
detail: Betty's shop, Port Sarim; explain the quest -- she asks for another empty vial and gives bottled water in return.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Make redberry juice
detail: Use redberries on the bottled water.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Make pink dye
detail: Use white berries on the redberry juice. White berries are not sold by Betty; source per the quest's own alternative list (Farming 59 whiteberry seed, or a rare drop from cave crawlers / Yanille Agility Dungeon chaos druid warriors) -- gather/produce only, never GE.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Make a rose-tinted lens
detail: Use pink dye on the lantern lens.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Betty (focus the lens)
detail: Stand in the doorway while it's open; use the rose-tinted lens on the counter to focus light onto an empty vial while she pours the serum. The lens shatters; she says she still needs a personal item from Sandy.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Betty (give Sandy's sand)
detail: Give the sand pickpocketed from Sandy earlier -- she finishes the truth serum and warns it must be diluted in tea or coffee.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Buy 5 earth runes from Betty
detail: 20gp from Betty's shop, before leaving Port Sarim.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Sandy (distract, dose his coffee)
detail: Sandy's office, Brimhaven; distract him with tall tales (try every dialogue option -- no single guaranteed one) until he looks out the window, then use the truth serum on his coffee. Activate the magical orb and talk to him again to record his confession.

hints.note: No single distraction option is guaranteed to work; cycle through them.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (show the recorded confession)
detail: Yanille; hand over the filled magical orb as proof of Sandy's confession. He asks for 5 earth runes and a bucket of sand to compensate Bert.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Fill a bucket of sand at Bert's sandpit
detail: Bert's sandpit, Yanille.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (give runes + sand)
detail: Hand over the 5 earth runes and bucket of sand -- he casts a spell to permanently refill Bert's sandpit, then asks the player to check the Entranan sandpit for the rest of Clarence's remains.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Deposit weapons/armour (Port Sarim bank deposit box)
detail: Entrana bans weapons and armour; use the deposit box at Port Sarim before crossing.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Mazion (Entrana sandpit)
detail: Entrana; recovers the dead wizard's head.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (hand over the wizard's head)
detail: Yanille; confirms it's Clarence's head. Sandy is arrested and Zavistic rewards the player -- quest complete.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Pirate Pete at the dock to start
detail: Pirate Pete waits at the dock north-east of the Ectofuntus; agree to help him, agree past his Barrelor warning, then refuse the money he offers before he knocks you out and rows you off.

label: Wake up and talk to Captain Braindeath
detail: A cutscene reveals Pete's story was fabricated; you wake in the rum brewery on Braindeath Island and Captain Braindeath explains the zombie-pirate siege and the rum plan.

label: Take the rake and seed dibber from the basement cupboard
detail: If not already held, go down the north-west ladder to the basement and head south-east past the spiders to a cupboard.

label: Intimidate zombie swabs blocking the farming patches
detail: Leave via the southernmost stairway; if attacked by zombie swabs, walk out of combat and right-click Intimidate to permanently stop them attacking.

label: Rake and plant the blindweed seed
detail: Use the rake on the only usable (south-eastern) patch to clear weeds, then plant Braindeath's seed with the dibber.

label: Harvest the grown blindweed
detail: Wait for the "I wonder how my blindweed is coming along..." notification, then harvest. If lost afterward, Braindeath supplies a backup.

label: Add blindweed to the hopper upstairs
detail: Climb the south-eastern ladder and use the blindweed on the north-western hopper.

label: Ask Braindeath for the next ingredient (stagnant water)
detail: He hands over a bucket if not already held and sends you to a nearby volcano.

label: Fill the bucket with stagnant water at the volcano
detail: Exit south then west past 50% Luke's gate (Ring of charos (a) or a tinderbox on him for optional dialogue) and up the volcano.

label: Pour the stagnant water into the hopper
detail: Return to the house and add the water to the hopper, then talk to Braindeath.

label: Catch 5 sluglings (or karamthulhu) at the nearby fishing spot
detail: Braindeath hands over a fishbowl tangled in a net (use them on each other if untangled). Fish at the spot by the farming patch.

label: Add the sluglings to the pressure barrel and pull the lever
detail: Upstairs next to the hopper; pulling the lever sets the brewing apparatus spinning.

label: Get the wrench blessed by Davey
detail: Former priest Davey, west side of the house, only blesses the wrench with 47+ available Prayer points (does not drain Prayer).

label: Beat the possessed controls and kill the Evil spirit
detail: Hit the controls south of Braindeath with the blessed wrench; a level-150 Evil spirit attacks — negate with Protect from Melee or a Ranged/Magic/halberd safespot.

label: Learn the final ingredient is a fever spider carcass
detail: Complete the full dialogue with Braindeath or the carcass will not drop from the kill.

label: Kill a fever spider in the basement for its carcass
detail: Fever spiders inflict disease even through Protect from Melee; negate with a safespot, Slayer gloves, or a cure such as Relicym's balm.

hints.value: Killing the fever spider also completes a medium Morytania Diary task.

label: Add the fever spider carcass to the hopper
detail: Finishes the rum recipe.

label: Collect the finished 'rum' from the output tap
detail: South end of the machinery; Braindeath supplies a bucket if not already held.

label: Give the 'rum' to Captain Donnie
detail: Found near the farming patches; he downs it and accidentally names his boss, Rabid Jack.

label: Report Rabid Jack's name to Braindeath to finish
detail: He is shocked, then thanks you and confirms the brewery stays put.

label: Slice a banana into Karamjan rum
detail: Pick a banana at the Musa Point plantation, buy Karamjan rum at the Karamja Spirits Bar, slice the banana with a knife/spear, then add the slice to the rum before leaving the island (leaving unslied breaks it).

label: Talk to Timfraku to start the quest
detail: Upstairs in the north-west house of Tai Bwo Wannai (fairy ring CKR); mention Trufitus sent you, then ask "So far??" to receive the task of reuniting his three sons.

label: Ask Tamayu about the Shaikahan
detail: South-east of the village at the mine; talk twice, asking when he'll succeed and offering to join his next hunt. A cutscene shows him failing against The Shaikahan.

label: Net-fish 20+ raw karambwanji at the Holy Lake
detail: South-west of Tamayu; keep a few spares in case of a low Cooking level burning the karambwan later.

label: Become Lubufu's karambwan apprentice
detail: By the south-eastern Brimhaven shore; ask his age, offer to help collect bait, catch and hand over 20 karambwanji, then ask about his catching method and become his apprentice to unlock the karambwan vessel and 65-Fishing raw karambwan catching (1500 Fishing xp).

hints.value: Collect extra vessels here (drop and re-ask Lubufu) — one each for Tiadeche, Tinsay, and yourself.

label: Give Tiadeche a full karambwan vessel
detail: North-east corner of the Karamja jungle (fairy ring DKP); fill a vessel with karambwanji first, then hand it over for a raw karambwan (vessel is not returned).

label: Grab seaweed on the beach near Tiadeche
detail: Spawns on the beach by Tiadeche; needed later for Tinsay's seaweed sandwich.

label: Cook the karambwan and grind it into paste
detail: Cook the raw karambwan into a poison karambwan, then grind it with a pestle and mortar into karambwan paste (use the "use" option, not eat, to avoid damage).

label: Poison the spear with karambwan paste
detail: Any of iron/steel/mithril/adamant/rune/dragon spear works; do NOT give it to Tamayu before poisoning it.

label: Get jogre bones on the way back to Tamayu
detail: Kill a Jogre en route back south (also a fallback source for an iron spear if none carried).

label: Give Tamayu the poisoned spear and 4-dose agility potion
detail: Cross the agility shortcut back to the mine; use the poisoned spear then a full 4-dose agility potion on him (can be topped up over multiple potions), then join his hunt for a successful cutscene.

label: Kill a monkey and have Tamayu skin it
detail: Ranged/Magic/halberd only (melee does 0 damage); use the corpse on Tamayu to skin it and keep the monkey skin (saves a Tinsay trip later).

label: Climb to Cairn Isle and talk to Tinsay
detail: Up the rockslide (Agility 15) and across the bridge; he asks for three items to regain his sanity and repair the Tribal Statue.

label: Give Tinsay the banana rum
detail: First of his three requests.

label: Make and deliver a seaweed sandwich
detail: Combine the seaweed and monkey skin into a seaweed sandwich (do not combine before skinning, or it becomes a joke item), then give it to Tinsay.

label: Give Tinsay a spare karambwan vessel
detail: Unlocks the Crafting manual for Tiadeche (he won't hand it over until the sandwich is delivered).

label: Burn, grind, paste, and cook jogre bones into marinated bones
detail: Burn jogre bones on a tinderbox (Firemaking 30+) or a furnace/Superheat Item if lower; grind a raw karambwanji into paste and add it to the burnt bones; cook the result on a range or fire until green (white means it was done in the wrong order).

label: Give Tinsay the marinated jogre bones
detail: His third request; he regains his sanity and agrees to return to the village.

label: Bring the Crafting manual back to Tiadeche
detail: Both brothers then head back to Tai Bwo Wannai.

label: Talk to Timfraku to finish the quest
detail: Same north-west house; completes the quest. Afterward, talk to each brother in their village house to claim their individual xp rewards.

label: Talk to Rantz to start the quest
detail: Rantz the ogre is south-east of Gu'Tanoth (Fairy ring AKS, Feldip Hills teleport, or gnome glider). The quest must be started by talking to him first, and he only accepts arrows you make yourself.

label: Kill 4 level-64 wolves for wolf bones
detail: In the crater south-west of Rantz; safespottable near the north-east swamp roots.

label: Chisel the wolf bones into wolfbone arrowtips
detail: Each bone yields 2-6 tips at random.

label: Chop 4 achey trees for logs
detail: Growing near Rantz.

label: Knife the achey logs into ogre arrow shafts
Feather the shafts into flighted ogre arrows
Attach wolfbone arrowtips to the flighted arrows
detail: Finishes at least 6 usable ogre arrows for the hand-in.

label: Hand at least 6 ogre arrows to Rantz
detail: He explains the swamp toads his children play with; ask him every listed question or the chest cannot be opened later.

hints.value: Ask every dialogue option offered, not just the minimum — required to open the chest later.

label: Enter the cave and talk to Fycie and Bugs
detail: North of Rantz; they explain their ogre bellows are locked in a rock-weighted chest.

label: Unlock the chest and search it for the bellows
detail: Failed unlock attempts reduce Strength by 1; search immediately after opening or it re-locks.

hints.value: Keep the bellows afterward if planning Mourning's End Part I and/or Recipe for Disaster.

label: Inflate 3 swamp toads into bloated toads
detail: South-west of Rantz at the swamp (also findable near poison spiders in the Yanille Agility dungeon); the bellows hold 3 charges before needing a refill at the swamp bubbles.

hints.value: Carrying capacity for bloated toads is 3 — inflating more replaces one already held.

label: Return to Rantz to learn the lure spot
detail: He shows the flashing arrow tile where toads should be dropped to lure a chompy bird.

label: Offer to shoot for Rantz and receive the ogre bow
detail: After his first miss (he blames the arrows), offer to help; he hands over his ogre bow.

label: Lure and kill a chompy bird with the ogre bow
detail: Drop a bloated toad on the marked tile and stand back but in view; range the bird once it appears (re-bait if the lure fails). You must land the kill yourself — a bought/traded raw chompy will not progress the quest.

hints.value: Purchasing a raw chompy bird instead of killing one yourself will NOT progress the quest — confirmed on the quest's own page, not a real GE-alternative.

label: Pluck the chompy and bring it back to Rantz
detail: He asks for it cooked with a seasoning of his children's choosing.

label: Ask Fycie and Bugs what seasoning they want
detail: Two of three needed ingredients (onion, doogle leaves, equa leaves, tomato, potato, cabbage) are randomised per player; only one bird is cooked.

label: Gather the 3 requested seasoning ingredients around the area
detail: Onion/tomato near the fire west-south-west of Rantz; doogle leaves to the west by the glider; equa leaves on the south-east peninsula; potato south-east near the equa spawns; cabbage scattered south-west/south-east — pick another plant if a seed drops instead.

label: Cook the chompy with all 3 seasonings on the spit
detail: North of Rantz; hold all three ingredients plus the raw chompy.

label: Present the seasoned chompy to Rantz to finish
detail: Completes the quest.

label: Ask Grish about the sick ogres
detail: Speak with Grish in Jiggig and offer to help investigate the zombified ogres.

hints.value: What do you mean sickies? -> Can I help in any way? -> Yes.

label: Get the ogre guard to remove the barricade
detail: Speak to the Ogre guard east of Grish so he clears the way into the Zogre-infested area.

label: Climb the barricade and descend into the cave
detail: Climb over the crushed barricade, run east to the stairs, and go down them.

label: Search the skeleton and defeat the zombie it spawns
detail: Search the skeleton next to the broken lecturn; a zombie appears and must be killed to get the ruined backpack.

hints.value: Under 89 combat, Zogre/Skogre attacks from here on can cause disease that lowers a random skill 10 levels roughly every minute -- carry super restore potions.

label: Open the ruined backpack
detail: Open the backpack to obtain a Dragon inn tankard, rotten food, and a knife.

label: Search the broken lecturn for the torn page
detail: Search the broken lecturn and keep the torn page it holds.

label: Cut open the coffin and search it for the black prism
detail: Use the knife on the coffin west of the skeleton, then search it (may take a few tries) for the black prism.

label: Show the tankard to the Yanille bartender
detail: Go to the Dragon Inn in Yanille and use the Dragon inn tankard on the bartender to begin identifying its owner.

label: Speak to Zavistic Rarve at the Wizards' Guild
detail: Find Zavistic Rarve inside the Wizards' Guild in Yanille (ring the bell out front if you lack the level to enter).

hints.value: I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres (only if Hand in the Sand already started)

label: Speak to the bedridden Sithik Ints
detail: Sithik is bedridden in the upstairs bedroom of the guest house north of the Wizards' Guild; ask to look around his room.

hints.value: Do you mind if I look around?

label: Search Sithik's drawers, cupboard, and wardrobe
detail: Search all three pieces of furniture in the room for a portraiture book, necromancy book, papyrus, charcoal, and a Book of H.A.M.

hints.value: More papyrus can be found here if a re-sketch is needed later.

label: Read all three found books
detail: Read the portraiture book, necromancy book, and Book of H.A.M before acting on them.

label: Use all three books on Sithik
detail: Use the portraiture book, necromancy book, and Book of H.A.M on Sithik in turn.

label: Use papyrus on Sithik to sketch his portrait
detail: Use papyrus on Sithik to sketch a portrait whose examine text must read a classic realist charcoal portrait of Sithik.

hints.value: A low Crafting level (1-10) reduces the odds of sketching a correct portrait on the first try; 20+ Crafting is recommended to speed this up -- soft speed factor, not a hard requirement.

label: Show the sketched portrait to Sithik
detail: Use the portrait on Sithik; he must appreciate its honesty, not just its truth.

label: Return to the Dragon Inn
detail: Head back to the Dragon Inn in Yanille to get the portrait signed.

label: Have the bartender sign the portrait
detail: Use the tankard then the portrait on the bartender; he signs the portrait as an affidavit.

label: Return to the Wizards' Guild
detail: Head back to Zavistic Rarve at the Wizards' Guild with the evidence in hand.

label: Present the evidence to Zavistic Rarve
detail: Speak to Zavistic Rarve while holding the necromancy book, Book of H.A.M, the tankard, and the signed portrait to receive a strange potion.

hints.value: I have some items that I'd like you to look at.
Text doesn't explicitly say whether the 4 items are truly consumed here vs merely checked -- modeled as consumed.

label: Spike Sithik's tea
detail: Use the strange potion on the cup of tea on top of Sithik's drawers.

label: Reset Sithik's dialogue by leaving and returning
detail: Go downstairs then back upstairs so Sithik has drunk the spiked tea before you talk to him.

label: Get the three secrets out of Sithik
detail: Question Sithik for the cures to the disease, the removal of the undead ogres, and the effects of the spell -- needed for Relicym's balm and Brutal arrows.

hints.value: How do I remove the effects of the spell from the area? / How do I get rid of the undead ogres / How do I get rid of the disease / Sorry, I have to go.

label: Report the culprit to Grish
detail: Tell Grish you found who's responsible for the Zogres; he gives you an ogre gate key for the ceremonial chamber.

hints.value: I found who's responsible for the Zogres being here.

label: Learn to equip a composite ogre bow
detail: Ask Grish about an easier way to kill Zogres to learn how to equip composite ogre bows.

label: Chop an achey tree for logs
detail: Optional: cut an achey tree for logs to make a composite ogre bow instead of relying on Crumble Undead.

hints.value: Optional side-path; not required to finish the quest.

label: Make an unstrung comp bow
detail: Use a knife on the achey tree logs with wolf bones in your inventory and select box 2 to create an unstrung comp bow.

label: String the composite ogre bow
detail: String the unstrung bow with a bow string to finish it.

label: Brew Relicym's balm
detail: Optional: add a Rogue's purse to a vial of water then add snake weed to brew Relicym's balm; not needed for the quest itself but unlocks purchasing more from Uglug Nar.

hints.value: ge_violation: page also lists 'buy one from the Grand Exchange' as an alternative -- excluded per the never-GE-buy hard rule; only the gather/produce path is modeled.

label: Cut achey trees for arrow logs
detail: Optional: cut achey trees for logs to fletch brutal arrows instead of buying them.

hints.value: ge_violation: page also says 'if you have access to the Grand Exchange, just buy the arrows and skip this section' -- excluded per the never-GE-buy hard rule.

label: Fletch the logs into ogre arrow shafts
detail: Fletch the achey tree logs with a knife into ogre arrow shafts.

label: Add feathers to the arrow shafts
detail: Add feathers to the ogre arrow shafts to make flighted ogre arrows.

label: Nail the flighted arrows into brutal arrows
detail: With a hammer in your inventory, use nails on the flighted ogre arrows to finish them.

label: Head to the ceremonial chamber
detail: Return to Jiggig, travel west through both sets of doors, then go down the stairs.

label: Search the stand at the end of the chamber
detail: Follow the chamber to its end and search the stand to approach Slash Bash.

hints.value: No item result is stated for this search -- treated as a pure trigger.

label: Kill Slash Bash
detail: Fight the level-111 Slash Bash, who uses both Ranged and Melee; safe-spot with Protect from Missiles or use Crumble Undead.

label: Return to Grish to finish
detail: Report Slash Bash's defeat to Grish to complete the quest.

label: Search the shelf in the SW ruined house to start
detail: Also search the smashed table in the same building for 2 free tarromin + a Rogue's purse (keep the purse for Zogre Flesh Eaters); a spare vial spawn is here too.

label: Brew 2 doses of Serum 207
detail: Use tarromin on a vial of water to make tarromin potion (unf) if not already carried, then add ashes to finish. Make two doses.

hints.value: Serum 207 can be bought on the GE, but at least one dose must be player-made for this quest step to register — gather/produce path modeled, GE not used.

label: Use Serum 207 on Razmire Keelgan and learn about the shades
detail: In the general store; he explains the shades are restless spirits and asks for 5 Loar Shade remains.

label: Kill 5 level-40 Loar Shades for their remains
detail: Kills only count toward the task once Razmire has asked for them; remains come from the kill itself.

label: Give Razmire 2 shade remains
detail: Use Serum 207 on him again, then he takes 2 remains for experiments and mentions Ulsquire Shauncy.

label: Buy olive oil and temple building materials from Razmire's stores
detail: General store: olive oil. Builders' store (Razmire opens it): timber beam, limestone brick, swamp paste (Flamtaer hammer optional, ~13,000gp, highly recommended if the minigame is unpopulated).

label: Cure Ulsquire Shauncy and learn about the temple
detail: House south-east of Razmire's; give a Serum 207 dose then a shade remain, then ask both "What did you find out about the remains?" and "What can you tell me about that temple?" (both required or the temple can't be interacted with).

label: Repair the temple to full and light the sacred flame
detail: Minigame on the island NE of the general store: use a hammer/Flamtaer hammer and building materials to repair the walls (Crafting 20); sanctity accrues from repairing/reinforcing or killing Loar Shades. World 377 is the dedicated minigame world if solo repair is too slow.

label: Pour olive oil on the sacred flame for sacred oil
detail: Requires at least 10% Sanctity from the temple repair.

label: Dip the remaining Serum 207 in the flame for Serum 208
detail: Optional but highly recommended (permanently cures Razmire/Ulsquire); needs 20%+ Sanctity.

label: Cut a dead tree for logs if none carried
detail: Near the funeral pyres, west of the general store.

label: Combine sacred oil with logs into a pyre log
Light the pyre log with the shade remains on a funeral pyre
detail: Use the pyre log then the remaining loar shade remains on one of the stone-pillar funeral pyres, then light it (25 Prayer xp) and collect the reward from the pillar.

label: Talk to Ulsquire to finish (re-serum him if needed)
detail: Use a Serum 207/208 dose first if he has reverted to being afflicted, then speak to him to complete the quest.

label: Talk to an Examiner and fail the first exam
detail: At the Exam Centre south of the Digsite; ask about taking an exam for an unstamped letter, then get the letter sealed by Curator Haig Halen at Varrock Museum before retrying — any answer fails the first attempt, prompting you to consult the students.

label: Get the letter sealed by Curator Haig Halen
detail: Varrock Museum, east side of the city.

label: Search the hilltop bush for the missing teddy bear
detail: North of the Exam Centre, east walkway, easternmost bush by the large blue urn.

label: Pan the river for the special cup
detail: Take a panning tray from the tent table, use a cup of tea on the panning guide, then pan the river east of the tent.

hints.value: Panning has a small chance to also yield an uncut opal, needed later for the level-3 exam — keep it if received here.

label: Pickpocket Digsite workmen for the animal skull
detail: Repeat until the skull drops.

hints.value: A specimen brush needed later can also drop from these pickpockets — keep it if received here.

label: Deliver the teddy, cup, and skull to the three lost-item students
detail: Blonde/green-shirt student (animal skull) north of the tent; orange-shirt student (special cup) further north-east; purple-clothed female student (teddy bear) north-west — talk to each twice.

label: Retake the exam for the Level 1 certificate
detail: Re-ask each student for their answer, then answer the Examiner's 3 questions correctly.

label: Retake the exam for the Level 2 certificate
detail: Re-consult all three students for the new round of answers first.

label: Give the female student an opal for the Level 3 answer
detail: She additionally demands an opal/uncut opal this round; pan the river again if none is held, hand it over across two conversations.

label: Retake the exam for the Level 3 certificate
detail: Consult all three students once more, then answer correctly for full digging permission.

hints.value: Certificates can later be exchanged with the Museum Curator for a chocolate cake (Desert Treasure I) or fruit blast (Recipe for Disaster) — keep at least the Level 3 certificate for that.

label: Take a specimen jar from the Exam Centre cupboard
detail: South wall inside the Exam Centre; speak to Terry Balando about the tools first if there's no search option.

label: Dig a level-3 site with the trowel for the ancient talisman
detail: South-westernmost or northernmost level-3 dig site; can take several minutes of repeated attempts.

label: Bring the talisman to Terry Balando
detail: He identifies it as a talisman of Zaros and grants an invitation letter for the private dig shafts.

label: Show the invitation letter to a workman by the west winch
detail: Must be the pickpocketable 'Digsite workman' near a winch, not the plain 'Dig site workman'.

label: Rope down the west winch into the sublevels
detail: Requires Agility 15 to operate; grab an arcenia root just north of the rope landing and search the bricks blocking the south-east path.

label: Rope down the north-east winch and talk to Doug Deeping
detail: Ask how to move the rock pile blocking the way; he hands over a chest key.

label: Unlock the chest in the panning tent for chemical powder
Open the centre barrel with the trowel and fill a vial
detail: Deals 25 non-fatal damage and breaks the vial if dropped after filling — do not drop it.

label: Get charcoal if not already carried
detail: Search the specimen tray north of the tent with a specimen jar held, if charcoal was not brought.

label: Have Terry Balando identify the powder and liquid
detail: Use the chemical powder on him (ammonium nitrate), then the unidentified liquid (nitroglycerin) without dropping/emptying it; read the Book on chemicals on a nearby bookshelf first if he won't identify it.

label: Combine powder, liquid, charcoal, and root into a chemical compound
detail: Ammonium nitrate + nitroglycerin -> mixed chemicals (Herblore 6); grind charcoal with pestle and mortar -> ground charcoal; add ground charcoal to mixed chemicals (Herblore 8); add arcenia root to finish (Herblore 10). Dropping the finished compound deals 65 non-fatal damage.

label: Blast the bricks open and enter the chamber
detail: Down the western winch: use the chemical compound on the bricks, then a tinderbox to detonate; watch for level-22 skeletons if under 45 Combat.

label: Pick up the stone tablet in the exposed chamber
Hand the stone tablet to Terry Balando to finish
detail: He remarks on the Saradomin cover-up of the Zaros altar and rewards 2 gold bars.

label: Climb the Watchtower trellis and talk to the wizard
detail: Climb the trellis (Agility 18) on the north side of the Watchtower, north-west of Yanille, then the ladder. The wizard explains the tower's ogre-repelling spell has failed because its power crystals were stolen.

label: Search the north-west bush for Skavid fingernails
detail: Other bushes yield red-herring items only (old robe, unusual armour, damaged dagger, tattered eye patch).

label: Show the wizard the fingernails to learn about the relic
detail: He identifies them as Skavid and explains the ogres stole 4 power crystals; you'll need pieces of an ogre relic from three tribe chieftains to enter the ogre city.

label: Talk to Og at the north-west ogre tribe
detail: Through Yanille's west gate or the agility shortcut, bank first for armour/food/2 ropes/1 dragon bones. Og's nemesis Toban stole his gold bar; he gives you a key to Toban's chest.

label: Rope-swing to Grew's island south of Og
detail: Long-branched tree on the west shore; the rope is lost on the swing. Grab jangerberries on the island for later.

label: Talk to Grew about his enemy Gorad
detail: He asks you to knock a tooth out of Gorad on the third island.

label: Kill Gorad for a tooth
detail: Level-68 chieftain, south of the ladder on Toban's island (reached via the Skavid caves x4 without a map, or around Gu'Tanoth's south edge, then west through a rock hole past a death rune spawn). Safespottable in the island centre for Ranged/Magic.

label: Give Toban dragon bones for the third relic piece
detail: Baby dragon bones do not work; do not bury them.

label: Open Toban's chest for Og's stolen gold bar
detail: A second rope spawns near the roots south-west of the island's ladder if needed for the swing back.

label: Give Grew the tooth for the second relic piece and the yellow crystal
detail: Rope-swing back to Grew's island; pick jangerberries first if not already held.

label: Give Og his gold bar for the final relic piece
Return the 3 relic pieces to the wizard to assemble the Ogre relic
detail: Pick up a candle from the ground-floor spawn if a light source is still needed.

label: Show the assembled relic to the Ogre guards for entry
detail: North-west trail split into Gu'Tanoth; the relic must be shown via dialogue, not used directly on them.

label: Steal a rock cake from the market food stall
detail: Southern stall in the ogre market; do not left-click (eats it, forcing a re-steal).

label: Buy a pestle and mortar and vial from Grud if needed
detail: Non-aggressive ogre merchant in the market; ~7 coins total.

label: Say you're a friend and hand over the rock cake at the second gate
detail: First dialogue option only, or the guard knocks you out of the area; use (not eat) the rock cake on him.

label: Jump the broken bridge gap and pay the toll
detail: Agility 25 to jump; the guards then ask for 20 coins to let you cross. Grab the knife spawn here for cutting webs later.

label: Solve the city guards' word puzzle with the death rune
detail: The answer is 'death rune'; hand over the death rune picked up earlier south of the rock hole.

label: Learn the Skavid language from the Scared skavid (cave 1)
detail: East of Gu'Tanoth along the south-east branch; promise not to hurt it.

label: Give the correct response to each of the 4 regular Skavids
detail: Cave 2 (NE, main path): "Bidith tanath." -> "Cur." Cave 3 (N, path opening): "Gor cur..." -> "Ar." Cave 4 (N, south of west Yanille gate): "Cur Bidith." -> "Ig." (take 2 Cave nightshade here). Cave 5 (E, east side of the mountain): "Tanath gor." -> "Nod."

label: Return to the Scared skavid to be declared ready for the Mad skavid
Use the gold bar on a guard to reach the Mad skavid's cave
detail: South of the Scared skavid cave along the south-east entrance path; go south and west across a bridge into cave 6.

label: Answer the Mad skavid's randomised word-repeat challenge
detail: One randomised opening line from a fixed 8-line/8-response table (e.g. 'Ar cur'->'Gor', 'Bidith ig'->'Cur', 'Gor nod'->'Tanath', 'Cur tanath'->'Bidith', 'Bidith tanath'->'Cur', 'Tanath gor'->'Nod', 'Cur bidith'->'Ig', 'Gor cur'->'Ar') read directly off the source page's own table; answering correctly grants the magenta crystal. If short on cave nightshade, 2 more spawn just inside.

hints.value: Do not eat the cave nightshade — it damages you; the hole in the corner is a shortcut back to Yanille.

label: Use a nightshade on an Ogre Enclave guard to enter
detail: West cave entrance in the Gu'Tanoth market; talking to the guards directly triggers an attack instead. 'Use'/'eat' options are swapped for nightshade here — do not eat it, and complete the full dialogue or the nightshade is wasted.

label: Run past the shamans and blue dragons to the north-east exit
detail: A cutscene shows an Ogre shaman and Blue dragon; do not talk to or attack shamans (20-30 damage instantly). Exits near a northern Skavid cave facing Yanille.

label: Kill a giant bat behind the webbed house for bat bones
detail: House east of the Watchtower with a web-covered entrance; cut through with a slashing weapon/knife.

label: Brew and enchant the magic ogre potion with the wizard
detail: Order matters: guam leaf + vial of water -> guam potion (unf); add jangerberries (do not left-click-eat them; they respawn on Grew's island if lost); grind bat bones with pestle and mortar then add; hand the finished potion to the wizard to enchant it.

label: Use the second nightshade on a guard to re-enter the Enclave
detail: Bring pickaxe, anti-dragon/dragonfire shield, food. Same use/eat-swapped, dialogue-must-complete rule as the first entry.

label: Use the magic ogre potion on all 6 ogre shamans
detail: Instantly kills each shaman with no damage taken; the last one drops the cyan crystal automatically into your inventory. If lost, a Shaman robe in the SE corner can be searched for a replacement.

label: Mine the Rock of Dalgroth for the last crystal
detail: Centre of the Enclave; only mineable after the shamans are dead. Mine (not prospect) before leaving, or fresh nightshades are needed to return.

label: Place all 4 crystals and pull the lever to finish
detail: Leave via the north-east exit (or a Nightmare Zone teleport); yellow crystal in the south-west pillar, grey in the south-east, cyan in the north-west, magenta in the north-east, then pull the west-side lever. Do not drop anything before pulling the lever or it is lost permanently in the instance.

label: Bank: withdraw banked big bones
detail: Withdraw big bones banked from earlier combat bands (Hill Giants always drop them); top up from a non-GE bone vendor if stock is short (vendor ??).

label: Bury big bones until Prayer 43
detail: Manual bone burial -- no location requirement. Gilded altar (350% bonus) needs Construction 75, not assumed available this early; flagged as a later-route upgrade, not this band's default.

hints.note: Bone supply depends on earlier combat-band drop rates.
Construction 75 unlocks a much faster offering rate -- revisit this band once available.

label: Bank: withdraw dragon bones
detail: Withdraw banked dragon bones (gathered non-GE, see next atom).

label: Kill green dragons for dragon bones (non-GE)
detail: Green dragons (Wilderness, combat 79) drop Dragon bones 100% of the time, per the monster's own drop table -- shares the exact same kill activity as train-crafting-54's dragonhide gather earlier in this segment (both drops fire from one kill).

hints.note: Wilderness PK risk -- hop if contested or under threat.

label: Offer dragon bones at a player-owned house gilded altar
detail: Best xp/hr (643,000) of the row's own 3 methods, but gated behind Construction 75 for the altar itself.

label: Offer dragon bones at the Chaos Temple altar (Wilderness)
detail: Level 38 Wilderness, multi-combat, PK risk -- no Construction requirement. Highest raw xp/hr (860,000) of the 3 methods.

hints.note: Wilderness multi-combat PK risk -- hop if contested.

label: Reanimate ensouled heads near the Dark Altar (Arceuus)
detail: No Construction requirement -- the safe fallback for an account without a gilded altar yet. Fairy ring code CIS per the row's own method.

label: Walk to the Survival Expert
detail: Exit the starting house through the door and left-click a tile on the ground toward the Survival Expert -- U6 zone transition inside Tutorial Island's first building cluster, no toll/rune/charge cost and no transport alternative (single mandatory walking path, so no teleport-choice hint or branch{} applies).

label: Bank: withdraw dragon bones + food
detail: Dragon bones (own-farmed from earlier dragon/wyvern kills, source ??, never bought) + food ??x for the Wilderness trip.

label: Go to the Chaos Temple altar (level 38 Wilderness)
detail: Multi-combat area, player-killer risk. Coordinates not pinned by the fetched section -- left ??.

hints.note: PK risk in the Wilderness; the gilded altar alt (player-owned house, Construction 75, 643,000 xp/h) avoids this entirely but is gated on a Construction level not assumed reached here.

label: Offer dragon bones at the Chaos Temple altar until Prayer 74
detail: 860,000 xp/h per Pay-to-play_Prayer_training.s14 -- the highest-rate altar option with no skill/quest gate, at the cost of Wilderness PK exposure.

label: Obtain a silver bar
detail: Buy a silver bar from the Silver merchant in Ardougne (an NPC shop, not the Grand Exchange) — the quest's own item note names this as the sanctioned non-GE source.

label: Obtain a sickle mould
detail: Buy a sickle mould from an NPC crafting-supplies shop (e.g. Rommik's Crafty Supplies in Rimmington).

label: Smith the silver sickle
detail: Use the silver bar with the sickle mould at any furnace (Crafting 18, boostable) to smith a silver sickle for 50 Crafting XP.

label: Ask Drezel about Filliman Tarlock
detail: Talk to Drezel in the Paterdomus basement and accept his request to find the druid Filliman Tarlock in Mort Myre Swamp; he hands over three meat pies and three apple pies for the ghost.

hints.note: Well, what is it, I may be able to help? -> Yes -> I'd better get going.

label: Travel to the Nature Grotto
detail: Leave the temple and run south through Mort Myre Swamp to the Nature Grotto north-west of Mort'ton. You must enter the swamp through the gate or Filliman never appears.

label: Meet the ghost Filliman Tarlock
detail: Attempt to enter the grotto to make Filliman appear; wear the ghostspeak amulet and ask how long he's been a ghost. He vanishes if you stop interacting with him, so keep talking.

hints.note: How long have you been a ghost?

label: Find the mirror under the washing bowl
detail: Take the washing bowl off the nearby bench to find a mirror underneath it.

label: Show Filliman the mirror
detail: Use the mirror on Filliman; he realises he's a ghost and asks you to find his journal (if using it does nothing, talk to him again first).

label: Retrieve Filliman's journal
detail: Search (right-click) the grotto tree to find Filliman's journal, then use it on him to return it; he teaches you a druidic spell.

label: Ask Drezel for a blessing
detail: Run back to Drezel and ask him to bless you. (UIM note: if Wolfbane was discarded, take the replacement dagger first, then speak to him.)

label: Cast the druidic spell on a rotting log
detail: Enter the swamp, stand next to a rotting log, and cast the druidic spell Filliman taught you.

label: Pick the mushroom from the log
detail: Quickly pick the mushroom that grows from the log after the spell is cast, then bring it back to Filliman's camp.

label: Solve the three-stone puzzle
detail: Make sure Filliman is standing outside between all three stones. Use the mushroom on the light-brown stone, the used spell card on the grey stone, then stand on the orange stone and tell him you've solved the puzzle.

hints.note: I think I've solved the puzzle!

label: Give the nature spirit your sickle
detail: Enter the hole under the tree, search the grotto in the middle of the cave, then give the nature spirit your silver sickle by talking to him; he blesses it and hands you a druid pouch.

label: Fill the druid pouch with swamp plants
detail: Leave the grotto and stand next to rotting logs, bushes, or branches in the swamp. Use the silver sickle (b)'s Bloom ability (costs prayer points) to harvest fungi/saplings/pears and fill the druid pouch.

label: Kill three Ghasts
detail: Use your filled druid pouch on a Ghast to make it attackable, then kill three of them (level 30 each).

label: Complete the grotto restoration
detail: Return to the nature spirit via the grotto in the cave; he redecorates the grotto and the quest completes. If aiming for the Morytania Diary, pray at the altar here first.

label: Ask the Warrior about Zanaris
detail: Speak to the Warrior camped north-west of Lumbridge Swamp and ask what he's guarding and who Zanaris is.

hints.note: What are you camped here for? -> Who's Zanaris? -> If it's hidden how are you planning to find it? -> Looks like you don't know either.

label: Chop (don't chop down) the nearby tree
detail: Go to the tree closest to the Warrior's encampment and right-click it, choosing the 'chop' option rather than 'chop down'. This makes Shamus appear.

label: Speak to Shamus
detail: Talk to Shamus about how the camp fits in a shed.

hints.note: How does it fit in a shed then?

label: Bank weapons and armour before Entrana
detail: Deposit all weapons and armour at a bank (jewellery such as a ring of dueling, amulet of glory, or combat bracelet is allowed) — Entrana's monks confiscate anything else. Optionally buy a chronicle from Diango and charge it with teleport cards if you lack a teleport to Entrana (not required, just convenient for repeat trips).

label: Travel to the Port Sarim docks
detail: Head to the Port Sarim docks, south of the Rusty Anchor Inn.

label: Sail to Entrana
detail: Talk to a Monk of Entrana at the docks to travel to the island.

label: Reach the cave on Entrana
detail: Cross the north-east bridge, go west to find the Cave monk, then go down the ladder. Do not craft a battlestaff or bow before entering the cave, or the monks will knock you out and send you back to Port Sarim.

label: Farm zombies for a bronze axe
detail: Kill zombies in the cave until one drops a bronze axe (roughly 40% drop chance per kill, so exact kill count is "??"). Two level-92 Greater Demons occupy the room before the Dramen tree — be careful.

label: Reach the Dramen tree
detail: Go south-east past the Greater Demons and attempt to chop the Dramen tree. Caution: the nearby magical door teleports you into level-32 Wilderness.

label: Defeat the Dramen Tree Spirit
detail: Chopping the tree summons the Dramen Tree Spirit; kill it (there's a safespot behind the southern fungus formation). Do not use the mushroom near the demons as a safespot — even after killing the spirit once, it respawns the next time you try to chop.

label: Chop dramen branches
detail: Chop the now-unguarded Dramen tree with the bronze axe. Cutting at least three branches is recommended — spares are useful later for the Freeing Sir Amik Varze RFD subquest and for smuggling into Thorvald's trial in the Fremennik Trials — but don't make them into staves yet.

label: Carve a dramen staff
detail: Use a knife on a dramen branch to make a dramen staff.

label: Return to the Lumbridge Swamp tool shed
detail: Teleport out of the cave, then travel to the tool shed in the centre of Lumbridge Swamp.

label: Enter Zanaris
detail: Wield the dramen staff and enter the tool shed — it opens onto Zanaris and completes the quest.

label: Go to Phileas Rimor's house
detail: Head to the house west of the Cloak and Stagger tavern in Shayzien (from Xeric's Talisman - Xeric's Lookout, run north-west; fairy ring code DJR also reaches Shayzien).

label: Agree to help Phileas Rimor
detail: Speak to Phileas Rimor and agree to help with his investigation.

hints.note: Do you need help with anything? -> Yes.

label: Ready a ranged, melee, and magic loadout
detail: Make sure you're carrying a ranged weapon, a melee weapon (a pickaxe counts), and runes for a magic attack — needed for the Tower of Magic puzzle ahead. Own combat gear, not a quest-specific item to source.

label: Travel to the Arceuus Library
detail: Travel to the Arceuus Library via fairy ring code CIS or the Lovakengj Minecart Network.

label: Ask Archeio for the Historical Archive
detail: Speak to Archeio, who teleports you to the Library Historical Archive.

label: Ask Pagida about King Shayzien VII
detail: Speak to Pagida, ask about King Shayzien VII, and agree to be teleported into the Tower of Magic prison.

hints.note: I have a question about King Shayzien VII. -> Yes please.

label: Push the device and attack with magic
detail: Push the strange device all the way west, then attack it with magic from the north side.

label: Attack the device with melee
detail: From the south side, attack the device using melee. Make sure NPC attack options aren't set to hidden or the option won't appear.

label: Push the device east and attack with ranged
detail: Push the device all the way east, then from the south side attack it using ranged.

label: Investigate the skeleton
detail: Investigate the skeleton in the northern cell.

label: Report back to Phileas Rimor
detail: Return to the quest start and talk to Phileas Rimor again (Xeric's Talisman - Xeric's Lookout, run north-west).

label: Head to the War Tent
detail: Go north-west to the War Tent in the south-west corner of the Shayzien Encampment and climb upstairs.

label: Speak to Lord Shiro Shayzien
detail: Speak to Lord Shiro Shayzien upstairs in the War Tent.

label: Travel to Mount Quidamortem's summit
detail: Travel to the summit of Mount Quidamortem via the Lovakengj Minecart Network, Xeric's Talisman (Xeric's Honour, if unlocked), or fairy ring code BLS (if unlocked). Optionally speak to the Mountain Guide here to unlock quick travel for later trips.

label: Speak to Historian Duffy
detail: Speak to Historian Duffy, found near the water symbol on the minimap.

label: Enter the mountain crevice
detail: Use a rope on the crevice on the western side of the mountain and enter it, then go around to the south — not through the middle (near the exclamation-mark symbol on the minimap).

label: Mine the boulder
detail: Mine the boulder blocking the passage.

label: Push the boulder aside
detail: Push the mined boulder out of the way.

label: Defeat the Corrupt Lizardman
detail: Attempt to pass the magic gate; a Corrupt Lizardman blocks it — kill it.

label: Inspect the Unstable Altar
detail: Pass through the magic gate and inspect the Unstable Altar.

label: Hop worlds to leave the cave
detail: Once the dialogue finishes, hop worlds to quickly leave the cave.

label: Speak to Duffy again
detail: Speak to Historian Duffy again on the mountain.

label: Return to the unstable altar
detail: Go back into the cave to the unstable altar.

label: Speak to both Duffy and Gnosi
detail: Speak to Duffy, then to Gnosi, near the unstable altar — make sure to talk to BOTH of them.

label: Report to Lord Shiro Shayzien
detail: Speak to Lord Shiro Shayzien back at the War Tent (fairy ring code DJR or the Lovakengj Minecart Network), or speak to the Mountain Guide if quick travel was unlocked earlier.

label: Check Phileas's empty house
detail: Return to Phileas's house and walk inside to trigger dialogue — he won't physically be there.

label: Finish the investigation
detail: Return to Lord Shiro Shayzien once more to complete the quest.

label: Accept King Narnode's request
detail: Speak to King Narnode Shareen at the Grand Tree and agree to investigate the missing 10th squad. Keep an inventory slot free or the gnome royal seal drops on the ground.

hints.note: start: ask about the missing 10th squad

label: Glide to Gandius
detail: Climb up the tree at the Grand Tree and take the gnome glider to Gandius.

label: Get monkey bones if needed
detail: If you don't already have monkey bones, kill a monkey nearby for some (if Tai Bwo Wannai Trio is already started, only a monkey corpse drops, which also works).

label: Enter the Shipyard gate
detail: Enter the Shipyard gate to the north, carrying the Royal Seal.

label: Speak with G.L.O. Caranock
detail: Speak with G.L.O. Caranock in the building south of the Shipyard gate.

label: Report back to King Narnode
detail: Return to King Narnode and speak to him. Keep 1 free inventory slot, or Narnode's orders drop to the floor.

label: Talk through every option with Daero
detail: Talk to Daero in the bar on the first floor (east side) of the Grand Tree, working through every dialogue option in turn, to be teleported to a new location.

label: Talk to Daero inside the hangar
detail: Talk (not "travel") to Daero again, now inside the hangar.

label: Solve the hangar sliding puzzle
detail: Click the panel in the south-eastern hangar and solve the sliding puzzle, or alternatively pay Glough back at the Stronghold to solve it for you.

label: Fly to Crash Island
detail: Watch the cutscene, then talk to Daero, then to Waydar, to fly to Crash Island.

hints.note: Yes

label: Speak to Lumdo
detail: Talk to Lumdo on Crash Island.

label: Have Waydar convince Lumdo
detail: Talk (not "travel") to Waydar twice so he convinces Lumdo to follow orders.

hints.note: I cannot convince Lumdo to take us to the island.

label: Sail to Ape Atoll
detail: Talk to Lumdo again to travel west to Ape Atoll.

label: Enter the valley and get arrested
detail: Follow the red path into the valley on Ape Atoll. You'll be shot and arrested by the guards.

label: Pick the cell lock and escape
detail: Watch the guards' patrol pattern, pick the lock on your cell door with a lockpick, and escape. Stay at least 2 squares away from the guards, even while inside the cell.

label: Talk to Garkor
detail: Follow the green path and talk to Garkor, completing the full dialogue (skipping it means Zooknock won't give the m'speak amulet later).

label: Find the monkey dentures
detail: Follow the blue path to the U-shaped building and enter through the southern door, staying on the dark-brown floor to avoid alerting guards. Search the stacked crates on the light-brown floor for Monkey dentures.

label: Fall into the cave below
detail: Heal up first (fall damage applies), then search the south-eastern crate to fall into a cave below.

label: Find the M'amulet mould
detail: Search the north-western crates in the cave for a M'amulet mould, then you may teleport away safely.

label: Mine a gold ore
detail: Mine a gold ore (Mining 40, pickaxe) at a gold rock. Exact nearest rock to the quest's travel path is unconfirmed this pass ("??") — any gold rock works, this is a generic material, not a quest-location-specific one.

label: Smelt the gold bar
detail: Smelt the gold ore into a gold bar at any furnace (Smithing 40, boostable), or cast Superheat Item (Magic 43) to skip the furnace trip.

label: Shear a sheep for wool
detail: Shear a sheep with a pair of shears to collect wool — any sheep pen near your bank works (e.g. Lumbridge or Falador).

label: Spin the wool into a ball
detail: Spin the wool into a ball of wool on a spinning wheel (Crafting 1).

label: Descend into the Ape Atoll Dungeon
detail: Resupply at a bank (good food, prayer/antipoison/stamina potions), return to Ape Atoll via Daero, Waydar, and Lumdo, follow the yellow path west, and climb down the ladder into the Ape Atoll Dungeon.

label: Fight through to Zooknock
detail: Run through the dungeon to Zooknock, keeping Protect from Melee active against the level-98 Monkey Zombies and level-142 Skeletons, eating and drinking potions as needed.

label: Speak to Zooknock
detail: Talk to Zooknock, the exiled monkey blacksmith.

label: Have Zooknock forge the enchanted bar
detail: Use your Monkey dentures, M'amulet mould, and gold bar on Zooknock, then talk to him to receive the Enchanted bar and get your mould back. Do not give him the mould a second time once you already have the bar, or he'll keep it.

label: Reach the temple with the wall of flames
detail: Teleport away then return (Daero, Waydar, Lumdo). Follow the red path, get arrested and escape again, then follow the pink path to the temple. Bearded guards can't be walked through — enter the trapdoor, then navigate via the ladder to avoid the gorillas.

label: Forge the M'speak amulet
detail: With the M'amulet mould in your inventory, use the Enchanted bar with the wall of flames, then string the result with your ball of wool to create the M'speak amulet.

label: Head to the Monkey child's house
detail: Follow the pink path back to the jail, then the cyan path to the Monkey child's house. Watch for the Monkey's Aunt — it's only safe in the garden while she's away.

label: Convince the monkey child
detail: Equip the M'speak amulet and talk to the monkey child, then talk to him twice more to trigger "Well I'll be a monkey's uncle!"

hints.note: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle! -> How many bananas did Aunty want?

label: Pick 5 bananas
detail: Pick 5 bananas from the trees in the garden.

label: Deliver the bananas
detail: Give the bananas to the monkey child, leave the garden, wait for the aunt to pass through, then talk to him again to receive a Monkey talisman.

label: Return to Zooknock for the greegree
detail: Teleport away then return (Daero, Waydar, Lumdo), resupply at a bank, and follow the yellow path down into the Ape Atoll Dungeon again.

label: Trade for a greegree
detail: Give Zooknock a Monkey talisman and Monkey bones from a regular monkey (not another type) to receive a Greegree. Be careful not to accidentally bury the bones, and don't leave the Zooknock dialogue early or you'll have to restart the cutscene.

label: Prepare at the Ardougne Zoo
detail: Head to the Ardougne Zoo, equip the Karamjan monkey greegree, and talk to the Monkey minder (click through any first-time dialogue).

label: Bag a monkey
detail: Equip the M'speak amulet and talk to a nearby monkey so it jumps into your bag. Remove the greegree and speak to the minder again.

label: Walk back to Ape Atoll on foot
detail: Travel by foot (walk or run) back to the Grand Tree — do not use any teleportation method — then return to Ape Atoll by talking to Daero, Waydar, and Lumdo.

label: Reach King Awowogei
detail: Equip the M'speak amulet and Karamjan monkey greegree — Ape Atoll is no longer hostile while wearing it. Follow the red path through the gates, talk to Garkor, then the nearby Elder Guard, then head to the west coast, climb the hill, cross the bridge, and talk to Kruk.

label: Speak with King Awowogei
detail: Talk to Awowogei twice, then talk to the Elder Guard again to be let out.

label: Receive the 10th squad sigil
detail: Talk to Garkor and watch the cutscene, then talk to him again to receive the 10th squad sigil.

label: Prepare for the Jungle Demon
detail: Prepare combat equipment for the final fight — good food, prayer potions, and high-healing food are strongly recommended.

label: Defeat the Jungle Demon
detail: Equip the 10th squad sigil, then fight the Jungle Demon. Use Protect from Magic and stay out of melee range to minimise damage.

label: Report victory to King Narnode
detail: Return to the Grand Tree and talk to King Narnode Shareen to complete the quest.

label: Talk to the Cook (start Cook's Assistant)
detail: The Cook is in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen, panicking over the Duke's birthday cake. Agree to fetch a bucket of milk, an egg, and a pot of flour for him.

label: Grab an empty bucket in the castle cellar
detail: An empty bucket sits in the Lumbridge Castle cellar (basement); pick it up before heading out to the cow field.

label: Milk a dairy cow in the Lumbridge cow field
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own 'buy from the Grand Exchange' shortcut (flagged GE-violation): use the bucket on a dairy cow in the Lumbridge cow field, just south of the castle.

label: Pick up an egg at the chicken coop
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own 'buy from the Grand Exchange' shortcut (flagged GE-violation): an egg spawns at the chicken coop north-west of the cow field; pick one up.

label: Grab an empty pot from the Cook
detail: A spare empty pot sits by the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen.

label: Pick grain from the wheat field by Mill Lane Mill
detail: Grain grows in the wheat field just outside Mill Lane Mill, next to the cow pens.

label: Mill the grain into a pot of flour
detail: Climb to the top floor of Mill Lane Mill, use the grain on the hopper, then pull the lever. Climb back down and take the flour from the flour bin using the empty pot.

label: Deliver the milk, egg, and flour to the Cook
detail: Bring the bucket of milk, egg, and pot of flour to the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen and hand them over to finish the quest.

label: Talk to Kaqemeex (start Druidic Ritual)
detail: Kaqemeex stands in the stone circle north of Taverley; agree to help the druids reclaim the ritual site.

label: Talk to Sanfew in the Taverley Herb shop
detail: Sanfew is upstairs in Taverley's Herb shop; he explains the meat-enchanting ritual and asks for four raw meats.

label: Kill a bear for raw bear meat
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own 'these meats can all be bought on the Grand Exchange' shortcut (flagged GE-violation): kill a bear near the building just west of Ice Mountain.

label: Kill a chicken for raw chicken
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own GE-buy shortcut (flagged GE-violation): kill a chicken at the farm just south-east of Falador.

label: Kill a cow for raw beef
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own GE-buy shortcut (flagged GE-violation): the same farm south-east of Falador also has a cow.

label: Kill a giant rat for raw rat meat
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own GE-buy shortcut (flagged GE-violation): kill the giant rat near the graveyard just north of the church below Port Sarim.

label: Go to the Cauldron in Taverley Dungeon
detail: Enter Taverley Dungeon and head to the Cauldron room.

label: Enchant the four meats on the Cauldron
detail: Use each of the four raw meats (bear, rat, beef, chicken) on the Cauldron one at a time to enchant them. The Quick guide doesn't name the resulting item(s) distinctly from the raw meats -- treated as a 1:1 transform per meat, flagged "??" on exact post-enchant item naming.

label: Return the enchanted meats to Sanfew
detail: Bring the four enchanted meats back to Sanfew in the Taverley Herb shop.

label: Return to Kaqemeex to finish the quest
detail: Talk to Kaqemeex at the stone circle north of Taverley to complete Druidic Ritual and unlock Herblore training.

label: Talk to King Roald (start Priest in Peril)
detail: King Roald is in Varrock Palace; ask about a quest and he sends you to check on the missing priest Drezel.

label: Go to the temple east of Varrock, by the river
detail: Bring a ranged or melee weapon -- magic attacks and the Dwarf multicannon will not damage the Temple Guardian ahead.

label: Fight past the Temple Guardian
detail: Click the large door, climb down the trapdoor to the north, then kill the Temple Guardian blocking the way.

hints.note: Get it stuck in the middle section against the east wall, then stand one tile north on the east wall to safespot.

label: Report back to King Roald
detail: Go back to Varrock Palace and speak to King Roald again before returning to the temple.

label: Gather 25 unnoted essence
detail: Collect 25 unnoted pure or rune essence, plus a bucket, a weapon, and 1 free inventory slot. The Quick guide doesn't cite a specific essence-mine route here -- flagged "??". Low-level players may need two trips; the Monk of Zamorak ahead can be safespotted over the pews with ranged or magic.

label: Climb to Drezel's cell and talk to him
detail: Enter the temple again, go up the stairs then the ladder to the 2nd floor, and talk to Drezel through the cell bars.

label: Kill the Monk of Zamorak for a golden key
detail: Kill the level 30 Monk of Zamorak on the 1st floor of the temple to obtain a golden key.

label: Study the monuments for the one that takes the golden key
detail: Go back to the trapdoor where the Temple Guardian was fought, climb down, go through the first door, and check the monuments until finding the one the golden key fits.

hints.note: Which monument is the correct one isn't specified in the Quick guide -- check each until it fits.

label: Use the golden key on the monument
detail: Use the golden key on the correct monument to open it. The Quick guide doesn't explicitly narrate where the Iron key (used later on Drezel's cell door) comes from -- modeled as the contents of this monument since it's the only sourced key between here and the cell door; flagged for confirmation.

label: Fill the bucket at the well among the monuments
detail: Use the bucket on the well in the middle of the monument room. The Quick guide calls the result a 'blessed bucket of water' with no separate blessing step shown -- flagged "??" on the exact trigger, modeled as produced directly by filling the bucket here.

label: Unlock Drezel's cell and pour the water on the coffin
detail: Go back up to the top floor where Drezel is held. Use the Iron key on the cell door, talk to Drezel, then use the blessed bucket of water on the coffin in his cell.

label: Talk to Drezel again to start The River Salve
detail: Speak to Drezel once more at his cell to move into the final segment.

label: Go through the monument room's eastern door and talk to Drezel
detail: Go back down the trapdoor, through the monument room, and through the eastern door; Drezel is waiting there.

label: Gather 50 unnoted essence for Drezel
detail: Collect 50 unnoted pure or rune essence to hand over; without essence pouches this takes a few trips.

label: Give Drezel the 50 essence to finish the quest
detail: Hand the 50 unnoted essence to Drezel to complete Priest in Peril and unlock Morytania.

label: Talk to Asgarnia Smith at Bedabin Camp (start Desert Treasure)
detail: Asgarnia Smith stands by the magic carpet at Bedabin Camp; bring at least one free inventory slot and agree to help him.

label: Gather the starting materials Eblis needs
detail: Assemble 650 coins, ashes, a blood rune, bones, 6 molten glass, 12 magic logs, charcoal, and 6 steel bars via non-GE routes: bones from any kill, molten glass crafted from bucket-of-sand + soda-ash in a furnace, steel bars smithed from iron ore + coal, ashes from burning any logs. Blood rune sourcing (Runecrafting at the Blood Altar, or a monster drop) and magic-log sourcing (Woodcutting 75 on magic trees) and charcoal sourcing are not detailed in this quest's own Quick guide -- flagged "??", genuine gaps for Lane 5 rather than a GE substitution.

label: Get the book translated at the Digsite Exam Centre
detail: Go to the Digsite Exam Centre and talk to Terry Balando about the Desert Treasure quest, then talk to him again for a translation.

label: Show the translated book to Asgarnia Smith
detail: Return to Asgarnia Smith in the desert; tell him not to read the book, then talk to him again to have him help you.

label: Buy a drink at the Bandit Camp bar and ask about the diamonds
detail: Run south to the Bandit Camp and buy a drink in the pub for 650 coins (remove any Saradomin/Zamorak items first so the bandits don't attack). Talk to the bartender again and ask about the four diamonds.

label: Talk to Eblis about the four diamonds
detail: Find Eblis in or just outside the small rectangular building east of the bar; ask about the four diamonds of Azzanadra and agree to fetch them.

label: Deliver the gathered supplies to Eblis
detail: Use each required item (ashes, blood rune, bones, molten glass, magic logs, charcoal, steel bars) on Eblis, then talk to him again. Items can remain noted for this delivery.

label: Follow Eblis to the mirrors and begin the diamond hunt
detail: Go south-east to the mirrors and talk to Eblis there. The four diamonds (Smoke, Shadow, Ice, Blood) can be collected in any order; watch for a level 95 stranger who may randomly ambush you with a poisoned dragon dagger while carrying a diamond -- bank or place diamonds in the pyramid to avoid it.

label: Equip a facemask or gas mask
detail: Equip a facemask, gas mask, or Slayer helmet before entering the Smoke Dungeon.

label: Light the four torches and grab the warm key
detail: Enter the Smoke Dungeon (west of Pollnivneach, east of the mirrors). Light all four standing torches, one per corner, and open the centre chest for the warm key before any torch burns out. Starting NE then SE, NW, SW with 100% run avoids needing stamina potions.

label: Unlock the gate and kill Fareed for the Smoke diamond
detail: Use the warm key to open the gate east, then kill Fareed. Ice gloves are needed to wield melee gear (ranged works unarmoured but ash-es arrows), and only water spells damage him with Magic.

hints.note: Protect from Melee strongly advised; attack with a water spell or any ranged ammo.

label: Talk to Rasolo south of Baxtorian Falls
detail: Rasolo is outside his house south of Baxtorian Falls; ask about the Diamonds of Azzanadra.

label: Gather 20+ lockpicks and antipoison
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own coin-exchange shortcut (flagged GE-violation): pickpocket bandits in the Bandit Camp vicinity for lockpicks and antipoison instead of exchanging noted coins with Tiles' general store.

label: Pick the secure chest and give the gilded cross to Rasolo
detail: In the southernmost Bandit Camp tent, pick all 3 locks on the secure chest consecutively (can take many tries, faster at higher Thieving) to get the gilded cross. Bring it back to Rasolo, who swaps it for a visibility ring even with a full inventory.

label: Equip the visibility ring and climb down
detail: Equip the visibility ring, then climb down the ladder east of Rasolo in the fenced area.

label: Kill Damis (both forms) for the Shadow diamond
detail: Run through the dungeon and kill Damis in both of his forms, then pick up the shadow diamond. His second form drains Prayer rapidly.

hints.note: Safespot by hitting a bat or rat and stacking NPCs behind you; don't run too far out of his range or he resets.

label: Gather sweet food and spiked boots
detail: Bring any sweet food from the Troll child's list, plus fire-spell runes. Get spiked boots from Dunstan by giving him a pair of climbing boots and an iron bar.

label: Give the troll child sweet food and enter the ice gate
detail: North-west of Trollheim, use the sweet food on the troll child, talk to it, then enter the ice gate.

label: Kill 5 ice trolls
detail: Kill 5 ice trolls guarding the gate; you won't need to re-kill them if you teleport out and return.

label: Follow the path and kill Kamil
detail: Enter the cave, follow the path, then fight Kamil. Only fire spells damage him with Magic (Iban Blast, Flames of Zamorak, and the trident's built-in spell do not work); your stats are constantly drained during the fight.

hints.note: Approach with Protect from Magic to force him to teleport into range, then switch to Protect from Melee.

label: Wear spiked boots, cross the ice ledge, and free the frozen trolls
detail: Continue west along the long icy path. Wear spiked boots to climb the ice ledge, follow the new path, go through the gate, then use a fire spell on each troll frozen in ice. Talk to them for the Ice diamond.

label: Talk to Malak in the Canifis pub
detail: Talk to Malak in the Canifis pub about the special diamond; ask how to kill Dessous.

label: Gather a silver bar, spice, and garlic powder
detail: Smelt a silver bar (silver ore in a furnace). Garlic can be searched from the cupboard upstairs in Morgan's house in Draynor; grind it with a pestle and mortar for garlic powder.

label: Get a silver pot made and enchanted
detail: Travel to the Draynor Sewer and give Ruantun the silver bar for a silver pot. Take the pot to the High Priest in the Entrana church (Entrana bans combat equipment) and he enchants it.

label: Talk to Malak again
detail: Return to Malak in the Canifis pub. He deals 5 damage during this conversation but cannot kill you.

label: Add spice and garlic powder to the pot of blood
detail: Add the spice and garlic powder to the pot Malak gives you to create a pot of blood. Prepare combat gear and prayer/healing supplies before the boss fight ahead.

label: Pour the blood on the tomb and kill Dessous
detail: Go to the Morytania Graveyard north of Castle Drakan, pour the pot of blood on the tomb, and defeat Dessous. He has 99 Defence and strong slash resistance -- range or mage him, alternating Protect from Melee/Missiles each tick to avoid damage.

label: Return to Malak and claim the Blood diamond
detail: Go back to Malak in the Canifis pub and claim the blood diamond. You keep the blessed pot even after leaving the fight (a new pot of blood is only needed if you leave mid-fight).

label: Place a diamond in each of the pyramid's obelisks
detail: Go south-east of Eblis and place the smoke, shadow, ice, and blood diamonds in the pyramid's obelisks.

label: Enter the pyramid and run each floor without stopping
detail: Enter the pyramid from the top and run through each floor without stopping -- traps may still trigger and can send you back to the start regardless. Mummies and Scarabs can hit over 20.

label: Talk to Azzanadra to finish the quest
detail: Talk to Azzanadra at the end of the pyramid to complete Desert Treasure and unlock the Ancient Magicks spellbook. Praying at his altar twice afterward unlocks a hard Desert-area task.

label: Talk to Ali Morrisane about his stock problems
detail: Talk to Ali Morrisane next to the Silk Stall in northern Al Kharid; ask why he's still selling from a stall to trigger the quest start.

hints.note: start: ask about his stock problems

label: Obtain a kharidian headpiece and a fake beard
detail: Buy a kharidian headpiece and a fake beard (NPC clothing stock in Al Kharid, not the Grand Exchange).

label: Combine the headpiece and beard into a desert disguise
detail: Use the kharidian headpiece on the fake beard to combine them into a desert disguise for the Pollnivneach infiltration later.

label: Travel to Pollnivneach
detail: Head south to Pollnivneach to begin the local investigation.

label: Buy 3 beers from Ali the Barman
detail: Buy 3 beers from Ali the Barman at the Pollnivneach bar (NPC purchase).

label: Ply Drunken Ali with 3 beers
detail: Use one beer on Drunken Ali at the bar, talk through the full dialogue, then repeat with the second and third beers -- do not skip any dialogue between beers.

label: Question the bandits and the Menaphite Thugs
detail: Talk to the bandits by the general store, then head west of the bar and question the Menaphite Thugs.

label: Travel to the camel store
detail: Head to the camel store just north-west of the bar.

label: Buy 2 camels from Ali the Camel Man
detail: Talk to Ali the Camel Man and buy 2 camels for 500 coins (NPC purchase); keep 2 free inventory slots first.

hints.note: haggle to 500 gold for the pair

label: Deliver camel receipts
detail: Talk to a Menaphite and a bandit, handing each of them a camel receipt.

label: Join Ali the Operator's gang
detail: Go to the large purple tent south-west of the bar and ask Ali the Operator to join his gang.

label: Demonstrate a pickpocket attempt
detail: Attempt to pickpocket a villager once (as a demonstration), then return to Ali the Operator for advice.

label: Pay the street urchin for a tip
detail: Talk to the street urchin near the centre town well and pay him 10 coins for a tip on which villager to target.

label: Pickpocket the marked villager
detail: Pickpocket the villager with an arrow marker over their head (the urchin's tip-off), then report back to Ali the Operator.

label: Obtain an oak blackjack
detail: Obtain an oak blackjack before continuing -- the walkthrough does not state an explicit source here ("??"); it is most likely supplied on joining Ali the Operator's gang, otherwise buy one from a Pollnivneach blackjack seller.

label: Equip the oak blackjack
detail: Equip the oak blackjack before approaching a villager.

label: Blackjack and pickpocket a villager
detail: Lure a villager into a secluded area, knock them out with the equipped oak blackjack, then pickpocket them while they're unconscious.

label: Report success, move to the jewels task
detail: Talk to Ali the Operator to move on to the jewel-theft task.

label: Equip the desert disguise and gloves
detail: Put on the desert disguise (made earlier) and a pair of gloves before infiltrating the mayor's house.

label: Hide behind the cactus near the mayor's house
detail: Hide behind the large cactus near the mayor's house, the large house to the east by the fountain.

label: Obtain the mayor's house keys
