detail: Obtain the keys to the mayor's house -- the walkthrough does not state exactly how they're acquired here ("??"); they appear to be picked up automatically during the hide-behind-the-cactus sequence.

label: Enter the house and find the hidden dial
detail: Use the keys on the door, go up the stairs in the north-eastern corner, then search the landscape picture near the bed to reveal a hidden dial.

label: Crack the dial and take the jewels
detail: Hit the button on the dial to reset it, then click 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 in that exact clockwise order to open the safe and take the jewels.

label: Hand over the jewels
detail: Give the recovered jewels to Ali the Operator.

label: Chase down the traitor lead
detail: Talk to Ali the Operator, then a Menaphite Thug, then Ali the Operator again, then Ali the Barman about "Traitorous Ali" -- a fixed dialogue chase with no branching outcome.

label: Buy special kebab sauce
detail: Buy special sauce from the kebab seller north-west of the well in the middle of town (NPC purchase).

label: Sabotage the trough behind the camel shop
detail: Use the special sauce on the trough behind the camel shop.

label: Collect Ugthanki dung
detail: Use a bucket on the dung behind the camel shop once it has turned brown; scoop 3 extra buckets of dung if also planning My Arm's Big Adventure later.

label: Get a snake charm and basket
detail: Use a coin on the snake charmer's money pot south of the bar, with 2 free inventory slots, to receive a snake charm and a snake basket.

hints.note: ask for a go with the snake charm

label: Capture a desert snake
detail: Use the snake charm repeatedly on a desert snake north of the Menaphite tent until it goes into the snake basket.

label: Travel to Ali the Hag
detail: Head to Ali the Hag, north-west of the kebab seller.

label: Trade the snake and dung for hag's poison
detail: Talk to Ali the Hag twice, handing over the filled snake basket and the Ugthanki dung to receive the hag's poison.

label: Poison the beer table
detail: Use the hag's poison on the table with a beer in the bar.

label: Report the traitor
detail: Talk to Ali the Operator to report what was found.

label: Prepare for battle and confront the Menaphite Leader
detail: Gear up for combat, then talk to the Menaphite Leader just outside the tent.

label: Kill the Tough Guy for a willow blackjack
detail: Kill the level-75 Tough Guy from a safe-spot behind the bush; he drops a willow blackjack.

label: Find and question the Bandit Leader
detail: Talk to a villager, then find and talk to the Bandit Leader, who wanders near the northern magic carpet station.

label: Kill the bandit champion for an adamant scimitar
detail: Kill the level-70 bandit champion from a safe-spot behind the chair in the house to the east, while holding the willow blackjack; he drops an adamant scimitar.

label: Report to Ali the Mayor
detail: Talk to a villager, then talk to Ali the Mayor by the well in the village centre.

label: Return to Ali Morrisane to finish the quest
detail: Return to Ali Morrisane, who you started the quest with, to complete The Feud.

label: Talk to Martin the Master Gardener
detail: Talk to Martin the Master Gardener in Draynor Village to start the quest.

hints.note: start: ask about the failing farm patches

label: Obtain secateurs and a spade if missing
detail: If you don't already have secateurs or a spade, buy them from Sarah in the building next to the Draynor cabbage patch (NPC purchase).

label: Confirm membership with Elstan
detail: Run north-west and talk to Elstan at the allotment/flower/herb patch; confirm he's a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners.

label: Confirm membership with Frizzy Skernip
detail: Run south and talk to Frizzy Skernip; confirm his Group of Advanced Gardeners membership.

label: Travel to the Gnome Stronghold
detail: Take the spirit tree network (the Grand Exchange spirit tree is the fastest hop) to the Gnome Stronghold, then run east.

label: Confirm membership with Bolongo
detail: Talk to Bolongo and confirm his Group of Advanced Gardeners membership.

label: Confirm membership with Prissy Scilla
detail: Run south-west to the tree patch and talk to Prissy Scilla; confirm her membership.

label: Travel to Falador Park
detail: Teleport to Falador (Ring of wealth's Falador option lands directly in the park) and run to the tree patch.

label: Confirm membership with Heskel
detail: Talk to Heskel at the Falador Park tree patch; confirm his membership -- this completes the 5-gardener tally.

label: Report back to Martin
detail: Return to the Draynor Village market and talk to Martin again to move the quest forward.

label: Equip a dramen staff or Lunar staff
detail: Equip a dramen staff or Lunar staff -- required to enter Zanaris; source of the staff itself is outside this quest's own walkthrough ("??" if not already owned from Lost City).

label: Travel to Zanaris
detail: Enter the small shack south of Lumbridge Castle in Lumbridge Swamp with the staff equipped to teleport to Zanaris; if the quest spade still needs collecting, enter once without the staff equipped first to grab it.

label: Ask the Fairy Godfather about the Fairy Queen
detail: Run to the throne room and talk to the Fairy Godfather; ask where the Fairy Queen is.

label: Get the symptoms list from Fairy Nuff
detail: Run north of the bank and talk to Fairy Nuff to receive the Fairy Queen's symptoms list.

label: Consult Zandar Horfyre
detail: Speak to Zandar Horfyre on the top floor of the Dark Wizards' Tower, just north of the Makeover Mage.

label: Fill a druid pouch (recommended)
detail: Fill a druid pouch before collecting the 3 random items -- it protects any of them that ghasts could otherwise turn to rotten food. Recommended, not strictly required.

label: Dig up a Draynor skull if needed
detail: If you don't already have a Draynor skull, travel to Draynor Manor and use a spade on the grave north of the building, within the fence, to dig one up.

label: Trade the skull for the collection list
detail: Talk to Malignius Mortifer, the necromancer north-west of Port Sarim's rune shop; give him the Draynor skull to receive the list of 3 required items. Buy secateurs/spade from the nearby farm shop if still missing.

label: Collect the 3 randomly-assigned items
detail: Collect the 3 randomly-picked items per your quest journal's list -- the exact items vary per playthrough ("??"); carry the filled druid pouch while gathering any that ghasts could rot.

label: Travel to the Nature Grotto
detail: Travel to the Nature Grotto in Mort Myre Swamp via the Shades of Mort'ton minigame teleport, go west, then follow the winding path north over the bridge.

label: Equip the Ghostspeak amulet
detail: Equip the Ghostspeak amulet before entering the grotto so the Nature Spirit can be understood.

label: Trade the items for the Magic secateurs
detail: Talk to the Nature Spirit inside the grotto and hand over the 3 collected items to receive the Magic secateurs.

label: Bring food and armour for the Tanglefoot fight
detail: Bring food and armour before returning to Zanaris to face the Tanglefoot.

label: Return to Zanaris with the Magic secateurs
detail: Travel to Zanaris with the Magic secateurs in your inventory.

label: Squeeze through the gap by the Cosmic Altar
detail: Run south of the wheat fields to the Cosmic Altar and squeeze through the gap in the western wall.

label: Equip the Magic secateurs
detail: Equip the Magic secateurs before entering the tunnel.

label: Defeat the Tanglefoot
detail: Run to the end of the tunnel and defeat Tanglefoot; toggle Protect from Melee if the level allows, or lure it around the mushrooms to the east to flinch it.

label: Pick up the Queen's secateurs
detail: Pick up the Queen's secateurs dropped by Tanglefoot.

label: Finish the quest with the Fairy Godfather
detail: Talk to the Fairy Godfather to complete Fairytale I - Growing Pains.

label: Talk to Curator Haig Halen
detail: Speak to Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum and agree to help finish the barge.

hints.note: start: offer to help finish the barge

label: Travel to the canal barge
detail: Go to the canal barge north of the Digsite.

label: Talk to the barge foreman
detail: Talk to the barge foreman at the canal barge.

label: Get the sawmill proposal
detail: Talk to the sawmill operator in the Lumber Yard, explaining you're there on behalf of the museum archaeological team.

label: Deliver the sawmill proposal
detail: Bring the sawmill proposal to the sawmill operator in the Woodcutting Guild; if entry requirements aren't met, simply try opening the guild's eastern gate to satisfy this step.

label: Deliver the signed agreement
detail: Bring the sawmill agreement back to the Lumber Yard's sawmill operator.

label: Report back to the barge foreman
detail: Talk to the barge foreman again.

label: Board the barge
detail: Right-click the Embark option on the barge guard to board the barge.

label: Talk to the Lead Navigator
detail: Talk to the Lead Navigator aboard the barge.

label: Travel to the Rusty Anchor Inn
detail: Travel to the Rusty Anchor Inn in Port Sarim.

label: Ask Jack Seagull about cursed voyages
detail: Talk to Jack Seagull in the Rusty Anchor Inn about cursed voyages.

label: Re-board the barge
detail: Return to the northern part of the Digsite and board the boat again through the barge guard.

label: Talk to the Lead Navigator again
detail: Talk to the Lead Navigator once more.

label: Get the Bone charm from the Odd Old Man
detail: Deboard, walk west then north then east to the limestone mine, and speak to the Odd Old Man about lucky charms and the cursed voyage; he gives a Bone charm.

label: Obtain 2 bottles of vodka
detail: Obtain 2 bottles of vodka -- the walkthrough does not state a sourcing method here ("??"); no Grand Exchange purchase is used regardless.

label: Gather a marrentill herb
detail: Gather a marrentill herb (Herblore farming patch or a common secondary monster drop).

label: Fill a vial with water
detail: Fill an empty vial with water from any water source.

label: Make a Marrentill potion (unf)
detail: Use the marrentill herb on the vial of water to produce a Marrentill potion (unf).

label: Bring the vodka and potion to the Apothecary
detail: Bring the 2 vodka bottles and the Marrentill potion (unf) to the Apothecary in Varrock; select 'Talk about something else' then 'Talk about Bone Voyage'.

label: Receive the potion of sealegs
detail: Speak to the Apothecary again, selecting the same chat options as before, to receive the potion of sealegs.

label: Deliver the potion of sealegs
detail: Return to the Lead Navigator and give him the potion of sealegs.

label: Hand over the bone charm and depart
detail: Speak to the Junior Navigator, give him the bone charm, and confirm you're ready to go.

label: Steer the barge to Fossil Island
detail: Click the arrow opposite whichever way the top arrow tilts to correct course, and keep the sails as large as possible in a straight line for steadier travel, until the progress bar fills and you arrive at Fossil Island.

label: Talk to Herman Caranos
detail: Talk to Herman Caranos at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony, north of fairy ring code AKQ; the offered cutscene is optional.

hints.note: start: agree to fight the sea trolls

label: Gather blood, mist, and lava runes
detail: Gather 5 blood runes, 10 mist runes, and 10 lava runes before visiting the Wise Old Man.

label: Talk to the Wise Old Man
detail: Talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village, handing over the gathered runes.

label: Bring combat supplies for the Sea Trolls
detail: Bring food, armour, a melee or ranged weapon, and prayer potions to fight the Sea Trolls guarding the colony.

label: Return to the Colony with the Wise Old Man
detail: Return to the Fishing Colony and talk to the Wise Old Man.

label: Fight through the Sea Trolls into the Colony
detail: Kill the level-79 Sea Trolls blocking the entrance and collect 7 of their bones if needed for later; note that after 1-3 kills the trolls switch to dropping only big bones, which don't count toward that requirement.

label: Talk to Herman in the east building
detail: Talk to Herman inside the east building -- click inside the building itself, not directly on Herman, or your character will run back outside.

label: Gather repair materials
detail: Bring logs, a tinderbox (or get one from Franklin), 5 iron bars, a hammer (or get one from Franklin), a small fishing net (or get one from Arnold), and level-boosting items if below Fishing 62 or Smithing 45.

label: Talk to Franklin Caranos
detail: Talk to Franklin Caranos near the colony entrance to begin repairs.

label: Light the firebox
detail: Use a log on the firebox -- not the furnace -- and light it, inside the building marked with the furnace symbol; Franklin supplies a tinderbox if asked again.

label: Press iron sheets
detail: Use each of the 5 iron bars on the Metal Press to produce iron sheets.

label: Repair the western perimeter wall
detail: Use the iron sheets to repair the western colony perimeter's broken walls; Franklin supplies a hammer if asked.

label: Talk to Arnold Lydspor
detail: Talk to Arnold Lydspor in the bank; he supplies a small fishing net if you don't already have one.

label: Fish 5 fresh monkfish
detail: Fish 5 fresh monkfish at the spot to the north-west, catching a few extra in case some burn while cooking.

label: Optionally fight spawning Sea Trolls
detail: Optionally kill Sea Trolls as they spawn nearby while fishing; after 1-3 kills they only drop big bones, which no longer count toward the earlier bones requirement.

label: Cook the monkfish
detail: Cook the monkfish in the kitchen south of the fishing spot; note that Arnold's bank cannot be used to access cooking gauntlets here.

label: Deliver the cooked monkfish to Arnold
detail: Talk to Arnold and hand over the cooked monkfish.

label: Report back to Franklin
detail: Talk to Franklin again.

label: Report to the Wise Old Man and Herman
detail: Talk to the Wise Old Man and Herman in the far eastern building.

label: Gather bones, an airtight pot, and a brown apron
detail: Gather 7 bones (from the earlier Sea Troll kills), an airtight pot OR a pot with a pot lid, and a brown apron (or ask Malignius for one); if not banking afterward also bring food, armour, a weapon, and prayer potions.

label: Travel to the Wizards' Guild basement
detail: Travel to the basement of the Wizards' Guild in Yanille; the Nightmare Zone minigame teleport is needed to leave the colony first.

label: Talk to Wizard Frumscone
detail: Talk to Wizard Frumscone and agree to help the necromancer.

label: Portal to the Dark Wizards' Tower
detail: Use the southern portal on the guild's 2nd floor to teleport to the Dark Wizards' Tower, near Malignius Mortifer.

label: Get a brown apron from Malignius Mortifer
detail: Talk to Malignius Mortifer, south of Falador, about saving the fishing colony; receive a brown apron for Crafting Guild entry.

label: Talk to the Master Crafter
detail: Talk to the Master Crafter with dreadlocks on the east side of the Crafting Guild.

label: Make a pot and pot lid
detail: If carrying soft clay, use it on the potter's wheel then the potter's oven to produce a pot and pot lid; if carrying a pickaxe instead, mine clay first then follow the same steps.

label: Assemble the airtight pot
detail: Combine the pot and pot lid into an airtight pot.

label: Remove Saradomin-affiliated gear
detail: Remove any Saradomin-affiliated gear before continuing -- Malignius refuses to hand over bone seeds while it's worn or held, and dropping gear here isn't advisable since you'll be teleported away shortly.

label: Collect bone seeds and teleport back
detail: Talk to Malignius Mortifer to receive the bone seeds and teleport back to the Fishing Colony.

label: Bring supplies for the Final Battle
detail: Bring food, armour, a melee or ranged weapon, prayer potions, and the bone seeds to the final fight.

label: Begin the fight with Herman
detail: Talk to Herman to begin the final battle.

label: Defeat the Sea Troll Queen
detail: Fight the Sea Troll Queen; use Protect from Magic while in melee range, and Ranged or Melee to deal damage.

label: Finish the quest with Herman
detail: Talk to Herman to complete Swan Song.

label: Optionally cook a diary monkfish
detail: Optionally catch and cook another monkfish afterward -- satisfies a hard Western Provinces Achievement Diary task.

label: Bank: withdraw Waterbirth Island loadout
detail: Withdraw food (?? x) and best-available armour; Camelot teleport tabs/runes bring you somewhat close.

label: Travel to Rock Crabs, Waterbirth Island
detail: Access is free if The Fremennik Trials has been started; otherwise a 1,000-coin toll ferry, or use one of the page's own stated no-requirement spots.

label: Bank: deposit Rock Crab loot
detail: Deposit any drops and spare food.

label: Go to the Tree Gnome Stronghold agility course
detail: South of the Grand Tree; walk straight through the front door (Femi's box favour) — no quest gate. Spirit tree / seed pod routes open up later once unlocked.

hints.note: Walking in the front door has no gate; spirit tree and royal seed pod are faster once unlocked.

mapMarkers.label: Gnome Stronghold Agility Course (infobox map pin)

label: Run Gnome Stronghold laps until Agility 10
detail: 7 obstacles (log balance, obstacle net x2, tree branch x2, balancing rope, obstacle pipe) + completion bonus; none can be failed. If The Tourist Trap / Recruitment Drive / The Depths of Despair / The Grand Tree are on your quest plan anyway, their lump rewards cover levels 1-33 outright (see methods).

hints.note: Every obstacle auto-succeeds, so laps tolerate split attention; ~10,000 xp/hr at a relaxed pace.
Drops marks of grace since the 8 May 2024 rebalance - bank them toward the 260-mark Graceful set.

label: Go to the Draynor Village rooftop course (alt)
detail: Rough wall in the wheat field just north of Draynor's bank.

mapMarkers.label: Draynor rough wall, course start (course map pin)

label: Run Draynor Village rooftop laps until Agility 10 (alt)
detail: 7-obstacle lap (rough wall, 2 tightropes, narrow wall, wall, gap, crate climb-down); ~9,000-10,000 xp/hr. No failable obstacles below level 20 on the course's own obstacle table, so no food is needed.

label: Bank: withdraw a light food stack
detail: A handful of food (e.g. bread/tuna) in case of Al Kharid's two failable obstacles (Tightrope 1, Zip line; 1-5 damage each).

label: Continue Draynor laps until Agility 20
detail: Same loop as band 1-10; continue until Al Kharid unlocks at 20.

label: Go to the Al Kharid rooftop course
detail: Rough wall on the north side of Ellis the Tanner's building; follows Draynor, precedes Varrock.

mapMarkers.label: Al Kharid rough wall, course start (course map pin)

label: Run Al Kharid rooftop laps until Agility 30
detail: 8-obstacle lap; two failable obstacles (Tightrope 1, Zip line) at 1-5 damage each. Bring energy restoratives or rest between laps - the course's own page warns that running dry mid-lap drops the effective rate below Draynor's.

label: Pay the Brimhaven Agility Arena entry fee (alt)
detail: 200 coins to Cap'n Izzy No-Beard at the arena entrance; paid on every entry, not a one-off unlock.

label: Repeat the floor spikes trap until Agility 30 (alt)
detail: Floor spikes trap, south-west of the entrance; passable from level 20, or 15 boosted with a summer pie. Up to ~30,000 xp/hr; the trap can still fail so keep a little food. A locked camera angle lets you bounce back and forth over the trap by re-clicking one tile.

label: Go to the Varrock rooftop course
detail: Rough wall on the east side of the Varrock General Store.

mapMarkers.label: Varrock rough wall, course start (course map pin)

label: Run Varrock rooftop laps until Agility 40
detail: 9-obstacle lap incl. 2 failable (Clothes line 3-8 dmg, Wall 2-5 dmg); ~14,000 xp/hr since the 8 May 2024 rebalance.

hints.note: The training page itself suggests casting High Level Alchemy or fletching darts between obstacles.

label: Pay the Brimhaven Agility Arena entry fee (alt, full course)
detail: 200 coins to Cap'n Izzy No-Beard.

label: Tag ticket dispensers until Agility 40 (alt, Brimhaven arena)
detail: From level 40 every obstacle in the arena is passable; chase the yellow-arrow ticket dispenser (activates ~every 60s) and clear the floor-spikes trap during downtime. Full pillar-to-pillar clears need level 40; below that, skip obstacles you can't pass. Karamja gloves 2+ add +10% to obstacle and ticket-redemption xp.

label: Go to the Canifis rooftop course
detail: Climb the tall tree just north of the Canifis bank. Requires Priest in Peril completed.

mapMarkers.label: Canifis tall tree, course start (course map pin)

label: Run Canifis rooftop laps until Agility 52
detail: 8-obstacle lap, 1 failable gap (jump between tanner and general store); ~14,000-19,700 xp/hr depending on source cited. Keep a little food on hand for repeated Jump Gap fails.

hints.note: Highest realistic marks/hr of any pre-Ardougne course (16-18/hr, no decay past level 60) - the classic Graceful-farming spot; a full 260-mark set lands around level 54-59 training here from 40.

label: Bank: withdraw Wilderness Agility Course loadout (alt, fastest)
detail: Stamina potions, summer pies (boost 47->52 if under level), knife or Wilderness sword (to cut the web toward the Mage Arena bank run), food.

label: Teleport to the Ice Plateau (alt)
detail: Ice Plateau Teleport tablet/spell (needs Lunar Diplomacy + 89 Magic) is the fastest route in; run south-east from the landing tile. Wilderness obelisk teleport to level 44 wildy is a no-requirement fallback.

hints.note: The tablet needs Lunar Diplomacy + Magic 89; the obelisk route has no requirement but lands you a run south.

label: Run Wilderness Agility Course laps until Agility 52 (alt)
detail: 5 obstacles; completing all of them in order awards a large bonus xp chunk plus a wilderness agility ticket and a run-energy refill — skipping/failing forfeits the bonus. Optional 150,000gp dispenser fee (lost on death or on leaving, not on logout) adds loot per lap via an open looting bag - skip it for risk-free xp-only laps.

hints.note: Singles-plus deep Wilderness - PKers can attack at any time, even mid-obstacle; carry nothing you can't lose.
Bank via the obelisk to 13-wildy Ferox Enclave and return on an Ice Plateau tablet.

label: Go to the Falador rooftop course
detail: South wall of the house directly east of the Mining Guild, eastern Falador.

label: Run Falador rooftop laps until Agility 60
detail: 13-obstacle lap, 1 failable (Hand Holds, 3-8 dmg, stops failing at 66); up to 35,000 xp/hr.

hints.note: Marks spawn on any flat roof except the first/last and the Mining Guild's west roof; grab them mid-lap, no detours.

label: Continue Wilderness Agility Course laps until Agility 60 (alt, fastest)
detail: Same loop as band 40-52; continue past 52 if already set up there.

label: Go to the Seers' Village rooftop course (top-of-band alt)
detail: Wall near the entrance of Seers' Village bank; only usable once Agility 60 is actually hit.

mapMarkers.label: Seers' Village bank wall, course start (course map pin)

label: Run Seers' Village rooftop laps (carries into band 60-90)
detail: 6-obstacle lap, 2 failable (Jump Gap 1, Tightrope) until level 79; 40,000-44,000 xp/hr with no teleport, 50,000-56,000 with the hard-Kandarin-Diary Camelot teleport at the bank.

hints.note: Kandarin Diary tiers add a reroll on failed mark spawns (easy/medium/hard = 5/10/15%).

label: Withdraw and equip a ring of charos
detail: Required to be let down the Werewolf Agility Course trapdoor by the werewolf NPC.

label: Go to the Werewolf Agility Course entrance
detail: North-eastern exit out of Canifis, then south; requires Creature of Fenkenstrain completed.

mapMarkers.label: Werewolf Agility Course trapdoor entrance (fetched map pin)

label: Run Werewolf Agility Course laps until Agility 90
detail: 5 obstacles; hand in the Stick item at the Agility Trainer each lap for +380 bonus xp (730 xp/lap total). Only the death-slide is failable (up to ~30 dmg); stops failing entirely at Agility 80 + Strength 80 + weight under 2kg. The course's own page suggests moving to Rellekka at 80 or Ardougne at 90 for similar xp with better marks/hr.

hints.note: Marks also spawn on this course (10-15/hr).

label: Continue Seers' Village laps until Agility 70 (alt, low edge)
detail: Carry the band-60 Seers' loop forward as an AFK alternative to Werewolf for the 60-70 slice.

label: Go to the Rellekka rooftop course (alt, top edge)
detail: West of the Lighthouse in Rellekka; usable from level 80.

mapMarkers.label: Rellekka rooftop start, west of the Lighthouse (course map pin)

label: Run Rellekka rooftop laps until Agility 90 (alt, top edge)
detail: 7-obstacle lap, 1 failable tightrope (stops failing at 85); 55,052 xp/hr base, 64,941 xp/hr with the hard Fremennik Diary.

hints.note: Hard Fremennik Diary: 1/3 chance the mark-of-grace cooldown shortens to 2 minutes.

label: Go to the Ardougne rooftop course (continuity, real unlock at 90)
detail: MISMATCH flag: the row's continuity label names this course for the whole 60-90 band, but the course itself only opens at Agility 90 per its own page — treat this as the entry point into band 90-99's loop (see train-agility-99), not a completable loop within 60-90.

mapMarkers.label: Ardougne wooden beams, course start (course map pin)

label: Go to the Ardougne rooftop course
detail: Wooden beams outside the house next to the gem stall, SE corner of the Ardougne marketplace.

mapMarkers.label: Ardougne wooden beams, course start (course map pin)

label: Run Ardougne rooftop laps until Agility 99
detail: 7-obstacle lap, stops failing at 95; up to 70,184 xp/hr on a perfect 45.6s lap.

hints.note: Marks spawn on a single tile here and stack, resetting the 10-minute despawn each time - collect in batches.
No energy restores needed and far less focus than Sepulchre - pairs well with a second-screen task.

label: Bank: withdraw Hallowed Sepulchre loadout (alt, fastest)
detail: Stamina potions (or other run-restore), a Saradomin-aligned item to use the Magical Obelisks without draining run energy, food for trap damage.

label: Go to the Hallowed Sepulchre lobby (Darkmeyer)
detail: Requires Sins of the Father completed for Darkmeyer access; floor gates are 52/62/72/82/92 Agility, NOT boostable.

label: Run Hallowed Sepulchre floors until Agility 99 (alt, fastest)
detail: Run each floor avoiding traps as fast as possible; xp/hr scales 45,000 (F1) up to 98,500 (F5, grand-coffin looting) or up to 108,000 without Grand Coffin looting. 200 hallowed marks buys a private instance with a fixed trap rotation from the Mysterious Stranger - steadier xp/hr long-term.

hints.note: Floors 1-3 coffins aren't worth the lap time beyond hallowed marks; the floor-5 Grand Hallowed Coffin (Thieving 66) carries the real loot.

label: Descend to the Catacomb of Famine (Stronghold level 2)
detail: Drop down the Barbarian Village hole and take the Vault of War ladder to level 2 - the same floor the ctr- routing atoms use; security doors open on any correct answer. At 30/30 the pack hits low enough that no banked supplies are needed.

label: Kill Flesh Crawlers until Attack 50 and Strength 50
detail: Park in the crawler pack and rotate style at each level milestone - Accurate while Attack lags, Aggressive while Strength lags - until both stats reach 50. Keep the herb drops; they fund the stretch. Zombies on the same floor count too.

hints.note: One toggle per lagging stat.
Aggro stacks; floor exit/re-entry resets it.

mapMarkers.label: Flesh Crawlers, Catacomb of Famine (Stronghold level 2)

label: Go to the Lumbridge chicken coop
detail: From Lumbridge castle cross the bridge east over the River Lum and follow the path north to the fenced chicken pen. No banking needed - you fight in whatever you spawned with.

hints.note: Both pens are on the Chicken page's own location list.

label: Kill cows until Attack 30
detail: Hop the stile into the cow field just south of the chicken coop - same Lumbridge East farm, so no travel atom - and attack cows on Accurate until Attack 30. Bury bones as they fall; carry hides to the Al Kharid bank only if you want them for Crafting later.

hints.note: Pin the style on Accurate - this band is Attack-only.
Hides are optional cargo - skip them if inventory churn slows kills.
The windmill herd is the quiet spot.

label: Go to Barbarian Village
detail: Head to the hut cluster around the bridge midway along the Varrock-Falador road, just south of Edgeville. Nothing to withdraw - food comes from the river once you're there.

label: Kill barbarians until Attack 40
detail: Fight the barbarians in and around the longhall on Accurate until Attack 40. When health runs low, fish trout at the river spots beside the village and cook them on the longhall fire - zero bank trips.

hints.note: Trout spot + range are adjacent - restock food between kill sets (same spot the fishing/cooking bands use).

label: Bank: withdraw a light food load for the Stronghold
detail: At Edgeville bank withdraw your best melee gear and a part-inventory of cheap cooked food (count ??). The level-2 monsters hit low, so one load lasts a long session.

label: Descend to Stronghold of Security level 2 (Catacomb of Famine)
detail: Climb down the hole in the centre of Barbarian Village, cross the Vault of War to the next ladder, and stop on level 2. Each gated door asks an account-security question - any correct answer opens it.

hints.note: Security-question doors; any of the listed correct answers opens them.

label: Kill Flesh Crawlers and zombies until Attack 60
detail: Stand in a crawler room and let the level 28/35/41 Flesh Crawlers and 30/44/53 zombies pile on - they hit low, so cheap food carries you. Keep the herb drops (they pay for the trip) and claim the Grain of Plenty's 3,000 coins on your first pass. Stay until Attack 60.

hints.note: Let aggro stack; leaving and re-entering the floor resets it.
Crawler herb drops are the floor's payday.
Spawn layout is identical on every world.

mapMarkers.label: Flesh Crawlers, Catacomb of Famine (Stronghold level 2)

label: Bank: withdraw the moss giant loadout
detail: At Varrock west bank withdraw food (count ??), your best melee set, and optionally High Alchemy runes to alch drops on the spot; a ring of dueling covers re-banking if you fight at the members spots instead.

label: Go to the moss giants
detail: Climb down into the Varrock Sewers and push through to the level 42 moss giants (the free-to-play spot); the Catacombs of Kourend and the clearing west of the Fishing Guild are the members alternatives the page lists.

hints.note: Catacombs are awkward to reach at low levels - the page suggests entering via another player's Kourend house portal.

label: Kill moss giants until Attack 70
detail: Fight the moss giants on Accurate until Attack 70. Every kill drops big bones - bury them as you go or bank them for Prayer - and keep herb, seed, and alchable drops plus any mossy key (opens Bryophyta) or dark totem pieces (Skotizo later). They hit hard through low Defence, so eat early.

hints.note: Big bones are a guaranteed drop - free Prayer xp riding along.
Key drops open Bryophyta as a side boss.

label: Get a Slayer task from your best master
detail: Ask the highest Slayer master you qualify for - the page recommends Nieve (85 combat, Tree Gnome Stronghold) in this bracket - and put on the Slayer helm if unlocked; its accuracy and damage bonus is what makes tasks strong Attack xp.

hints.note: Task rolls vary; spend points to skip or block the melee-hostile ones.

label: Grind Slayer tasks until Attack 80
detail: Kill each assignment on Accurate in your best melee gear, re-task at the master the moment it finishes, and melee the melee-friendly tasks; the un-meleeable ones are where your skips go. Repeat task after task until Attack 80.

hints.note: Slayer levels and points bank alongside the Attack xp.
Popular task spots crowd up.

label: Travel to Nightmare Zone (north of Yanille)
detail: Take the Minigame teleport straight to Nightmare Zone once you meet its five-quest entry bar; otherwise Watchtower teleport and run east, a Yanille player-owned house, fairy ring CLS or CIQ, or ring of dueling to Castle Wars and walk.

quests: Any 5 quests from the Nightmare Zone requirement list (Nightmare_Zone.s3)

hints.note: The Minigame teleport only works once the entry requirements are met.

label: Fund Dominic's coffer
detail: Deposit coins into Dominic's coffer beside the lobby, in multiples of 1,000 (long-session total ??); each dream's fee is drawn from the coffer when you drink the potion.

label: Stock overload and absorption doses at the barrels
detail: Spend reward points at the lobby barrels: overload is 1,500 points a dose, absorption 1,000; each barrel stores up to 255 doses and withdrawing before a dream is free. First visit ever? Run one game on super combat + prayer potions to seed points (the Strategies page's first-points routine).

hints.note: A 28-dose absorption inventory drinks as fast as cleaning herbs and never delays a hit.

label: Start a hard customisable rumble with Dominic
detail: Talk to Dominic, pick the hard customisable rumble, and set the boss list: disable Glod, Elvarg, Corrupt Lizardman, Chronozon, and Barrelchest; never leave Dream Mentor bosses on while Desert Treasure I bosses are off (an 83.33% point penalty). Then drink the dream potion on the plinth.

hints.note: Cancel by talking to Dominic again before drinking - no fee lost.
Selection persists between dreams - set it once.

label: Dharok the dream: kill bosses until Attack 99
detail: In the dream wearing Dharok's (best at 92+ Hitpoints) or Obsidian + Berserker necklace + Toktz-xil-ak: drink an overload while at 51+ Hitpoints, wait for its damage ticks to finish, then Guzzle (right-click - Eat only reaches 2) the dwarven rock cake to 1 Hitpoints and hold it by flicking Rapid Heal at least once a minute while absorption points soak every hit. Re-overload each 5-minute wear-off, re-cake after the spike, restock doses between dreams. Six hours is the hard session cap; repeat dreams until Attack 99.

items: Dharok's set OR Obsidian armour + Berserker necklace + Toktz-xil-ak OR Blood Moon set + Dual Macuahuitl
dwarven rock cake or locator orb

hints.note: Pinned on Attack for the cape run; the page trains Strength first if you're optimising all three.
Between one-minute Rapid Heal flicks this is low-attention play.
Flicking Rapid Heal stops passive regen from lifting you off 1 HP.

label: Buy your first player-owned house from an estate agent
detail: Talk to any estate agent (Varrock, Falador, Seers' Village, East Ardougne, Hosidius, or Civitas illa Fortis) and pay 1,000 coins; your first house is placed at Rimmington. Completing the Daddy's Home miniquest grants the house free instead. Ownership also lets you claim free construction guides from any estate agent.

label: Buy a hammer from a general store
detail: Any general store stocks hammers (e.g. Varrock General Store) and they never break; the Master smithing tutor at the west Varrock anvil also hands one over free. From Construction 15 a Tool store 1 in your Workshop supplies unlimited hammers.

label: Buy a saw from the sawmill operator
detail: The sawmill operator at the Lumber Yard north-east of Varrock sells a saw for 13 coins; a free saw spawn also sits in the Varrock estate agent's house, and a house Tool store stocks them too.

label: Buy ~188 steel nails from the sawmill operator
detail: Same sawmill operator, 3 coins each (members). ~188 nails covers every nail-using build to level 15 per the training page's own totals; nails bend at random so buy spares. Alternative non-buy source: smith them yourself at Smithing 34 (1 steel bar -> 15 nails on an anvil).

hints.note: Nails bend at random when building; ~188 is the page's own estimate for levels 1-15, not a fixed count.

label: Go to your house portal at Rimmington and enter in building mode
detail: From Falador run south past Port Sarim to Rimmington. Right-click the house portal and choose the building-mode entry so furniture hotspots are buildable (or pre-set building mode in the Settings house options).

hints.note: Building mode persists for the visit; you cannot drop items while it is on and guests block enabling it.

label: Chop 94 regular logs for the plank ladder
detail: No bank loadout needed for this checkpoint: hammer, saw, and nails stay with you, and logs come from any regular trees (no Woodcutting requirement). The full nail-build ladder to level 15 uses 94 regular planks per the page's own totals; chop in inventory batches and convert as you go.

label: Convert logs to planks at a sawmill (100 coins each)
detail: Pay the sawmill operator 100 coins per regular log (94 logs = 9,400 coins for the ladder). Auburnvale's sawmill is currently the closest to a bank; the Lumber Yard, Woodcutting Guild, and Prifddinas also have one. With your house at Rimmington you can instead carry noted planks and unnote them at Phials for 5 coins each between builds. This fee-per-log conversion is the non-GE plank source used in every band below - the page's own buy-from-GE advice is skipped per the gather/produce rule.

label: Build the furniture ladder in your house until Construction 20
detail: In building mode: 5 crude wooden chairs (Parlour, 2 planks + 2 nails, 58 xp) to 4 -> 7 wooden bookcases (Parlour, 4 planks + 4 nails, 115 xp) to 9 -> 7 wooden larders (Kitchen, 8 planks + 8 nails, 228 xp) to 15. Then switch your chop-and-convert cycle to oak logs (Woodcutting 15; 250 coins per oak plank, no nails needed): 3 repair benches (Workshop, 2 oak planks, 120 xp) to 16, then crafting tables (Workshop, 4 oak planks, 240 xp) to 20 (~8 of the page's 12-count 16-22 stretch).

hints.note: Fishing Trawler leak fixes (5 xp each), Wintertodt brazier repairs (4x level), and Vale Totems (xp = level) all pay Construction xp while training other skills - free early levels if those are on your route.

label: Bank: withdraw the Beginner contract loadout
detail: Withdraw hammer, saw, a couple of steel bars, and a stack of regular planks - the page's averages are 9.7 planks + 0.5 steel bars per Beginner contract (865 avg xp), ~24 bars/hr. Bring teleports toward Falador/Varrock/East Ardougne/Hosidius. Planks come from the same chop-and-sawmill cycle; steel bars are smelted at Smithing 30 (1 iron ore + 2 coal at a furnace) - no shop sells them.

label: Talk to Amy in Falador to take your first Mahogany Homes contract
detail: Amy stands just south of Falador Park at the minigame icon and must assign the first contract herself; afterwards Marlo (Varrock), Ellie (East Ardougne), and Angelo (Hosidius) also assign them, each in or beside their city's estate agent office.

label: Complete Beginner contracts until Construction 20
detail: Travel to the client's marked house, repair or rebuild every flagged furniture piece with regular planks and steel bars (no nails), then talk to the client to finish for xp, Carpenter points, and a run-energy-restoring cup of tea. Contracts cannot be cancelled once accepted. Cheaper and less click-intensive than the plank ladder, but slower per the page's own Beginner range.

hints.note: Optimal contract rates need teleports to all four cities; a charged Xeric's talisman covers Hosidius.

label: Bank: withdraw the oak build loadout
detail: Withdraw hammer, saw, an axe, and coins for sawmill fees (250 per oak plank). No servant yet below Construction 40 - either run planks in through the house portal, or carry noted planks plus coins and unnote them at Phials in Rimmington for 5 coins each (faster than bank runs at this level, per the page's own 1-40 tip).

label: Chop oak logs to a full inventory
detail: Oak trees a few tiles from the Hosidius bank deposit box (closest), just south of Seers' Village bank, or on the path between Falador Park and the west bank. Woodcutting 15 required.

label: Convert oak logs to oak planks at a sawmill (250 coins each)
detail: Pay the sawmill operator 250 coins per oak log; Auburnvale's sawmill is the closest to a bank, with the Lumber Yard, Woodcutting Guild, and Prifddinas as alternates.

label: Build the oak table -> carved table -> larder ladder until Construction 40
detail: In building mode: finish crafting tables to 22 if needed, then oak dining tables (Dining room, 4 oak planks, 240 xp - the page counts 39 tables/156 planks for the full 22-31 stretch) -> carved oak tables (Dining room, 6 oak planks, 360 xp; 10 tables/60 planks for 31-33) -> oak larders (Kitchen, 8 oak planks, 480 xp) from 33 to 40. Repeat the chop-and-convert cycle as planks run out. Fishing crane repair (methods[]) is a slower dual-skill alternative from level 30 if Crafting 30 is also up.

label: Bank: withdraw the Novice contract loadout
detail: Withdraw hammer, saw, steel bars, and oak planks - page averages 9.84 oak planks + 0.5 steel bars per Novice contract (1,887 avg xp), ~32 bars/hr - plus teleports for the four contract cities. Oak planks come from the same chop-and-sawmill cycle above; steel bars are smelted (Smithing 30, 1 iron ore + 2 coal), no shop sells them.

label: Get a Novice contract from any Mahogany Homes contractor
detail: Amy (Falador), Marlo (Varrock), Ellie (East Ardougne), or Angelo (Hosidius) - any of them assigns contracts once Amy has given the first; pick the Novice tier.

label: Complete Novice contracts until Construction 40
detail: Repair/replace the client's marked furniture with oak planks and steel bars (no nails), then talk to the client to finish for xp, Carpenter points, and the energy-restoring tea. Contracts cannot be cancelled once accepted.

label: Bank: withdraw the larder loadout and hire a servant
detail: Withdraw hammer, saw, axe, and coins for fees and wages. At Construction 40, hire a Butler at the Servants' Guild in East Ardougne to unnote planks for you (your house needs two bedrooms with beds built); upgrade to the Demon butler at 50 - both beat Phials. Servants ask payment every 8 services, so keep coins on you; at 58 build a servant's money bag in a bedroom to auto-pay and skip the dialogue.

label: Chop oak logs to a full inventory
detail: Same oak spots as the previous band: beside the Hosidius deposit box, south of Seers' Village bank, or the Falador Park to west bank path.

label: Convert oak logs to oak planks at a sawmill (250 coins each)
detail: Same 250-coin conversion as the previous band; Auburnvale's sawmill is closest to a bank.

label: Build oak larders in your Kitchen until Construction 55
detail: Kitchen hotspot, 8 oak planks and 480 xp per larder, with the servant ferrying noted planks. The page's rate (~480,000 xp/hr) only applies from level 50 onwards. For scale, its own 33-52 row counts 220 larders / 1,760 oak planks. Oak dungeon doors - this row's continuity label - do not actually unlock until 74; that chain lives in the 70-99 band.

label: Bank: withdraw the Adept contract loadout
detail: From Construction 50: withdraw hammer, saw, steel bars, and teak planks - page averages 11.5 teak planks + 0.5 steel bars per Adept contract (3,276 avg xp), ~36 bars/hr - plus the four-city teleports. Self-supplied teak: chop teak logs (teak tree spots not in this session's fetched pages - ??) and convert at a sawmill for 500 coins each; steel bars are smelted (Smithing 30).

label: Get an Adept contract from any Mahogany Homes contractor
detail: Adept contracts unlock at Construction 50; ask any of the four contractors.

label: Complete Adept contracts until Construction 55
detail: Repair/replace the marked furniture with teak planks and steel bars, then talk to the client to finish. Only covers the 50-55 tail of this band; contracts cannot be cancelled.

label: Bank: withdraw the mahogany table loadout
detail: Withdraw hammer, saw, and coins for demon butler wages; bank your mahogany plank stock where the butler can fetch it. The demon butler (Construction 50+, Servants' Guild, house needs two bedrooms with beds) is what makes the build-and-remove cycle work; a servant's money bag (58) auto-pays him mid-loop.

hints.note: The whole cycle is tuned around his 24-plank bank fetch.

label: Chop mahogany logs to a full inventory
detail: Mahogany trees north of the Farming Guild (Woodcutting 50; guild bank a short walk south). Alternates per the tree's own page: Hardwood Grove at Tai Bwo Wannai (100 trading sticks entry, free with Elite Karamja Diary; parcel service banks logs for 10 sticks each) or Prifddinas (crystal shard chance).

label: Convert mahogany logs to mahogany planks at a sawmill (1,500 coins each)
detail: Pay the sawmill operator 1,500 coins per mahogany log; Auburnvale's sawmill is closest to a bank.

label: Build-and-remove mahogany tables until Construction 70
detail: Dining room hotspot, 6 mahogany planks and 840 xp per table. Send the demon butler for 24 planks, then build 3 tables and remove 2 in the time he takes to return (22 ticks per inventory on a low-ping world; on higher ping use remove-3/build-2 or build-2/remove-2). Up to ~900,000 xp/hr at full efficiency - expect less with imperfect timing. Teak garden benches (66+) and Adept contracts are the cheaper alternates in methods[].

label: Bank: withdraw the Adept contract loadout
detail: Withdraw hammer, saw, steel bars, and teak planks (page averages 11.5 teak planks + 0.5 steel bars per Adept contract) plus the four-city teleports. Teak self-supply: chop teak logs (spots not in fetched pages - ??), sawmill 500 coins each; steel bars smelted at Smithing 30.

label: Get an Adept contract from any Mahogany Homes contractor
detail: Adept contracts stay selectable through this whole band; ask any of the four contractors.

label: Complete Adept contracts until Construction 70
detail: Repair/replace the marked furniture with teak planks and steel bars, then talk to the client to finish; contracts cannot be cancelled.

label: Bank: withdraw the mahogany furniture loadout
detail: Withdraw hammer, saw, and coins for demon butler wages; keep the mahogany plank stock banked for his 24-plank fetches. Money bag (58) auto-pays him so the loop never breaks for wage dialogue.

label: Chop mahogany logs to a full inventory
detail: Same mahogany trees north of the Farming Guild as the previous band (Woodcutting 50).

label: Convert mahogany logs to mahogany planks at a sawmill (1,500 coins each)
detail: Same 1,500-coin conversion as the previous band.

label: Build-and-remove mahogany tables until Construction 77
detail: Same demon-butler 22-tick cycle as the 55-70 band (build 3/remove 2 per 24-plank fetch), ~900,000 xp/hr; the page reckons 52->77 is doable inside 2 hours of clean cycling.

label: Build-and-remove gnome benches until Construction 99
detail: Superior garden, two adjacent bench hotspots: stand on the inner tile between them with 18 mahogany planks and one bench already built. Send the demon butler for 24 planks, then remove the built bench one tick and build the other hotspot the next, alternating until planks run out; when he returns, remove-and-build once more, restock, and re-send. 6 planks / 840 xp per bench - just over 1,100,000 xp/hr, the best rate in the game. The page counts 13,761 benches / 82,566 planks for 77-99.

label: Bank: withdraw the Expert contract loadout
detail: Withdraw hammer, saw, steel bars, and mahogany planks - page averages 12.71 mahogany planks + 0.5 steel bars per Expert contract (4,373 avg xp), ~40 bars/hr - plus four-city teleports; a plank sack lifts the tier to its higher range. Planks come from the same chop-and-sawmill cycle; steel bars smelted at Smithing 30.

label: Get an Expert contract from any Mahogany Homes contractor
detail: Expert contracts unlock at Construction 70; ask any of the four contractors. Many players deliberately stay on Adept past 70 to save mahogany plank costs - any unlocked tier is selectable.

label: Complete Expert contracts until Construction 99
detail: Repair/replace the marked furniture with mahogany planks and steel bars, then talk to the client to finish for xp, Carpenter points, and the run-restoring tea; contracts cannot be cancelled. Steel bars have no shop source - smelt them (Smithing 30, 1 iron ore + 2 coal per bar).

label: Bank: withdraw the oak door loadout
detail: From Construction 74: withdraw hammer, saw, and coins for the demon butler; bank a deep oak plank stock (the page counts 198,970 oak planks / 19,897 doors for the full 74-99 run) for his 25-plank fetches. Bridge 70-74 on mahogany tables or contracts first.

hints.note: Asking for 20 instead trades a little xp/hr for a simpler, mistake-tolerant cycle.

label: Chop oak logs to a full inventory
detail: Same oak spots as earlier bands (Hosidius deposit box, Seers' Village, Falador Park path).

label: Convert oak logs to oak planks at a sawmill (250 coins each)
detail: Same 250-coin conversion as earlier bands.

label: Build-and-remove oak dungeon doors until Construction 99
detail: Dungeon door hotspot (level 74), 10 oak planks and 600 xp per door. Hold 1 the whole time: send the demon butler for 25 oak planks, build two doors and remove one (leaving 5-8 spare planks), and when he returns remove-and-build once, click him twice to take the rest and re-send. ~550,000 xp/hr at max efficiency, upwards of 500,000 with occasional mistakes - the cheapest low-intensity high-xp option of this band.

hints.note: Custom Menu Swaps: prioritise 'Talk-to, Demon Butler' on left click; Menu Entry Swapper: door hotspot -> Build, built door -> Remove. Then holding 1 runs the whole loop - overlay/config only, no input automation.

label: Net and bait-fish about 190 raw fish for the 1-20 ladder
detail: Small-net shrimp/anchovies and bait-fish sardine/herring at the shore spots, and fly-fish the trout rung at Barbarian Village. The page's ladder wants roughly 25 raw sardine, 40 herring, 53 mackerel and 75 raw trout — the 2.5x burn buffer is already in those counts. Bank the stock as you fill it; this doubles as early Fishing progress (train-fishing-20).

hints.note: Same spots and hours as the early Fishing band — let the two bands pay each other off.

label: Go to the Lumbridge Castle kitchen range (Cook-o-matic)
detail: The range sits in the castle's ground-floor kitchen and needs Cook's Assistant done before the Cook lets you use it. It lowers the burn-stop level on early food (shrimp/meat 31 instead of 34, trout 45 instead of 49), which is worth more than bank speed at these levels. Any other fire or range works if you skip the quest — you just burn more.

hints.note: The page notes the Lumbridge Teleport spell lands close to the castle.

label: Bank: withdraw a full inventory of the current rung's raw fish
detail: Go up the castle staircase to the bank and pull 28 raw fish of whichever rung you are on (sardine, then herring, mackerel, trout). The page's location table puts this range 22 tiles from the bank — the longest run of the standard spots — so it only stays worth it while the burn reduction matters; stand east of the ladder before climbing to shave the corner.

hints.note: 28 cooks per load; a full inventory takes about 67 seconds on the range.

label: Cook the fish ladder on the Cook-o-matic until Cooking 20
detail: Cook every load: sardine to 5, herring to 10, mackerel to 15, trout to 20 — about 10/16/21/30 successful cooks per rung. Burns are heavy this low; that is what the 2.5x raw buffer covers. Rebank upstairs and repeat — the burn-and-rebank cycle stays inside this one step.

hints.note: The page sizes each rung's raw count at ~2.5x the cooked need because low-level burn rates are high.
Keep the cooked output as early food; burnt fish are dead weight.

label: Go to the Barbarian Village permanent fire
detail: Run west from Varrock west bank or east from Edgeville to Barbarian Village; the everlasting fire sits beside the river fly-fishing spots, so nothing needs lighting and no bank is needed this whole band — you fish straight into the fire.

hints.note: Both banks are a short run; pick whichever you can reach fastest.

mapMarkers.label: Barbarian Village fly-fishing spot + fire (mirrored from the train-fishing-40 row's pin)

label: Fly-fish trout and salmon beside the fire
detail: Feather fly-fishing at the Barbarian Village river spots, keeping a rolling stock of raw fish a few loads ahead of your cooking. This is the same loop as train-fishing-40 — hours here bank both skills at once. Exact raw count for 20-40 by this route: ??.

hints.note: Fish while your last batch cooks; alternate rod and fire.

label: Cook trout and salmon on the fire until Cooking 40
detail: Cook each load as you catch it and drop or eat the output — no bank this band. Trout stops burning at 49 on a fire and salmon at 58, so burns taper but never quite stop here. From 30 you can instead bank raw tuna for the Hosidius ovens (easy Kourend & Kebos diary): 340 raw tuna covers the whole 30-40 stretch.

hints.note: Fire burn-stop levels from the Burn level table — expect some burns through the band.
Bank a stack of trout/salmon if you need cheap food soon; otherwise drop and keep fishing.

label: Cage lobsters until a raw-lobster bank covers the band
detail: Pot-fish raw lobsters at your Fishing band's cage spot — the same loop as train-fishing-58 — and bank every load. The page's full 40-68 lobster ladder consumes about 4,970 raw, so a 40-58 leg needs a big slice of that (exact count ??). Stock ahead of time so the cooking loop never stalls.

hints.note: Cage-lobster hours count toward both bands — fish first, cook after.

label: Travel to the Hosidius Kitchen ovens
detail: The clay ovens sit south-east of the Mess Hall, six tiles from the bank, and cut burn chance by 5% (10% after the elite Kourend & Kebos diary). The easy Kourend & Kebos diary is required to use them at all — without it, cook at any bank-side range and expect more burns.

hints.note: The page ranks locations by bank distance, not transport; use your fastest Kourend route.

label: Bank: withdraw cooking gauntlets and a full load of raw lobsters
detail: First trip: gauntlets plus 27 raw lobsters; every later trip a full 28 raw with the gauntlets already on your hands. Six tiles oven-to-bank makes each full round about 74 seconds.

hints.note: About 1,365 cooks/h at Hosidius when the loop is clean.

label: Equip the cooking gauntlets
detail: The Family Crest reward gloves. With them lobsters stop burning at 60 on the Hosidius ovens (64 on a normal range) instead of 70/74 bare-handed — the difference is most of this band's burn losses.

hints.note: Keep them on for every lobster/monkfish/shark/anglerfish load from here to 99.

label: Cook lobsters at the Hosidius ovens until Cooking 58
detail: Cook 28, rebank, repeat. Burns continue until level 60 even with gauntlets at Hosidius, so keep the raw buffer topped up; from 47/52 you can swap to fish or botanical pies via Bake Pie if you have Lunar Diplomacy, or push single levels with jugs of wine.

hints.note: Burn-stop levels from the Burn level gauntlets table.

label: Stock the band's raw fish: lobsters to 68, then harpoon swordfish
detail: Keep cage-fishing raw lobsters until your Cooking reaches 68, then switch the stock to harpooned swordfish (the same loop as train-fishing-70). The page's full-ladder counts are 4,970 raw lobster for 40-68 and 10,186 raw swordfish for 68-80, so a 58-74 leg uses a slice of each (exact ??). Running the monkfish variant instead? Use the existing gather-monkfish row.

hints.note: Harpoon swordfish hours feed both this band and the Fishing 58-70 band.

label: Return to the Hosidius Kitchen ovens
detail: Same site as the lobster band: clay ovens six tiles from the bank, 5% burn reduction (10% with the elite Kourend & Kebos diary, which needs 84 Cooking, boostable). Easy diary still required to use the ovens.

hints.note: Fastest Kourend transport you own; the page only ranks bank distance.

label: Bank: withdraw gauntlets plus 28 raw fish of the current rung
detail: Gauntlets on, then full 28-loads of raw lobster (to 68) or raw swordfish (from 68). About 74 seconds per cook-and-bank round at Hosidius.

hints.note: 1,365 cooks/h at Hosidius; 1,435 at the zero-tile bank spots.

label: Cook lobsters at Hosidius until Cooking 68 — burn-free from 60
detail: With gauntlets at the Hosidius ovens, lobsters stop burning entirely at 60, so almost this whole leg is loss-free: cook 28, rebank, repeat until 68.

hints.note: Zero burns from 60 with gauntlets at Hosidius (Burn level table).

label: Switch to swordfish at 68 and cook until Cooking 74
detail: Same rebank rhythm with raw swordfish. Burn-stop is 76 at the Hosidius ovens — and the page footnotes that gauntlets make no difference for swordfish there — so expect occasional burns all the way through this leg. Monkfish (Swan Song; reuse cook-monkfish) is the like-for-like alternative if your supply is monkfish; 1-tick karambwan beats both if you have Tai Bwo Wannai Trio and the focus.

hints.note: Page footnote: gauntlets do not affect swordfish burn rate at the Hosidius kitchen.

label: Fish raw karambwan on Karamja's north-east coast (fairy ring DKP)
detail: With Fishing 65, a karambwan vessel and raw karambwanji as bait, fish the karambwan spots on the north-east Karamja shore — fairy ring code DKP lands beside them. The full 30-99 1-tick run eats about 75,185 raw, so a 74-99 leg needs a large slice of that (exact ??). Bank stock in batches as you fill. Karambwanji bait source: ?? (not fetched here).

hints.note: The spot table's own access note is the DKP fairy ring.

label: Teleport to Burthorpe and drop into the Rogues' Den
detail: Games necklace to Burthorpe, run south into The Toad and Chicken inn and take the trapdoor by the bartender. Emerald Benedict banks one step from the everlasting fire and never moves. Same-speed alternatives: the Myths' Guild stove (Dragon Slayer II; mythical cape teleports straight there) or the Mor Ul Rek sulphur vent (show a fire cape to enter the inner city).

hints.note: All three routes are the page's own transport list; games necklace is the shortest run.

mapMarkers.label: Rogues' Den, under The Toad and Chicken ({{Map}}-sourced)

label: Bank: withdraw 28 raw karambwan from Emerald Benedict
detail: He stands beside the fire; pull a full 28 each round. At the assumed 5,000 cooks an hour you will be back at him roughly every 20 seconds — keep the bank pin off and the withdraw-28 preset ready.

hints.note: One inventory per ~20s at 1-tick pace; 1,435 cooks/h if you fall back to AFK pace here.

label: 1-tick cook karambwan on the Den fire until Cooking 99
detail: Hold 1 (or space) and rapidly use each raw karambwan on the fire so every cook lands on its own tick — about 5,000 cooks an hour when clean, but it demands sustained click accuracy. Cannot hold the rhythm? AFK-cook them at the Hosidius ovens up to 96 (lower burns beat the longer bank run at AFK speed; elite Kourend & Kebos at 79 helps further), then finish at a zero-tile bank spot — or switch to jugs of wine (490,000 xp/h, no quest gate).

hints.note: Karambwan burn to 99 on a fire and gauntlets do not help — burns are a costed-in constant here.
Both sit zero tiles from a bank; stove vs fire makes no difference for karambwan.

label: Go to the Al Kharid crafting hub (bank + Ellis + Dommik's)
detail: Head to north-east Al Kharid: the bank, Ellis the tanner, and Dommik's Crafting Store all sit within a short run of each other, so the whole 1-20 leather ladder happens in one spot.

hints.note: Ring of dueling and amulet of glory both land near Ellis per the Tanner page; otherwise walk east from Lumbridge.

mapMarkers.label: Ellis the tanner, Al Kharid (west of the bank)
Dommik's Crafting Store, NE Al Kharid

label: Buy a needle (and a chisel) from Dommik's Crafting Store
detail: One needle lasts forever; Dommik stocks 3. Grab a chisel here too (stock 2) if you plan to cut gems in the 20-40 band.

mapMarkers.label: Dommik's Crafting Store, NE Al Kharid

label: Buy ~50 thread from Dommik
detail: The training page budgets around 50 thread spools for the full 1-20 ladder; Dommik stocks 100 at a time.

hints.note: One spool covers about 5 crafts, so ~50 spools carry all 215 leather items.

mapMarkers.label: Dommik's Crafting Store, NE Al Kharid

label: Kill cows until 215 cowhides are banked
detail: Kill cows at the Lumbridge cattle field (or any cow pen) and keep every cowhide -- a guaranteed drop. 215 hides covers the whole ladder: 48 gloves, 19 boots, 21 cowls, 34 vambraces, 57 bodies, 36 chaps. Hides banked during early combat training (existing row ctr-02-kill-cows already says keep cowhides) count toward this pile.

hints.note: Bury the bones as they drop for free early Prayer progress.

label: Tan all 215 cowhides into leather at Ellis
detail: Use the hides on Ellis, just west of the Al Kharid bank -- 1 coin per hide for soft leather. Bank-and-return until the whole stack is tanned.

mapMarkers.label: Ellis the tanner, Al Kharid (west of the bank)

label: Craft the leather ladder at the Al Kharid bank until Crafting 20
detail: Stand at the bank and use the needle on leather, always making the highest item unlocked: gloves to 7, boots to 9, cowl to 11, vambraces to 14, body to 18, chaps to 20. Each craft takes 3 ticks, so the 215 items are about 6.5 minutes of pure craft time between banking.

label: Go to the Edgeville furnace
detail: Edgeville's furnace sits steps from its bank -- the page's best option without Prifddinas access (Shilo Village is even closer but charges 20gp per use).

label: Bank: withdraw your mould plus 27 gold bars
detail: Withdraw the ring/necklace/amulet mould (Dommik's or Rimmington sell them) and fill the rest of the inventory with gold bars; when making sapphire rings from 20, split the load: mould + 13 bars + 13 sapphires.

label: Smelt your mined gold ore into bars at the same furnace
detail: One bar per craft. Smelting your own gold needs Smithing 40 (Gold bar page) -- if the Smithing lane hasn't caught up yet, run the gem-cutting alternative below instead.

label: Craft jewellery at the furnace until Crafting 40
detail: Make the best unlocked piece: gold ring at 5, necklace 6, bracelet 7, amulet (u) 8; from 20 switch to sapphire rings (gold bar + sapphire). Bank, re-withdraw 27, repeat -- the furnace and bank are a few tiles apart.

label: Alt: buy uncut gems from Toci's Gem Store in Aldarin
detail: Toci's stocks a trickle -- 3 uncut sapphires, 2 emeralds, 1 ruby, 0-base diamonds -- with restocks measured in thousands of ticks. It is the named non-GE vendor, not a bulk source.

hints.note: Per-world stock is tiny; hop worlds, or treat shop gems as a side trickle while jewellery carries the band.

label: Alt: cut gems with a chisel until Crafting 40
detail: Cut sapphires from 20 (106 cuts reach 27), emeralds from 27 (156 reach 34), then rubies from 34 -- the page's fastest-xp path whenever you have gem supply in the bank.

label: Restock uncut rubies and diamonds (Toci's trickle + your own gem pile)
detail: Toci's holds at most 1 uncut ruby and 0-base diamonds per restock cycle, so real volume comes from your own gathering (gem rocks, monster drops) banked over time.

hints.note: Tiny per-world stock; hop worlds for the trickle.
Gem supply outside the shop is drop/rock RNG -- bank every gem you touch.

label: Cut rubies, then diamonds from 43, until Crafting 54
detail: 355 ruby cuts carry 34 to 43; from 43 cut diamonds -- the page recommends staying on diamonds all the way to 62. One chisel, one gem per cut, stand at any bank.

label: Optional lookahead: start banking green dragonhides for level 63
detail: Green d'hide bodies -- this row's named method -- actually unlock at Crafting 63, one band later. If you want the hides ready, green dragons drop one hide every kill; regular spawns are all in the Wilderness, with the Myths' Guild basement (post-Dragon Slayer II) as the safe option. Three tanned hides per body.

hints.note: Wilderness spawns carry PvP and dragonfire risk; the Myths' Guild basement (Dragon Slayer II) avoids both.

label: Go to Zaff's staff shop in central Varrock
detail: Zaff's Superior Staffs is just north-west of Varrock square. Battlestaves only appear in his stock once most of What Lies Below is complete.

label: Buy battlestaves from Zaff (shop stock + daily diary barrel)
detail: Shop stock is 5 at a time on a 100-tick restock. With Varrock Diary tiers done, also buy the once-per-day noted barrel at 7,000 each: 15/day Easy, 30 Medium, 60 Hard -- the page's own ironman-friendly supply line.

hints.note: Daily discounted noted battlestaves scale with Varrock Diary tier; buy the barrel every day you pass through.

label: Blow unpowered orbs from molten glass (Crafting 46)
detail: Smelt bucket of sand + soda ash into molten glass at a furnace (both sold by charter ship crews; giant seaweed + sandstone for bulk), then blow unpowered orbs with a glassblowing pipe -- 52.5 xp each, one orb per battlestaff.

label: Charge orbs at the elemental obelisks (Magic 56/60/63/66)
detail: Cast the charge spell on the obelisk -- each orb costs 30 elemental runes + 3 cosmics: Water at the ladder past Taverley Dungeon's black dragons (dusty key or 70 Agility); Earth deep in Edgeville Dungeon past the poison spiders; Fire at the end of Taverley Dungeon; Air in level-7 Wilderness north of Edgeville.

hints.note: The Air Obelisk is level-7 Wilderness -- skip it if you refuse PvP risk; fire battlestaves (62) already carry the band's tail.

label: Combine orbs onto battlestaves at a bank until Crafting 70
detail: Use the charged orb on a battlestaff: water from 54 (736 crafts reach 58), earth from 58 (972 reach 62), fire from 62 (1,300 reach 66), air from 66. Climb the ladder as Crafting and Magic levels allow; withdraw 14 staves + 14 orbs per inventory.

label: Kill black dragons for hides (3 per body)
detail: Black dragonhide is a guaranteed drop. Taverley Dungeon holds the non-Wilderness spawns: the ground-floor area needs a dusty key or 70 Agility; the upper level needs an active black-dragon Slayer task. Bring dragonfire protection. Self-sourcing every hide to 99 is enormous -- bank hides from every source (kills, other lanes) and lean on the glass alternative below when supply runs dry.

hints.note: No black-dragon task? Use the ground-floor spawns (dusty key or 70 Agility) instead of the task-gated upper level.

label: Tan dragonhides at Ellis (20gp each)
detail: Use the hides on Ellis by the Al Kharid bank -- 20 coins per dragonhide, any colour. From Magic 78 with the Fremennik Hard Diary, the Tan Leather lunar spell tans 5 hides per cast and skips the tanner entirely.

mapMarkers.label: Ellis the tanner, Al Kharid (west of the bank)

label: Craft d'hide bodies at a bank until Crafting 99
detail: Climb the ladder as you level: blue bodies from 71 (210 xp), red from 77 (234 xp, where d'hide becomes the fastest viable method), black from 84 (258 xp). Withdraw 24 leather + needle and thread for 8 bodies per trip, or use the costume needle (Costumer in Aldarin, post-Death on the Isle) for 9 with no thread.

hints.note: Deposit lock on = 'Deposit inventory' banks only the bodies and never the needle -- the page's own banking tip; leave it on for the whole grind.
Costume needle fits 9 bodies per inventory vs 8 with needle+thread, and consumes no thread.

label: Alt supply: buy buckets of sand + soda ash from charter ship crews
detail: Charter ship shops sell both molten-glass ingredients -- the Molten glass page's own named non-GE route; for bulk, giant seaweed + sandstone are the efficient self-gather sources.

label: Alt from 87: smelt molten glass and blow empty light orbs
detail: Smelt sand + soda ash into molten glass at a furnace (20 xp each; Superglass Make yields 1.3 glass per pair at 10 xp), then blow empty light orbs with the pipe -- 70 xp per orb, the page's stated 122,500 xp/hr under its 1,750-blows/hr assumption. Fully self-sourceable, unlike bulk dragonhide.

hints.note: The page calls glassblowing low-attention -- pair it with a second-monitor task; it is the AFK arm of this band.

label: Go to the Lumbridge chicken coop
detail: From Lumbridge Castle cross the bridge east over the River Lum and follow the path north to the fenced chicken pen. Nothing to bank - you fight in whatever you spawned with.

hints.note: Both pens are on the Chicken page's own location list.

label: Kill chickens on Defensive until Defence 10
detail: Open the combat tab, click the Defensive style (bottom option on most weapons), and kill chickens around the pen until Defence 10. Bury each bone as it drops and pick up the stacking feathers; no food needed - chickens max at 3 Hitpoints of harm.

hints.note: Pin the style on Defensive: every point of damage dealt pays 4 Defence xp (+1.33 Hitpoints) and grants an invisible +3 Defence boost.
Feathers stack; bones are free early Prayer xp.

label: Kill cows on Defensive until Defence 30
detail: Hop the stile into the cow field just south of the chicken coop - same Lumbridge East farm, so there is no travel leg - keep the style pinned on Defensive, and kill cows until Defence 30. Bury bones as they fall; carry hides to the Al Kharid bank only if you want them for Crafting later.

hints.note: Pin the style on Defensive: every point of damage dealt pays 4 Defence xp (+1.33 Hitpoints) and grants an invisible +3 Defence boost.
Hides are optional cargo - skip them if inventory churn slows kills.
The windmill herd is the quiet spot.

label: Bank: withdraw the Barbarian Village loadout
detail: At Edgeville bank equip your best melee gear and withdraw a small stack of cheap cooked food (count ??) - or bring none and fish trout at the river spots beside the village longhall instead.

label: Go to Barbarian Village
detail: Head to the hut cluster around the bridge midway along the Varrock-Falador road, just south of Edgeville; barbarians (combat 8-17) spawn in and around the longhall.

label: Kill barbarians on Defensive until Defence 40
detail: Fight the barbarians in and around the longhall with the style pinned on Defensive until Defence 40. When health runs low, fish trout at the river spots beside the village and cook them on the longhall fire - zero bank trips.

hints.note: Pin the style on Defensive: every point of damage dealt pays 4 Defence xp (+1.33 Hitpoints) and grants an invisible +3 Defence boost.
Trout spot + range are adjacent - restock food between kill sets (same spot the fishing/cooking bands use).

label: Bank: deposit the Barbarian Village loot
detail: Run back north to Edgeville bank and deposit the bones, coins, and any stray gear drops before the next band's Stronghold trip.

label: Bank: withdraw a light Stronghold food load
detail: At Edgeville bank equip your best melee gear and withdraw a part-inventory of cheap cooked food (count ??); the level-2 monsters hit low, so one load lasts a long session. No special items - the doors only ask security questions.

label: Descend to Stronghold of Security level 2 (Catacomb of Famine)
detail: Climb down the hole in the centre of Barbarian Village, cross the Vault of War to the next ladder, and stop on level 2. Each gated door asks an account-security question - any correct answer opens it.

hints.note: Security-question doors; any of the listed correct answers opens them.

label: Kill Flesh Crawlers on Defensive until Defence 60
detail: Stand in a crawler room with the style pinned on Defensive and let the level 28/35/41 Flesh Crawlers and 30/44/53 zombies pile on - they hit low, so cheap food carries you. Keep the herb drops (they pay for the trip) and claim the floor's one-time coin reward while passing. Stay until Defence 60.

hints.note: Pin the style on Defensive: every point of damage dealt pays 4 Defence xp (+1.33 Hitpoints) and grants an invisible +3 Defence boost.
Let aggro stack; leaving and re-entering the floor resets it.
Crawler herb drops are the floor's payday.
Spawn layout is identical on every world.

label: Alt: assigned Slayer tasks on Defensive until Defence 60
detail: Instead of camping the Stronghold, work through assigned Slayer tasks with the style pinned on Defensive until Defence 60 - kept from the coarse row's own alternatives; pair it with the route's Slayer band for a concrete assigner.

hints.note: Task rolls vary; not concretely locatable without a specific assigner.

label: Bank: deposit the Stronghold loot
detail: Climb back out of the Stronghold and deposit the grimy herbs, runes, coins, and ashes at Edgeville bank.

label: Bank: withdraw a three-valuables Wilderness loadout
detail: At Edgeville bank take only three valuable items - weapon, dragon defender, slayer helm - and fill the rest with cheap kit: climbing boots, dragonhide armour, amulet of glory, food (count ??), and a burning amulet for deep-Wilderness tasks. Protect Item prayer covers a fourth valuable if you run it.

hints.note: Weapon + dragon defender + slayer helm; everything else must be cheap and losable.

label: Get a Wilderness task from Krystilia
detail: Speak to Krystilia in the Edgeville guardhouse jail, north-east of the bank, and take an Assignment. She refuses anyone still Slayer level 1 - the Varrock Museum's Natural history quiz pays 1,000 Slayer xp (level 9) if you need to clear that bar. She warns she assigns any monster regardless of your combat level.

hints.note: Unwanted, unskippable tasks can be wiped by Turael - but that resets the 5-task Wilderness point streak.

label: Kill Krystilia's task in the Wilderness on Defensive until Defence 70
detail: Hunt the assigned monster inside the Wilderness with the style pinned on Defensive. Only deaths that happen while you are physically in the Wilderness count - the Ferox Enclave interior does not. Set player-attack options to Hidden so you never skull by misclick, and keep an escape teleport ready below 30 Wilderness. Repeat task after task until Defence 70.

produces.slayer_points: 25 per task from the 5th streak task (125 every 10th)

hints.note: Pin the style on Defensive: every point of damage dealt pays 4 Defence xp (+1.33 Hitpoints) and grants an invisible +3 Defence boost.
Stops accidental skulling on another player.
Bad tasks slow the band; blocking costs 100 points, a Turael wipe resets the point streak.
Every kill also pays Slayer xp and points toward later blocks/unlocks - the page's reason to pick this over pure camping.

label: Bank: deposit the task loot, then re-task
detail: Between tasks teleport or run back to Edgeville bank, deposit Larran's keys and drop loot, restock food, and talk to Krystilia again for the next assignment.

hints.note: Loop def-05 -> def-06 -> def-07 until the band ends.

label: Alt: bank a Moss giant loadout
detail: At any bank withdraw food (count ??) and your best melee gear for the alternative Moss giant camp.

label: Alt: go to the Moss giants west of the Fishing Guild
detail: Walk to the riverside clearing just west of the Fishing Guild entrance - a surface spot with no key or quest gate, unlike the Catacombs of Kourend or Brimhaven Dungeon alternatives on the same page.

label: Alt: kill Moss giants on Defensive until Defence 70
detail: Camp the giants with the style pinned on Defensive until Defence 70. Every kill drops big bones - bury on the spot for Prayer xp or bank them for the Prayer band. Level 42, max hit 6, Crush attack style.

hints.note: Pin the style on Defensive: every point of damage dealt pays 4 Defence xp (+1.33 Hitpoints) and grants an invisible +3 Defence boost.
Big bones always drop - bank for Prayer training or bury on the spot.
Popular training spot; hop worlds if contested.

label: Alt: bank the Moss giant loot
detail: Deposit big bones, coins, and any weapon/armour drops at the nearest bank when the band ends.

label: Travel to Nightmare Zone (north of Yanille)
detail: Take the Minigame teleport straight to Nightmare Zone once you meet its five-quest entry bar; otherwise Watchtower teleport and run east, a Yanille player-owned house, fairy ring CLS or CIQ, or ring of dueling to Castle Wars and walk.

quests: Any 5 quests from the Nightmare Zone requirement list (Nightmare_Zone.s3)

hints.note: The Minigame teleport only works once the entry requirements are met.

label: Fund Dominic's coffer
detail: Deposit coins into Dominic's coffer beside the lobby, in multiples of 1,000 (long-session total ??); each dream's fee is drawn from the coffer when you drink the potion.

label: Stock overload and absorption doses at the barrels
detail: Spend reward points at the lobby barrels: overload is 1,500 points a dose, absorption 1,000; each barrel stores up to 255 doses and withdrawing before a dream is free. First visit ever? Run one game on super combat + prayer potions to seed points (the Strategies page's first-points routine).

hints.note: A 28-dose absorption inventory covers a long dream without delaying hits.

label: Start a hard customisable rumble with Dominic
detail: Talk to Dominic, pick the hard customisable rumble, and set the boss list: disable Glod, Elvarg, Corrupt Lizardman, Chronozon, and Barrelchest; never leave Dream Mentor bosses on while Desert Treasure I bosses are off (an 83.33% point penalty). Then drink the dream potion on the plinth.

hints.note: Cancel by talking to Dominic again before drinking - no fee lost.
Selection persists between dreams - set it once.

label: Defensive dream: kill bosses until Defence 80
detail: In the dream wearing Dharok's (best at 92+ Hitpoints) or Obsidian + Berserker necklace + Toktz-xil-ak, with the style pinned on Defensive so every damage point pays 4 Defence xp: drink an overload while at 51+ Hitpoints, wait out its damage ticks, then Guzzle (right-click - Eat only reaches 2) the dwarven rock cake to 1 Hitpoints and hold it by flicking Rapid Heal at least once a minute while absorption points soak every hit. Re-overload each 5-minute wear-off, re-cake after the spike, restock doses between dreams. Six hours is the hard session cap; repeat dreams until Defence 80.

items: Dharok's set OR Obsidian armour + Berserker necklace + Toktz-xil-ak OR Blood Moon set + Dual macuahuitl
dwarven rock cake or locator orb

hints.note: Pin the style on Defensive: every point of damage dealt pays 4 Defence xp (+1.33 Hitpoints) and grants an invisible +3 Defence boost.
Between one-minute Rapid Heal flicks this is low-attention play.
Flicking Rapid Heal stops passive regen from lifting you off 1 HP.
The page's own Defence-specific alternatives: a Venator bow on Long range here, or Ancient Magicks on Defensive against maniacal monkeys, which it rates faster for Defence than melee.

label: Withdraw the allotment-run loadout
detail: Rake, seed dibber, spade, 3 allotment seeds per patch (potato from level 1, onion at 5, cabbage at 7) and 1 compost per patch. Each of the three no-requirement sites (Falador, Catherby, Ardougne) has 2 allotment beds -- 6 patches, so 18 seeds + 6 compost per full run.

hints.note: s16's own per-site teleport ranking: Explorer's ring to the Falador patch, Camelot Teleport then run east for Catherby, Ardougne cloak for Ardougne.

mapMarkers.label: Ardougne allotments (north of East Ardougne, 2 patches)

label: Plant and compost potato/onion/cabbage allotments until Farming 17
detail: At each patch: rake, plant 3 seeds, treat with compost. Potato from level 1, switch to onion at 5 and cabbage at 7. Allotments mature on a ~10-minute cycle, so run the circuit during natural breaks in other training rather than standing at a patch.
