CORRECTION: the circuit is Falador-Catherby-Ardougne (the wiki's three no-requirement allotment sites) -- the inherited 'Lumbridge farm patches' claim has no grounding on any fetched page.

hints.note: RECURRING background loop, not a one-shot action -- XREF bg:bg-farm-allotment-setup rides the same cycle.

label: Harvest each mature patch and replant on the spot
detail: Harvest as soon as a patch is mature and replant immediately so no patch idles. 3 seeds are consumed per planting; an equipped amulet of bounty gives a chance to consume only 1.

hints.note: Yield scales with Farming level and compost tier; no flat per-patch number is stated on the fetched pages.

label: Deposit the produce at the nearest bank
detail: Bank surplus vegetables between circuit legs; keep any back that the route flags for Cooking or quest use.

label: Grow oak/willow saplings from seed ahead of the run
detail: Use each tree seed on a filled plant pot with a gardening trowel in your inventory, water the seedling, and wait -- seedlings finish growing into saplings even while banked, so batch these well ahead. Humidify (Magic 68 + Dream Mentor) waters a full inventory at once. Seed-grown saplings keep this loop gather/produce rather than GE-bought; tree-seed sourcing itself is not stated on the fetched page (??).

label: Withdraw the tree-run loadout
detail: One sapling per unlocked tree patch (oak until 30, willow after), the per-patch payment noted (oak: 1 basket of tomatoes; willow: 1 basket of apples), a spade, and the circuit teleports.

hints.note: s7's own Setup list: Lumbridge/Varrock/Falador teleports, Taverley house (or tab), slayer ring for the Gnome Stronghold patch; the 7th patch (Farming Guild) needs Farming 65 via skills necklace -- skip until unlocked.

label: Each growth cycle: check, pay to fell, and replant every tree patch until Farming 35
detail: Check the grown tree's health for the xp dump (oak 467.3, willow 1,456.5), pay the gardener 200 coins to chop it, replant the next sapling, and hand over the protection payment so the tree cannot die. Oak grows in 3h20m, willow in 4h -- a full run is ~5 active minutes, so do other route content between runs. Willow unlocks at 30: swap tiers on the first run after hitting it.

hints.note: RECURRING passive loop -- s7 calls tree runs the fastest effective Farming xp and the skill's first priority; only the ~5-minute check/replant run is active time.

label: Alt: add apple/banana fruit trees to the same trips
detail: From 27 plant apple trees (pay 9 sweetcorn, check xp 1,199.5), from 33 bananas (pay 4 baskets of apples, check 1,750.5) at the fruit patches (Catherby, Brimhaven, Lletya) on a 16-hour cycle -- checked during the regular circuit, not a dedicated trip.

hints.note: Same trip as tf35-02's circuit -- the Catherby fruit patch sits by the Camelot landing; Brimhaven reached via Ardougne teleport + Captain Barnaby per s7's own quest list.

label: Background: keep the allotment loop from the last band cycling
detail: Same Falador-Catherby-Ardougne allotment loop as tfb-02, continued into this band on its ~10-minute timer while tree saplings grow.

hints.note: RECURRING -- continuation of tfb-02-plant-allotment-crops, not a new loop.

label: Grow willow/maple saplings from seed ahead of the run
detail: Tree seed on a filled plant pot (gardening trowel in inventory), water the seedling, wait; saplings finish growing even in the bank. Batch enough for every patch on the circuit.

label: Withdraw the tree-run loadout
detail: One sapling per patch (willow until 45, maple after), payments noted (willow: 1 basket of apples; maple: 1 basket of oranges per patch), spade, circuit teleports.

hints.note: s7's own Setup list: Lumbridge/Varrock/Falador teleports, Taverley house (or tab), slayer ring for the Gnome Stronghold patch; the 7th patch (Farming Guild) needs Farming 65 via skills necklace -- skip until unlocked.

label: Each growth cycle: check, pay to fell, and replant every tree patch until Farming 50
detail: Check health (maple pays 3,403.4 per check; growth 5h20m), pay 200 coins to fell, replant, pay protection. Maple unlocks at 45, ten levels into the band -- willow carries 35-45, swap on the first run after 45. ~5 active minutes per run.

hints.note: RECURRING. farm-ranarr-patch and farm-herb-patch-guam (existing steps.jsonl rows, prayer-pot-supply chain) already run herb patches on the same circuit shape and add passive Farming xp -- run them concurrently rather than re-authoring a herb loop here (U8).

label: Alt: watermelon allotments on the herb-run legs
detail: From 47, plant watermelons (54.5 xp per harvested melon) in the allotment beds beside each herb patch on the same trip, and keep nasturtiums in the flower patch -- they protect watermelons outright so yield is the only variable.

hints.note: Rides the farm-ranarr-patch herb circuit -- same teleports, adjacent beds; not a dedicated trip.

label: Grow maple/yew saplings from seed ahead of the run
detail: Tree seed on a filled plant pot (gardening trowel in inventory), water, wait; saplings finish growing even banked. Add mahogany/camphor saplings here too if running the hardwood alt.

label: Withdraw the tree-run loadout
detail: One sapling per patch (maple until 60, yew after), payments noted (maple: 1 basket of oranges; yew: 10 cactus spines per patch), spade, circuit teleports; add the skills necklace once 65 unlocks the Farming Guild patch.

hints.note: s7's own Setup list: Lumbridge/Varrock/Falador teleports, Taverley house (or tab), slayer ring for the Gnome Stronghold patch; the 7th patch (Farming Guild) needs Farming 65 via skills necklace -- skip until unlocked.

label: Each growth cycle: check, pay to fell, and replant every tree patch until Farming 70
detail: Check health (yew pays 7,069.9 per check; growth 6h40m), pay 200 coins to fell, replant, pay protection. Yew unlocks at 60 mid-band -- maple carries 50-60. ~5 active minutes per run; everything else is downtime for other content.

hints.note: RECURRING passive loop; s7: fastest effective xp in the skill.

label: Alt: ranarr/snapdragon herb runs on the 80-minute loop
detail: Plant ranarr (32) -- swapping to snapdragon at 62 (harvest 98.5/herb) -- with ultracompost at every herb patch on the standard 80-minute circuit. From 61 also swap the adjacent allotment legs to snape grass (82 xp per spike) and the flowers to white lilies, which protect all allotments.

hints.note: Same circuit/travel pattern as the existing farm-ranarr-patch background row -- run concurrently with the tree loop, not as a separate trip.
s16: ultracompost minimises disease and with magic secateurs ensures a minimum of 6 herbs per seed.

label: Alt: hardwood run -- mahogany, then camphor at 66
detail: Plant mahogany (55, pay 25 yanillian hops, check 15,720) then camphor (66, pay 10 white berries, check 17,840) at the hardwood patches; growth is ~85 hours, so check them every few days when passing. Patch access: 3 on Fossil Island behind Bone Voyage (digsite pendant), 1 in Varlamore behind The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute, 1 at Anglers' Retreat (Sailing 51).

label: Grow yew/magic saplings from seed ahead of the run
detail: Tree seed on a filled plant pot (gardening trowel in inventory), water, wait; saplings keep growing banked. Add calquat (72), celastrus (85) and redwood (90) saplings as those unlock for the add-on patches.

label: Withdraw the tree-run loadout
detail: One sapling per patch (yew until 75, magic after), payments noted (yew: 10 cactus spines; magic: 25 coconuts per patch), spade, circuit teleports; skills necklace for the Farming Guild patch (65), eternal teleport crystal for Prifddinas after Song of the Elves, ring of wealth for the GE spirit tree leg.

hints.note: s7's own Setup list: Lumbridge/Varrock/Falador teleports, Taverley house (or tab), slayer ring for the Gnome Stronghold patch; the 7th patch (Farming Guild) needs Farming 65 via skills necklace -- skip until unlocked.

label: Each growth cycle: check, pay to fell, and replant every tree patch until Farming 99
detail: Check health (magic pays 13,768.3 per check; growth 8h), pay 200 coins to fell, replant, pay protection (Falador Park never gets diseased after the elite Falador Diary). FLAG: methods[0] 'Tree runs (magic)' is a continuity label -- magic unlocks at 75, five levels into the band, so run yew 70-75 then swap. From 72 also add the calquat patch (pay 8 poison ivy berries, check 12,096).

hints.note: RECURRING passive loop; s7: ~5 active minutes per run, 1-2 runs per day, still the fastest effective xp in the skill -- 99 in roughly 3-4 months of consistent runs.

label: Alt (MINIGAME): run Tithe Farm rounds until Farming 99
detail: Bring only a spade, seed dibber (or bare-handed planting from Barbarian Training) and 6-8 watering cans (or the 1,000-dose Gricoller's can once bought). Pick up to 10,000 of the best seeds you can plant from the table inside -- Golovanova at 34, Bologano at 54, Logavano at 74 -- then plant, water each plant three times (before minutes 1, 2 and 3) or it wilts, harvest at 3 minutes, and deposit the fruit into the sacks. Do NOT leave through the door mid-session: it resets the game and removes seeds/fruit (points and xp already earned persist).

hints.note: Deposit in full 100s: the 75th fruit pays a 250x bonus (5,750 xp on Logavano), fruits 75-100 pay double xp, and the 100th adds 2 bonus points; 1 point per 3 fruits otherwise.
Minigame teleport works after your first visit; otherwise Xeric's talisman to Xeric's Glade and run south-east, or fairy ring AKR to the Hosidius Vinery and go south.

Active change-of-pace block: s20 frames Tithe Farm as xp gained BETWEEN patch growth cycles or as a seed-free training alternative -- slot 1hr+ sessions between tree runs per the round-robin philosophy.

label: Alt: torstol herb runs on the 80-minute loop
detail: From 85, plant torstol with ultracompost at every herb patch (plant 199.5, harvest 224.5 per herb) on the same 80-minute circuit shape as farm-ranarr-patch; this is the page's named herb for paying back tree-run costs.

hints.note: Rides the same herb-run teleports as farm-ranarr-patch (U8 circuit reuse) -- not a dedicated trip.

label: Alt: add celastrus and redwood to the tree run
detail: At 85 plant celastrus (pay 8 potato cactus; check 14,130, then harvest the bark -- ~9 barks with ultracompost, s7 flags it as worth the extra time) and at 90 redwood (pay 6 dragonfruit; check 22,450; 2,000 coins to remove) in the special patches on the same circuit.

hints.note: Add-on legs of the same run as tf99-02, not an alternative to it (own alt_group so it never excludes the primary loop or Tithe Farm).

label: Buy a tinderbox from the Varrock General Store
detail: No bank setup needed for this band -- just a tinderbox and an axe. Tinderboxes are sold in most general stores; the Varrock General Store sits in the town centre between the two banks. Skip this if you already own one.

mapMarkers.label: Varrock General Store (centroid of the shop's {{Map|mtype=polygon}} footprint)

label: Go to the Varrock fountain, your burn line's starting tile
detail: The page's easy row spot: light the first log at the fountain and burn a row westward, banking at Varrock west bank. Cast Varrock Teleport to land right there if you have it.

hints.note: Page names Varrock Teleport for this spot; Camelot Teleport + Seers' Village bank is its stated alternative row location.

label: Chop regular trees around the plaza until your inventory is full of logs
detail: Any regular tree works and each gives exactly one log, so chop the cluster nearest your row. Refill the same way every time the burn line empties your pack.

hints.note: This same chopping is the Woodcutting 1-15 band's method -- both bands progress at once (XREF: train-woodcutting-15).

label: Light your logs in a row from the fountain westward until Firemaking 15
detail: Use the tinderbox on a log, step one tile west as it catches, light the next -- the row burns east to west so you never stand on a fire. When the inventory empties, re-chop (fm-03) and lay another row.

hints.note: Low-level lights can fail; the page's rate footnotes budget time lost to failed attempts. Firelighter-coloured logs (methods[1]) always light first try.
The page's premier row spot is the east side of the Grand Exchange -- bank one tile from burnable ground; use it if the fountain row is crowded.

label: Go to the oak trees just east of the Draynor Village bank
detail: No bank setup needed -- carry only your axe and tinderbox. The oaks stand right beside the bank; watch for the aggressive level 26 jail guards patrolling this patch if your combat is low.

label: Chop the Draynor oaks until your inventory is full of oak logs
detail: Oaks give multiple logs per tree, so one or two trees fill a pack. Refill here every time your burn row runs dry.

hints.note: Same trees as the Woodcutting 15-30 band -- the page calls oaks the fastest WC xp all the way to 35 (XREF: train-woodcutting-30).

label: Burn your oak logs in rows on the open ground beside the bank until Firemaking 30
detail: Light a log, step one tile along, light the next -- rows burn away from you. Re-chop (fm-06) whenever the pack empties; the trees are a few steps from the burn line so no banking is needed.

label: Go to the willows just south of the Draynor Village bank
detail: No bank setup needed -- carry only your axe and tinderbox. Five willows sit a few steps south of the bank; below combat 15, beware the aggressive level 7 dark wizards nearby.

label: Chop willows until your inventory is full of willow logs
detail: Willows regrow fast and give multiple logs each. Refill here whenever your burn row runs dry.

hints.note: Same trees as the Woodcutting 30-45 band -- both bands progress at once (XREF: train-woodcutting-45).

label: Burn willow logs in rows beside the Draynor bank until Firemaking 45
detail: Light, step one tile, light the next; re-chop when the pack empties. The fastest-table ladder swaps to teak at 35 and arctic pine at 42, but chopping those yourself needs WC 35 at remote hardwoods / WC 54 -- the page's own cheaper progression keeps willows to 45, which is exactly what self-supplied logs support.

label: Move to Seers' Village bank for the maple stretch
detail: Bank here and keep only axe + tinderbox. Seven maples flank the bank (four north, three south) and the page names Seers' Village as a burn-row banking spot.

hints.note: The page's stated route: Camelot Teleport, bank at Seers' Village.

label: Chop the bank-side maples until your inventory is full of maple logs
detail: Needs Woodcutting 45. Four maples north and three south of the bank -- refill here each time the burn row empties.

hints.note: Maples are the Woodcutting 45-60 band's continuity method -- both bands progress at once (XREF: train-woodcutting-60).

label: Burn maple logs in rows beside the Seers' bank until Firemaking 50
detail: Same rhythm: light, step one tile, light the next; re-chop (fm-12) when empty. 200,475 xp/hr per the page's 45-50 maple bracket.

label: Keep the Seers' maple chop-and-burn loop running until Firemaking 60
detail: No new setup -- same trees, same burn rows as the last band (chop the seven bank-side maples full, burn in a row, repeat). The page's own cheap ladder keeps maples to 60; its fastest-table pick for 50-60 is mahogany, which means remote members hardwood chopping instead (see methods).

label: Move to the eight yews south of the Seers' flax field
detail: No bank loadout beyond axe + tinderbox. Eight yews stand south of the flax field with the Catherby bank an easy run east.

hints.note: If the yews are contested: Woodcutting Guild has 9 yews, an invisible +7 WC boost and a bank chest; Varrock Palace has 3 yews with the GE nearby.

label: Chop yews until your inventory is full of yew logs
detail: Needs Woodcutting 60. Yews are slow -- rotate between the eight trees and refill whenever the burn row runs dry.

hints.note: Yews are the Woodcutting 60-75 band's continuity method -- both bands progress at once (XREF: train-woodcutting-75).

label: Burn yew logs in rows until Firemaking 75
detail: Light, step one tile, light the next. 300,712 xp/hr per the page's 60-75 yew bracket. From 50 onward Wintertodt is the low-effort alternative (methods[3]); the full Wintertodt loop is written under the next band.

label: Bank: withdraw your Wintertodt loadout
detail: Withdraw an axe, knife, hammer, tinderbox (or bruma torch), at least four pieces of warm clothing to wear, and a few rejuvenation potions or food. Missing tools are no blocker -- almost everything is obtainable from the crates inside the Doors of Dinh.

label: Travel to the Wintertodt camp
detail: Games necklace is the fastest way in (needs one prior boat trip to Great Kourend with Veos); a bank chest sits in the tent just east of that landing -- note you must leave the fight area to use it mid-session. No-requirement fallback: switch to the Arceuus spellbook at Tyss and use the Arceuus Home Teleport.

hints.note: The Wintertodt page's own fast-to-slow ordering; the fairy ring and games necklace both require having reached Kourend once before.

mapMarkers.label: Games necklace landing, Wintertodt camp (map pin from Wintertodt's own {{Map}})
Lovakengj Minecart Network, Northern Tundras stop (map pin)

label: Run Wintertodt rounds -- light, chop, feed, repair -- until Firemaking 99
detail: Hop to an official Wintertodt world (307/309/311/389/402; ~4-minute rounds). Each round: light your brazier the moment it starts (6x level xp), chop bruma roots to a full inventory (0.3x WC xp each), feed the roots to the brazier (3x each), and fix (4x Construction, needs a POH) and relight the brazier whenever the Wintertodt breaks or snuffs it. Heal with rejuvenation potions -- brew them from the crate-supplied unf potions and bruma herbs, or have Brew'ma make them if Druidic Ritual isn't done.

hints.note: Reach 500+ points every round: subduing then pays a level x100 Firemaking bonus plus reward-cart loot. Only fletch roots into kindling (0.6x Fletching, 3.8x feed) when you'd otherwise miss 500 -- fletching everything significantly hampers xp/hr per the page.
The page's own downtime suggestions for the ~60s pause between rounds.

label: Search the reward cart for your owed loot between rounds
detail: Every 500 points banks at least two rewards in the cart (each further 500 = one more guaranteed, with the overflow giving a proportional chance of an extra; cart caps at 8,000 owed). Reward tiers scale to your skill levels at the moment you search -- herb/ore/fish/gem/seed/log tables key off Herblore, Mining, Fishing, Crafting, Farming and Woodcutting respectively.

hints.note: Rewards owed scale linearly with points past each 500 threshold; skill-scaled loot tables mean searching later (at higher levels) upgrades what the same owed rewards roll.

label: Buy a small fishing net from Gerrant's Fishy Business (Port Sarim)
detail: One-time purchase of the non-consumable level-1 net from Gerrant's fishing shop in Port Sarim (named F2P vendor, stock confirmed). Skip if you already own one.

label: Go to the Draynor Village net-fishing spot
detail: From Lumbridge follow the road west to Draynor Village; the net spot sits on the riverbank by the village. Lumbridge Swamp's shoreline spot is an equally-grounded F2P alternative if it is closer. No bank loadout needed — this is a drop-the-catch band.

label: Net shrimp/anchovies at the riverbank, dropping the catch, until Fishing 20
detail: Click the net fishing spot and keep netting; drop each full inventory in place — no bank trip is worth it at this level. If Sea Slug, Fishing Contest, and RFD-Freeing Pirate Pete are already on your route, their combined 10,612 quest xp alone covers this band (to roughly level 27) — see those quests' own atom tracks.

hints.note: Low-value catch; drop rather than bank. Bank a stack only if you want early Cooking xp next.

label: Bank: withdraw fly fishing rod + feather stack
detail: Withdraw a fly fishing rod and a stack of feathers; no food needed at this spot. If you don't own the rod yet, Gerrant's Fishy Business in Port Sarim sells it (level-20 F2P tool, one-time purchase).

label: Go to the Barbarian Village fly-fishing spot
detail: Fishing spot on the River Lum bank at Barbarian Village, beside the village's permanent fire.

label: Fly fish trout/salmon at the river spot until Fishing 40
detail: Lure-fish continuously with feathers. The village's permanent fire is steps away: cook each load and drop the cooked fish in place instead of banking (free Cooking xp, zero bank trips).

hints.note: Barbarian Village's permanent fire lets you cook+drop without banking.
No bank trips needed at 20-40 pace; bank the fish only if you want them for Cooking-range training later.

label: Alt: 3-tick fly fish trout/salmon (faster, click-intensive)
detail: Same spot, same loadout plus swamp tar and a suitable herb: start the cycle with herb-on-tar, click the fishing spot on the correct tick, repeat. 53,000 xp/h at level 40 vs 30,000 AFK, at the cost of constant precise clicking.

hints.note: Dropping each fish between catches (shift-drop) beats dropping full inventories on this rhythm.

label: Alt: fight Tempoross from Fishing 35 (low-intensity minigame)
detail: Board the boat at the sea spirit dock west of the Ruins of Unkah — Ferryman Sathwood's ferry south of Al Kharid bank is the fastest way there (mind the desert heat en route). Rope, bucket, hammer, and harpoon are all obtainable free at the cove. Skip cooking the harpoonfish for maximum Fishing xp.

hints.note: All routes end at the sea spirit dock west of the Ruins of Unkah; Sathwood's ferry sails straight there.

label: Bank: withdraw lobster pot + ferry coins
detail: Withdraw a lobster pot and coins for the Port Sarim-Karamja ferry (30 each way, several round trips). If you don't own a pot, Gerrant's Fishy Business in Port Sarim sells it (level-40 F2P tool) — the shop is right by the ferry dock.

label: Sail from Port Sarim to Karamja and walk to the plantation dock
detail: Take the ship from Port Sarim to Musa Point (30 coins), then walk to the small dock behind Luthas' banana plantation on the island's north shore — the cage spots are on the dock. Catherby's shore spot (members) is the closer-to-bank alternative if that side of the map is open.

label: Cage lobsters at the dock, banking full loads, until Fishing 58
detail: Cage continuously; when your inventory fills, sail back and drop the load in the bank deposit box on the Port Sarim dock (Fishing.s33 grounds the box), then return. Keep every lobster — the upcoming combat bands eat this food stock.

hints.note: Bank the catch -- it pays off as food stock for upcoming combat bands.

label: Alt: travel to Fossil Island and pay Ceto for underwater access
detail: Speak to Ceto on the northern shore of Fossil Island to enter the underwater area: 200 numulites per day, or 20,000 numulites for permanent access. Bring drift nets, flippers, fishbowl helmet, diving apparatus, and run-energy restores. Caveat: the page's only stated drift-net acquisition path is the Grand Exchange — no named non-GE vendor found, flagged rather than guessed.

label: Alt: drift net fish shoals underwater until Fishing 58
detail: Set drift nets on the anchors, then click each fish shoal once to chase it toward the nets, prioritising shoals nearest a net. A net fills after 10 shoals — reset it and repeat. Optionally bank a full net's catch for 5 numulites (slightly lower xp).

hints.note: Also trains Hunter simultaneously at a higher xp/h than Fishing at these levels -- switch off once Hunter no longer needs the levels.

label: Bank: withdraw harpoon
detail: Withdraw a harpoon — or fish bare-handed if you've done the relevant part of Barbarian Training (the page's own note). First-time harpoon purchase: Gerrant's Fishy Business, Port Sarim.

label: Go to the Catherby swordfish/tuna spot
detail: Shore spot at Catherby, a short walk from the town bank — bank each full load and return.

label: Harpoon swordfish/tuna, banking each load, until Fishing 70
detail: Harpoon continuously and bank full loads at the adjacent Catherby bank. No tick manipulation required.

hints.note: Swordfish extend the combat food stock started by the lobster band; tuna is optional keep.

label: Alt: AFK Barbarian Fishing at Otto's Grotto pond
detail: Grab a barbarian rod from Otto's Grotto (first trip only), bring feathers, and fish the pond next to the grotto, dropping the leaping fish. Needs Agility 30 + Strength 30 and partial Barbarian Training. 56,800 xp/h total at level 70 with passive Strength/Agility xp.

hints.note: Drop the catch at the pond; this is the low-effort AFK variant.

label: Alt: 2-tick harpoon at Port Piscarilius (fastest from 61)
detail: Lure two rats west of the Port Piscarilius bank so they auto-retaliate on you every 2 ticks; equip an ammo-less shortbow and click the fishing spot on the tick a hitsplat lands — a catch chance every 2 ticks instead of 5. The page's Fishing Guild PvP-world variant (~5% faster, using a second account's darts) carries PK risk.

hints.note: Drop between catches to hold the 2-tick rhythm.

label: Bank: withdraw 3-tick Barbarian Fishing loadout
detail: Withdraw the barbarian rod, feathers, herb + swamp tar (or a knife + teak/mahogany logs) for the 3-tick cycle, and a knife if cut-eating. The rod itself comes from Otto's Grotto — grab it there on your first trip.

label: Go to the pond next to Otto's Grotto
detail: Teleport to Barbarian Assault (games necklace or Minigame Teleport) and run south-west to the pond beside Otto's Grotto — the page's own fastest route.

hints.note: Both land at Barbarian Assault; run south-west from there.

label: 3-tick cut-eat leaping salmon/sturgeon until Fishing 99
detail: Run the 3-tick cycle: start with herb-on-tar, then keep the cycle alive by cutting each leaping fish with the knife and eating the roe/caviar; when out of fish to cut, restart with herb-on-tar. Fish offcuts from cutting double as free bait. Simpler variant: skip the knife and just shift-drop each fish between catches.

hints.note: Cut-eating grants passive Cooking xp (~80 Cooking recommended for a 100% cut rate on salmon/sturgeon) plus the leaping fish's passive Strength/Agility xp.
Less intensive: fish at Mount Quidamortem and bank at the Chambers of Xeric chest (fish barrel for longer trips); otherwise drop at the pond.

label: Alt: bank — withdraw harpoon (crystal recommended)
detail: Withdraw a harpoon; the crystal harpoon's faster catch rate makes it the recommended tier for 2-tick fishing at this stage.

label: Alt: go to the Port Piscarilius harpoon spot
detail: Shore spot west of the Port Piscarilius bank; the 2-tick rat-lure setup happens here.

label: Alt: 2-tick harpoon swordfish/tuna until Fishing 99
detail: Lure two rats so they auto-retaliate on you every 2 ticks, equip an ammo-less shortbow, and click the fishing spot on the tick a hitsplat lands — a catch chance every 2 ticks instead of 5. Up to 137,000 xp/h at 99 with good practice. (Page note: 2-tick harpooning sharks is on average the fastest route to the heron pet, if chasing it.)

hints.note: Drop between catches to hold the 2-tick rhythm.

label: Alt: board the boat to Tempoross Cove
detail: Board at the sea spirit dock west of the Ruins of Unkah — Ferryman Sathwood's ferry south of Al Kharid bank sails straight there (mind the desert heat en route). Rope, bucket, hammer, and harpoon are all obtainable free at the cove; join a populated world for full-team subdues.

hints.note: Fastest-to-slowest per the page's own Transportation list.

label: Alt: subdue Tempoross repeatedly until Fishing 99
detail: Each round: fish harpoonfish and load them as cannon ammunition to drain Tempoross's energy, then fish the energised fish to drain its essence; repeat subdues round after round. Skipping the cooking step trades points/loot for more Fishing xp — up to 95,000 xp/h at 99 with a crystal harpoon.

hints.note: Cooking the harpoonfish instead lowers xp/h but raises points/loot -- better for reward-pool uniques (fish barrel, tome of water, dragon harpoon).

label: Alt: buy sandworms/diabolic worms from Tynan's Fishing Supplies
detail: Buy sandworms (or diabolic worms for the faster rate) from Tynan's Fishing Supplies in Port Piscarilius — the page's named non-GE vendor, right by the anglerfish spot.

label: Alt: rod-fish anglerfish with sandworms until Fishing 99
detail: From level 82, fish the Port Piscarilius anglerfish spot with a fishing rod and sandworms, banking loads at the adjacent bank; diabolic worms lift the rate to ~39,000 xp/h by 99. Slower than the tick methods but near-AFK and stocks high-tier combat food.

hints.note: Bank everything -- anglerfish are endgame combat food.

label: Buy 1 knife from the Lumbridge General Store (one-time fletching tool)
detail: Any general store stocks knives; Lumbridge's carries 5 with fast restock. Buy one, keep it forever -- every fletching loop in every later band uses this same knife. A fletching knife (if you own one) cuts bows in 2 ticks instead of 3.

label: Bank: withdraw the knife and a full load of own-cut normal logs
detail: Knife + 27 normal logs per load (own-cut, never bought; ~233 logs covers 1-10). Optional: feathers to finish shafts into headless arrows at 15 xp per action -- Gerrant's Fishy Business in Port Sarim stocks 1,000 feathers if you want that finisher.

label: Cut logs into arrow shafts at the bank until Fletching 10
detail: Use the knife on a log, select arrow shafts, cut the whole inventory, rebank, repeat. 5 xp per log, ~10,000 xp/hr at 2,000 cuts/hour; the page's own count is 233 logs for 1-10. Shafts stack, so deposits are rare.

label: Cut logs into longbows (u) at the bank until Fletching 20
detail: Same loop, new product: from 10, cut each log into a longbow (u) -- 10 xp each, 18,000/hr plain or 27,000/hr with a fletching knife; 332 logs covers 10-20. (Shortbows (u) open at 5 if you got there before finishing the shaft stack.) Deposit each full inventory of bows.

label: Bank: deposit the arrow shafts and unstrung bows
detail: Keep the knife. The banked (u) bows can be strung later for extra xp (bow string is a members item, spun from flax at Crafting 10) or sold to shops -- never needed again for this band.

label: Chop and bank 788 oak logs at any oak cluster beside a bank
detail: Oaks are common near most banks; chop full inventories and deposit until 788 are banked (205 for 20-25 + 583 for 25-35, the table's own logs-for-goal counts, assuming you start at exactly 20). WC 15 to chop oaks per the Woodcutting rates table.

hints.note: This route's own Woodcutting oak band banks these exact logs -- fletch that stock before chopping extra.

label: Bank: withdraw the knife and 27 oak logs per load
detail: Stand at the bank booth; each load is knife + 27 logs, cut, deposit bows, repeat.

label: Cut oak logs into oak shortbows (u) until Fletching 25
detail: 16.5 xp per bow; 29,700 xp/hr plain, 44,550 with a fletching knife. 205 logs covers 20-25.

label: Switch product to oak longbows (u) at 25; cut until Fletching 35
detail: Same oak loadout, no bank trip to switch -- just pick the longbow option: 25 xp per bow; 45,000 xp/hr plain, 67,500 with a fletching knife. 583 logs covers 25-35.

label: Chop and bank 445 willow logs at any willows beside a bank
detail: 445 willow logs covers 35-40 per the table's logs-for-goal column. WC 30 to chop willows.

hints.note: This route's own Woodcutting willow band banks these exact logs -- fletch that stock before chopping extra.

label: Bank: withdraw the knife and 27 willow logs per load
detail: Material switch from oak to willow; same bank-side rhythm.

label: Cut willow logs into willow shortbows (u) until Fletching 40
detail: 33.3 xp per bow; 59,940 xp/hr plain, 89,910 with a fletching knife. 445 logs covers 35-40.

label: Bank: deposit the unstrung oak and willow bows
detail: Bank the (u) bows -- string later (members: bow string) or sell to shops; keep the knife.

label: Chop and bank 1,545 willow logs at any willows beside a bank
detail: 1,545 willow logs covers 40-50 per the table's logs-for-goal column (WC 30). Chop full loads, deposit, repeat.

hints.note: This route's own Woodcutting willow band banks these exact logs -- fletch that stock before chopping extra.

label: Bank: withdraw the knife and 27 willow logs per load
detail: Optional stringing variant: withdraw 14 willow longbows (u) + 14 bow strings per load instead once bows are banked -- bow strings are members-only, spun from flax at Crafting 10.

label: Cut willow logs into willow longbows (u) until Fletching 50
detail: 41.5 xp per bow; 74,700 xp/hr plain, 112,050 with a fletching knife, 101,675 stringing. 1,545 logs covers 40-50.

label: Chop and bank 1,307 maple logs at any maples beside a bank
detail: 1,307 maple logs covers 50-55 per the table's logs-for-goal column. WC 45 to chop maples.

hints.note: This route's own Woodcutting maple band banks these exact logs -- fletch that stock before chopping extra.

label: Bank: withdraw the knife and 27 maple logs per load
detail: Material switch from willow to maple; same bank-side rhythm.

label: Cut maple logs into maple shortbows (u) until Fletching 55
detail: 50 xp per bow; 90,000 xp/hr plain, 135,000 with a fletching knife. 1,307 logs covers 50-55.

label: Bank: deposit the unstrung willow and maple bows
detail: Bank the (u) bows for later stringing or shop-selling; keep the knife.

label: Harvest celastrus bark from your Farming Guild celastrus tree (alt path)
detail: Optional alternative to both bow loops -- pick one path. Plant a celastrus sapling in the Farming Guild's high-tier patch (Farming 85; pay the farmer 8 potato cacti to protect it), then chop the grown tree with an axe: minimum 3 bark per tree, more with ultracompost, magic secateurs, and higher Farming. ~1,618 bark covers 40-55 at 80 xp each (129,412 xp band).

hints.note: Yield is variable (min 3 per tree); compost/secateurs/Farming level raise it, nature offerings do not.

label: Cut celastrus bark into battlestaves until Fletching 55 (alt loop, runs to 80)
detail: Use the knife on bark at the bank: 80 xp each; 110,000 xp/hr plain, 143,000 with a fletching knife. One table row spans 40-80 (24,361 bark total), so this same loop can carry straight through the next two bands without a product switch. Bank each full inventory of staves as you go.

label: Chop and bank 4,851 maple logs at any maples beside a bank
detail: 4,851 maple logs covers 55-65 per the table's logs-for-goal column (WC 45). A long stock-up -- interleave with the fletch loop in chunks if you prefer; the per-iteration banking stays inside each loop.

hints.note: This route's own Woodcutting maple band banks these exact logs -- fletch that stock before chopping extra.

label: Bank: withdraw the knife and 27 maple logs per load
detail: Or, for the stringing variant: 14 maple longbows (u) + 14 bow strings per load (members; strings spun from flax at Crafting 10). Alt: keep running the celastrus battlestaff loop from the 40-55 band instead -- it spans to 80 without switching.

label: Cut maple logs into maple longbows (u) until Fletching 65
detail: 58.3 xp per bow; 104,940 xp/hr plain, 157,410 with a fletching knife, 142,835 stringing. 4,851 logs covers 55-65.

label: Chop and bank 4,270 yew logs at any yews beside a bank
detail: 4,270 yew logs covers 65-70 per the table's logs-for-goal column. WC 60 to chop yews.

hints.note: This route's own Woodcutting yew band banks these exact logs -- fletch that stock before chopping extra.

label: Bank: withdraw the knife and 27 yew logs per load
detail: Material switch from maple to yew; same bank-side rhythm.

label: Cut yew logs into yew shortbows (u) until Fletching 70
detail: 67.5 xp per bow; 121,500 xp/hr plain, 182,250 with a fletching knife, 165,375 stringing. 4,270 logs covers 65-70.

label: Bank: deposit the unstrung maple and yew bows
detail: Bank the (u) bows for later stringing or shop-selling; keep the knife.

label: Chop and bank 16,646 yew logs at any yews beside a bank
detail: 16,646 yew logs covers 70-80 per the table's logs-for-goal column (WC 60). Interleave stock-up chunks with the fletch loop rather than front-loading it all.

hints.note: This route's own Woodcutting yew band banks these exact logs -- fletch that stock before chopping extra.

From Fletching 95, dart sets are zero-tick: 10 dragon dart tips + 10 feathers = 250 xp, two clicks, no movement interruption -- fletch them during questing, Agility, Hunter, farm runs, Slayer, or Wintertodt. Tips cannot be smithed (dragon implings/drops); Tourist Trap is NOT needed to fletch darts.
Since Easter 2023 the default routes dart fletching through a crafting menu -- flip the account setting for two-click fletching, or enable Make-X (10 sets per action) for the low-click variant.

label: Bank: withdraw the knife and 27 yew logs per load
detail: Bank-side loop: cut a full load into longbows (u), deposit, repeat.

label: Cut yew logs into yew longbows (u) until Fletching 80
detail: 75 xp per bow; 135,000 xp/hr plain, 202,500 with a fletching knife, 183,750 stringing. 16,646 logs covers 70-80.

label: Chop and bank 15,277 magic logs (members trees, WC 75)
detail: 15,277 magic logs covers 80-85 per the table's logs-for-goal column. Magic logs are members-only; WC 75 to chop.

hints.note: This route's own Woodcutting magic band banks these exact logs -- fletch that stock before chopping extra.

label: Bank: withdraw the knife and 27 magic logs per load
detail: Bridge tier: magic shortbows (u) fill the gap between yew longbow's 80 ceiling and magic longbow's 85 floor.

label: Cut magic logs into magic shortbows (u) until Fletching 85
detail: 83.3 xp per bow; 149,940 xp/hr plain, 224,910 with a fletching knife, 203,350 stringing. 15,277 logs covers 80-85.

label: Chop and bank magic logs for the 85-99 stretch (up to 106,840)
detail: The table's own count for 85-99 is 106,840 bows = 106,840 logs -- gather in rolling chunks alongside the fletch/string loop, not as one monolithic stock-up.

hints.note: This route's own Woodcutting magic band banks these exact logs -- fletch that stock before chopping extra.

label: Spin flax into bow strings at a wheel near a bank (1 per bow)
detail: Pick flax (Seers' Village field, Lletya, Land's End, or Gnome Stronghold) and spin at a wheel: Crafting 10, 15 Crafting xp each; ~840-1,344 strings/hr depending on spot, Lumbridge Castle's top-floor bank wheel being the classic pre-picked route. Alternatives the page names: Temple Trekking rewards ~3,000-5,000 strings/hr with minimal stats; Spin Flax (Lunar, Magic 76) reaches ~6,000/hr.

hints.note: A bow string spool lets you string 27 bows per inventory instead of 14 -- about 3% more xp/hr from fewer bank trips; bales of flax feed the spool directly at Seers' Village.

label: Bank: withdraw knife + magic logs, or 14 bows (u) + 14 strings per load
detail: Two alternating load shapes: fletch loads (knife + 27 magic logs) build the (u) stock; string loads (14 magic longbows (u) + 14 bow strings, or 27 + spool) convert it. Stringing is 2-tick -- 16.8 seconds per inventory.

label: Cut magic logs into magic longbows (u), keeping pace with stringing
detail: 91.5 xp per bow; 164,700 xp/hr plain, 247,050 with a fletching knife. Runs interleaved with the stringing loop below -- stock (u) bows a few loads ahead.

label: String magic longbows until Fletching 99
detail: Use bow string on magic longbow (u): 224,175 xp/hr at 2,450 strings/hour. Alternate string loads with fletch loads until 99; 106,840 bows covers 85-99.

label: Bank: deposit the strung magic longbows
detail: Deposit each strung load; the finished bows are the band's sellable/alchable output.

label: Chop and bank redwood logs, two per shield (members, WC 90; alt path)
detail: Optional alternative from Fletching 92: 30,173 shields = 60,346 redwood logs for 92-99 per the table's own counts. Redwood logs are members-only, WC 90 to chop.

label: Cut redwood log pairs into redwood shields until Fletching 99 (alt loop)
detail: 216 xp per shield (2 logs each, 13 shields per load); 168,000 xp/hr plain, 193,000 with a fletching knife -- the page's fastest late alternative to bows. Bank each load of shields as you go.

label: Bank: withdraw a full inventory of grimy guam leaves
detail: Stand at any bank and withdraw 28 grimy guam leaves per load. Stock comes from your own guam herb-patch runs (reuse step farm-herb-patch-guam) or banked monster-drop herbs -- never the GE. From Herblore 5 you can mix grimy marrentill loads in (3.8 xp each vs guam's 2.5).

hints.note: Full-inventory loads; deposit cleans and re-withdraw in one bank cycle.

label: Click-clean grimy guam leaves at the bank until Herblore 10
detail: Click each grimy guam individually (2.5 xp per herb): a fast clicker clears 10,000+ herbs an hour per the page. One click also auto-cleans the whole inventory since the 2020 update, but that route caps near 3,000 herbs/hour -- roughly 30% of the manual rate -- so keep clicking per-herb. Deposit the clean herbs (they feed later potion bands), withdraw the next 28, repeat until Herblore 10.

hints.note: Bank every cleaned herb -- they are the unf-potion inputs for the 10-38 band.
Herb cleaning is pure clicking at a bank -- pair it with any idle wait (page tip: touchscreens work well for long sessions).

label: Buy eye of newt (and packs) from Betty's Magic Emporium, Port Sarim
detail: Walk into Betty's Magic Emporium on the Port Sarim high street and buy eye of newt -- base stock is 300 loose plus 60 'eye of newt pack' items for batched buying (one eye per attack potion; restock every 10s/50s). This is the standard non-GE source.

hints.note: Packs batch the purchase; shop restocks fast enough that one visit covers a long mixing session.

label: Bank: withdraw 14 clean guam + 14 vials of water and mix them unfinished
detail: Withdraw 14 guam leaves (cleaned in the last band) and 14 vials of water, then use a guam on a vial and make the whole set of guam potions (unf). Vials come from Jatix's Herblore Shop in Taverley or self-filled at any water source (reuse step pps-04-source-vials) -- never the GE.

hints.note: Two half-inventories per load: herbs on the left, vials on the right, one combine click per set.

label: Mix attack potions (guam unf + eye of newt) until Herblore 12
detail: At the bank, use an eye of newt on each guam potion (unf) and confirm the make-all: 25 xp per potion, 62,500 xp/hour at the page's 2,500-potions rate. Deposit finished potions, withdraw the next 14+14 set, repeat until Herblore 12.

label: Stock limpwurt roots for strength potions (source ??)
detail: Strength potions need one limpwurt root each. A wiki-confirmed non-GE gather/vendor source was not in any fetched page -- ?? rather than a guess (limpwurt seeds do exist as a farm crop; verify on the item's own page before relying on it).

hints.note: Non-GE sourcing unverified by a fetched page -- inherited flag from the earlier train-herblore-38 contribution.

label: Mix strength potions (tarromin unf + limpwurt root) until Herblore 38
detail: Switch the loadout to 14 grimy tarromin (cleans at 11 for 5 xp each -- clean while the bank interface is open) + 14 vials, mix the unf set, then add a limpwurt root to each: 50 xp per potion, 125,000 xp/hour per the page. Bank-cycle 14+14 sets until Herblore 38.

hints.note: From 22, harralander unf + red spiders' eggs (restore potion, 62.5 xp, 156,250 xp/hour) out-rates strengths if you have eggs banked -- eggs' non-GE source unverified (??).
Same two-half-inventory rhythm as the guam sets.

label: Bank: withdraw 14 grimy ranarr + 14 vials of water; clean and mix unf en route
detail: Withdraw 14 grimy ranarr weed and 14 vials of water. Clean the ranarr at the bank (Herblore 25, 7.5 xp each) and combine each with a vial into ranarr potion (unf) -- a distinct Herblore-30, 0-xp sub-recipe before the real brew. Ranarr stock comes from your own herb runs and Master Farmer pickpocketing (reuse steps farm-ranarr-patch / pps-02-steal-ranarr-seeds); snape grass from the Waterbirth spawn cluster (reuse gather-snape-grass).

hints.note: Clean + unf-mix happen in the same bank stand; only the snape-grass combine ticks the xp.

label: Mix prayer potions (ranarr unf + snape grass) until Herblore 50
detail: Use a snape grass on each ranarr potion (unf) and make-all: 87.5 xp per potion, 218,750 xp/hour per the page. Bank the finished prayer potions -- they double as your PvM prayer-restore stock (this is the same chain as the prayer-pot supply steps). Repeat 14+14 sets until Herblore 50.

hints.note: Never alch/sell these -- they are the route's PvM prayer supply (XREF prayer-pot-supply chain).

label: Mix avantoe potions (fishing, then super energy) until Herblore 55
detail: Swap the herb half of the loadout to avantoe (cleans at 48, 10 xp each): avantoe unf + snape grass makes fishing potions at 50 (112.5 xp, 281,250 xp/hour). At 52, the same avantoe unf + mort myre fungus makes super energies instead (117.5 xp, 293,750 xp/hour) -- switch if you have fungus banked. Continue to Herblore 55.

hints.note: Mort myre fungus non-GE source unverified here (??); super energies also feed the 77+ stamina loop, so any made now bank forward.

label: Bank: withdraw 14 grimy kwuarm + 14 vials + 14 limpwurt roots
detail: Load the kwuarm set: clean the kwuarm at the bank (Herblore 54, 11.3 xp each), mix each with a vial into kwuarm potion (unf), keep the limpwurt roots in the remaining slots.

hints.note: Limpwurt roots ride in the same load if you pre-made the unf potions the trip before.

label: Mix super strength potions (kwuarm unf + limpwurt) until Herblore 66
detail: Use a limpwurt root on each kwuarm potion (unf) and make-all: 125 xp per potion, 312,500 xp/hour per the page -- the recipe opens exactly at this band's floor. Bank-cycle sets until Herblore 66.

hints.note: Bank all supers -- super attack(45)/strength(55)/defence(66) potions are the literal inputs of the level-90 super combat recipe later.
Limpwurt non-GE sourcing still unverified -- same ?? as the 38 band.

label: Bank: withdraw 14 grimy cadantine + 14 vials + 14 white berries
detail: Swap to the cadantine set at 66: clean the cadantine (Herblore 65, 12.5 xp each), mix unf, keep white berries alongside. White berries' non-GE source is unverified in fetched pages (??).

label: Mix super defence potions (cadantine unf + white berries) until Herblore 70
detail: Use a white berry on each cadantine potion (unf) and make-all: 150 xp per potion, 375,000 xp/hour per the page. At 69 you can switch to antifires (lantadyme unf + dragon scale dust, 157.5 xp, 393,750 xp/hour) if you want dragon-fight stock instead. Continue to Herblore 70.

hints.note: Antifire secondaries (dragon scale dust) non-GE source unverified (??); antifires bank forward as dragon/bossing supply.

label: Optional: minigame-teleport to Mastering Mixology at Aldarin
detail: From Herblore 60 (and Children of the Sun complete), open the grouping tab's minigame teleport list and take the Mastering Mixology teleport to Aldarin in Varlamore. The teleport shares the standard 20-minute minigame cooldown.

hints.note: Free, no runes; 20-min shared minigame-teleport cooldown.

label: Optional: fill Mastering Mixology potion orders instead of bank mixing
detail: Work the minigame's potion orders at Aldarin -- it consumes no specific herbs or secondaries and pays far more xp per herb than bank mixing. Efficiency climbs with level (final unlock at 81; the page states up to ~105,000 xp/hour at 81). It is also the only source of the prescription goggles, alchemist's amulet, chugging barrel, and potion storage, so runs here pay off even when raw xp/hour loses to bank mixing.

hints.note: Per-order xp varies with the requested potions; the page states no sub-81 hourly figure.

label: Bank: withdraw 14 grimy dwarf weed + 14 vials + wine of zamorak
detail: Bridge loadout for 70-77: clean the dwarf weed at the bank (Herblore 70, 13.8 xp each), mix each with a vial into dwarf weed potion (unf), and pair with wine of zamorak (one per potion; non-GE source unverified in fetched pages, ??).

hints.note: Secondary sourcing unverified -- ?? beats a guessed spawn/vendor.

label: Mix ranging potions (dwarf weed unf + wine of zamorak) until Herblore 77
detail: Use a wine of zamorak on each dwarf weed potion (unf) and make-all: 162.5 xp per potion, 406,250 xp/hour per the page -- the best cited rate available at 72, bridging you to the stamina unlock. Bank-cycle sets until Herblore 77.

hints.note: For the 70-72 sliver keep mixing antifires (69 recipe, 393,750 xp/hour) -- ranging potions gate at 72.

label: Restock super energies (avantoe unf + mort myre fungus) as stamina inputs
detail: Each stamina potion consumes a super energy, so keep the level-52 avantoe unf + mort myre fungus loop running as a feeder (117.5 xp per mix, 293,750 xp/hour -- still real training xp). Any dose size works downstream: the stamina table pays 102/76.5/51/25.5 xp for (4)/(3)/(2)/(1)-dose inputs respectively.

hints.note: Fungus non-GE sourcing unverified (??).

label: Bank: withdraw super energies + a stack of amylase crystals
detail: Stamina loadout: an inventory of super energy potions plus amylase crystals (stackable -- 4 per (4)-dose potion, so one stack slot feeds the whole session). Amylase's non-GE acquisition route is unverified in fetched pages (??).

hints.note: Stackable secondary means 27 potions per load instead of 14 -- one of the few recipes with this shape.

label: Mix stamina potions (super energy + 4x amylase) until Herblore 99
detail: Use amylase crystals on each super energy and make-all: 102 xp per (4)-dose potion, 280,500 xp/hour plain. Because the secondary stacks, this recipe 1-ticks: hold spacebar with 'All' selected and repeatedly use the amylase stack on the potions -- the page rates ~4,583 potions/hour this way, 535,500 xp/hour. Bank-cycle until Herblore 99.

hints.note: Page-stated 1-tick technique: stackable secondary + held spacebar; high intensity, near-double rate.

From 88, dwarf weed unf + lily of the sands pays 200 xp / 500,000 xp/hour plain (page's top non-tick rate; lily sourcing ??). At 98, extended super antifires hit 440,000 plain / 840,000 one-ticking and bank forward as bossing supply.

label: Go to the Lumbridge East Farm pens
detail: From Lumbridge Castle courtyard cross the bridge east over the River Lum and follow the path north: the chicken coop sits on the right and the cow field is over the stile just north of it. Nothing to bank - you fight in whatever you have.

hints.note: Quieter pens from the Chicken/Cow pages' own spawn lists if the farm is crowded.

label: Keep killing cows until the Hitpoints tab reads 20
detail: Hitpoints trails the stat you are training - each damage point pays 4 xp to the selected style but only 1.33 to Hitpoints - so Attack 10 and Strength 20 together do not finish this band on their own. When the host loops complete, stay on the cows (or roll straight into the Barbarian Village block) until Hitpoints 20: you start from 1,154 xp at level 10 and need 3,316 more.

hints.note: Accurate, Aggressive and Defensive all pay the identical 1.33 Hitpoints xp per damage - pick whichever host stat you want next; style choice cannot favour Hitpoints.
Bones are free Prayer xp on the spot; carry hides only if early Crafting is queued next.

label: Kill Rock Crabs, rotating melee styles, until Hitpoints 50
detail: The crabs look like inert rocks with no yellow minimap dot and only wake when you walk beside them. Rotate style blocks - Accurate, Aggressive, Defensive - so Attack, Strength and Defence climb while every damage point streams 1.33 Hitpoints xp; with a max hit of 1 against you, a handful of food covers hours. After about ten minutes the pack turns tolerant: run halfway back to Rellekka's entrance (or step in and out of the Keldagrim tunnel entrance) and walk back to re-wake them. The band needs 96,863 Hitpoints xp, so expect it to span your whole 30s-40s melee arc.

hints.note: This whole band is the passive rider of the train-attack/strength/defence loops - never park here for Hitpoints alone; let the host bands choose the spot.
All three styles pay the identical 1.33 Hitpoints xp per damage; rotate so no host stat stalls.
Crab tolerance kicks in after roughly ten minutes; reset by leaving halfway to Rellekka's entrance or via the Keldagrim tunnel, then walking back.
The band's other two vehicles: druids from around 30 (Wilderness caution), moss giants from around 40 (free-to-play at Varrock Sewers).

label: Bank: withdraw noose wand, rings of pursuit, stamina potions, a butterfly net and 2 bird snares
detail: One loadout covers the whole 9-21 ladder: noose wand + rings of pursuit for kebbit tracking (9-15), butterfly net + bird snares for the Piscatoris leg (15-21), staminas throughout. Hunter gear comes from Hunter shops - buy from a vendor, never the GE.

hints.note: A hunter potion just before levels 20/40/60/80 unlocks the extra trap early.

label: Travel to the Feldip Hunter area
detail: Break a Feldip Hills teleport scroll if you have one and run south toward the dungeon icon on the minimap; the weasel burrows are around there.

hints.note: The page's pick; other Feldip transports: ??

label: Track feldip weasels until Hunter 15
detail: Equip the noose wand and a ring of pursuit, inspect a burrow to start a track, run to the end of the trail and attack the bush it points at to noose the kebbit, then re-inspect a burrow and repeat. The ring reveals each whole track at once. ~13,000 xp/hr.

hints.note: Catch pace rides on track RNG; rings of pursuit smooth it out.

label: Move to the Piscatoris hunter area (fairy ring AKQ)
detail: Fairy ring AKQ lands at the Piscatoris hunter area (ring access needs Fairytale II started). Set up on the bird-snaring ground.

hints.note: Fairy rings need Fairytale II started - the page's own recommended unlock.

label: Net ruby harvests over copper longtail snares until Hunter 21
detail: Set your bird snares (two from level 20) for copper longtails, then catch ruby harvest butterflies with the net while the snares work. The birds alone are weak xp - combined, up to 20,000 xp/hr with two traps.

hints.note: Keep both snares cycling under the butterfly netting - that combination IS the rate.

label: Trap red crabs at The Pandemonium until Hunter 29
detail: Needs partial Pandemonium and Construction 10. First trip bring a hammer, saw, 2 planks, 4 nails and 2 buckets and build two crab traps side by side; after that just bait them with fish offcuts and cycle the traps. 31,000 xp/hr with two traps; bank the catch at the bank nearby.

hints.note: Two traps side by side is the page's setup; the build kit is a one-off.

label: No Pandemonium? From 25, net sapphire glacialis at the Rellekka hunter area until 29
detail: Stay on the Piscatoris birds until 25, then fairy ring DKS to the Rellekka hunter area and net sapphire glacialis (28,500 xp/hr at 25). Catch from the north or east side so the butterflies flee south-west, shortening your runs.

hints.note: Butterflies flee south-west; mark spawn tiles and minimenu-reorder to dodge misclicks.
Two bird traps running under the netting adds a little xp.

label: Optional background loop - bank: withdraw digsite pendant (3+ charges), hammer, chisel, 4 logs, 4 clockworks, 40 cheap seeds and a stamina potion
detail: Needs Bone Voyage. Each bird house is a log + clockwork assembled with hammer and chisel, armed with 10 low-level seeds (5 if high-level) - potato or onion seeds are ideal, and seed choice never changes the loot. Stock seeds from the Draynor Seed Market or Amelia's in the Farming Guild, or pickpocket Master Farmers.

label: Digsite pendant to the Digsite, then the barge guard's Quick-Travel to Fossil Island
detail: On the first run, climb the House on the Hill and use the pendant on the Strange Machine so future pendant rubs land on Fossil Island directly; click each Mushtree you pass to unlock its teleport stop.

hints.note: Keep a stack of pendants banked; they are the page's strongly recommended transport.

label: Build and seed 4 bird houses around the island (first circuit)
detail: Craft each house from a log + clockwork while running. Sites: beside the Sticky Swamp north-west entrance; north of the Mushroom Meadow Mushtree; and two in Verdant Valley. Use the seeds on every house manually - 10 low-level seeds each.

label: Every ~50 minutes: harvest and reset all 4 bird houses (one run is 73-90 s)
detail: Pendant to Fossil Island, Mushtree to Verdant Valley and check-and-replace the west then east house; Mushtree to Mushroom Meadow and replace that house; run south to the swamp entrance for the last. Craft the next house on a spare clockwork while running, and reseed every house. Harvest returns the clockwork plus nests and feathers.

hints.note: A background clock like farming - weave runs into whatever you are training.
10 low-level seeds (5 high-level) arm one house; cheapest seeds win, loot is identical.

label: Bank: withdraw 3 ropes, 3 small fishing nets, weight-reducing clothing and ~4 hunter potions
detail: One rope + one small fishing net per trap. Two traps run from 29-39; the third needs level 40 - from 37 the page recommends ~4 hunter potions to boost into it early. Weight-reducing clothing keeps run energy up.

label: Travel to the swamp north-west of Slepe
detail: The lizard trees sit in the swamp north-west of Slepe in Morytania. Route/teleport: ??

hints.note: Page names the spot, not the route - pick your fastest Morytania transport.

label: Net-trap swamp lizards until Hunter 43, dropping each lizard as you go
detail: Set a rope + small-net trap per free slot (two traps at 29-39, three from 40), cycle them as they spring, and drop caught lizards immediately so the weight does not drain run energy. ~20,000-28,000 xp/hr on two traps, ~40,000-45,000 on three.

hints.note: Drop on catch - the page's own advice for run energy.
Boost with hunter potions from 37 to run the third trap early.

label: From 39, box-trap embertailed jerboas at Locus Oasis instead (fairy ring AJP)
detail: Needs partial Eagles' Peak to set box traps. Fairy ring AJP lands beside the hunter ground; run three box traps for ~50,000 xp/hr to close the band faster than the lizards.

hints.note: AJP is right next to the hunter area.

label: Bank: withdraw 500 coins, stamina potions and weight-reducing clothing - and empty your weapon, shield and hand slots
detail: The gyr falcon rental costs 500 coins and requires bare weapon, shield and hand slots. Staminas plus weight-reducing clothing keep you running between spawns.

label: Fairy ring AKQ, then head east into the Piscatoris falconry area
detail: AKQ drops you at the Piscatoris hunter area; the falconry pen is just east. Rent a gyr falcon for 500 coins on entry.

hints.note: Fairy rings need Fairytale II started (the page's recommended unlock).

label: Falconry spotted kebbits until Hunter 49, camping the three south-east spawn points
detail: Click a spotted kebbit to launch the falcon, then retrieve the falcon and its loot, and drop the loot. The south-east corner holds three spawn points on a 4-second respawn - stand beside the spawn tile before launching to cut downtime. 60,000-70,000 xp/hr.

hints.note: Three SE spawns, 4 s respawn - position beats running.
A bonecrusher buries the bones automatically, cutting drop clicks.
Staying past 57? Dark kebbits pay 75,000-80,000 xp/hr from the west-edge spawn pair.

label: Bank: withdraw noose wand, a big stack of rings of pursuit, stamina potions and a chisel
detail: Rings of pursuit are consumed constantly - carry plenty (a Huntsman's kit stores extras so one trip lasts longer). The chisel turns long kebbit spikes into stackable long kebbit bolts for bonus Fletching xp between catches.

label: Track razor-backed kebbits at Piscatoris until Hunter 60
detail: From AKQ head east; the burrows and bushes sit just before the falconry pen. With noose wand and ring of pursuit equipped, search a burrow (the east-most has the least downtime) and attack the bush the track reveals - 348.5 xp per catch, up to 130,000 xp/hr (about 100,000 without staminas).

hints.note: Chisel the spikes into stackable bolts between the far bushes and the burrow - no ticks lost.
Minimenu-reorder raw beast meat to left-click Drop; a bonecrusher necklace handles the bones.
Reorder bushes to left-click Attack. Searched a burrow ringless? Hop worlds, ring up, search again.

label: Quieter alternative 47-59: net orange salamanders in the desert
detail: Bring 3 small fishing nets, 3 ropes, 10-14 waterskin(4)s and full desert clothing (120 s between sips). Uzer: through Shantay Pass, south-east to the bridge, cross and head east - or fairy ring DLQ and run north. The Necropolis spot (Beneath Cursed Sands + 62 Agility, fairy ring AKP) pays 50,000-63,000 xp/hr vs Uzer's 40,000-50,000. With 68 Magic + Dream Mentor, Humidify refills every waterskin at once.

hints.note: Necropolis instead: fairy ring AKP (Beneath Cursed Sands + 62 Agility).
Full desert clothing stretches each sip to 120 s; Humidify (68 Magic, Dream Mentor) refills them all.

label: Go to the Varrock Museum and climb down to the basement
detail: The museum is in Varrock; head inside and take the stairs down to the natural-history basement where Orlando Smith stands. No bank stop needed - the quiz uses no items.

hints.note: Any Varrock transport works; the museum is inside the city.

label: Talk to Orlando Smith to start the Natural History Quiz
detail: Orlando Smith runs the quiz from the museum basement; speak to him to begin.

label: Answer the quiz at the basement display cases until the 1,000 xp reward lands (Hunter 9)
detail: Work around the basement's natural-history displays answering each one's quiz questions. Finishing the whole quiz pays a one-time 1,000 Hunter xp - enough to jump straight from level 1 to 9 (969 xp needed).

hints.note: One-off reward, not repeatable - line up the next band's kit before leaving Varrock.

label: Keep tracking razor-backed kebbits at Piscatoris until Hunter 73
detail: Same ground and same loadout as the 49-60 stretch (noose wand, rings of pursuit, staminas, chisel) - no bank change. The method stays the fastest active option all the way to 73 at up to 130,000 xp/hr.

hints.note: Keep chiselling spikes into bolts between bushes.

label: Bank: withdraw the Wilderness chin kit - box traps, knife + teak/mahogany logs, an escape teleport, 5 super restores, 1-3 anglerfish, Saradomin brews, a ranged weapon with cheap ammo, anti-venom+
detail: Page inventory: box traps; knife and teak/mahogany logs for tick manipulation; amulet of glory or royal seed pod (works to level 30 Wilderness) to escape; 5 super restores, 1-3 anglerfish and brews for tanking; a magic shortbow with cheap arrows to shoot strays if you have no alt; anti-venom+ unless wearing a serpentine helm. Wear magic-defence tank gear you can afford to lose (black d'hide on a budget) with a phoenix necklace at the neck.

hints.note: Enable PK Skull Prevention so the ZGS-freeze logout escape cannot be skull-tricked.

label: Obelisk to level 35 Wilderness, then run south-east to the chin ground
detail: Fastest in: the POH Wilderness obelisk or the obelisk east of the Corporeal Beast's lair to level 35, then a short run south-east (hard Wilderness diary strongly recommended for obelisk control). Alternatives: revenant cave teleport and run south, or the Edgeville waka canoe (57 Woodcutting).

hints.note: Hunter cape teleport lands here too once you hit 99.

label: Box-trap black chinchompas until Hunter 99, banking the stack for later chinning
detail: Lay traps on the spawn tiles and shoot any chin that strays - a fresh spawn walks into traps faster. Reset on the pickup tick: check a full trap, knife a log the same tick, click under yourself, lay the trap from inventory, and move to the next trap on the same tick. 145,000 xp/hr solo at 73 rising to 225,000 at 99 (265,000 with a shooting alt). The chins stack - keep every one as ammo for chinning Ranged later.

hints.note: Direct feedstock for maniacal-monkey chinning - gather, never GE.
Swap to Protect from Magic when teleblocked/frozen; a Zamorak godsword freeze + logout under the PKer is the consistent escape.
Rates assume one attack every 1-2 h; bank the stack whenever the risk outweighs the trip.
Table rates assume practised tick-manip - expect less while learning.

label: No Wilderness? Run expert (72+) then master (91+) Hunters' Rumours from the Hunter Guild
detail: Guild hunters in the Hunter Guild (Avium Savannah; the guild opens at Hunter 46) assign a creature - hunt it until its rare part drops, then turn in for (level + 5) x 55/60 xp. Skip novice/adept tiers: start experts at 72 (~160,000 xp/hr) and masters at 91 (~195,000, reaching ~250,000 at 99). Two hunters never assign the same creature, so park an unwanted rumour with one hunter and take rumours from the others.

hints.note: Toggle on for higher rates.
Rumour length is drop-luck; quoted rates assume an xp-focused block list, full guild hunter outfit and teleports.

label: Safer chins from 80: carnivorous chinchompas in the Tlati Rainforest
detail: Varlamore entry needs Children of the Sun; after Twilight's Promise take a quetzal to Tal Teklan and run north-east - the ground is east of the Tal Teok temple by the teak trees. Startable at 63 with four traps (85,000 xp/hr tick-manip) but properly worth it from 80 with five (163,000 rising to 220,000 at 99). Same one-tick trap resets as black chins; the catch is red chinchompas - bank them for chinning.

hints.note: Quetzal ride needs Twilight's Promise done.
Chinning ammo - gather, never GE.

label: Low-intensity 80+: track herbiboar loops in the Mushroom Forest
detail: Needs Hunter 80 (boostable from 74 with super hunter potions, at reduced xp), Herblore 31 to harvest, and Bone Voyage. Inspect one of the five hunter-icon start objects, follow the trail through seaweed, mushrooms and muddy patches, attack the tunnel at the end, then harvest the stunned herbiboar - magic secateurs bump the pick to 2-4 herbs at 25 Herblore xp per herb after the first. 137,000 xp/hr at 80 rising to 171,000 at 99 (~66 catches/hr with staminas). Never start a new trail before harvesting or the herbiboar vanishes.

hints.note: The official client's Herbiboar Helper highlights the correct next object.
Trails can confuse you back to the start; several approach-direction spots always continue at the same object.
Mostly running: 0 kg weight, graceful, staminas, ring of endurance; herb sack for the harvest, fossils into the mycelium-pool storage box.

label: Near-AFK 60+: deadfall maniacal monkeys in Kruk's Dungeon
detail: Needs Monkey Madness II completed and the Kruk monkey greegree. Gnome glider to Ape Atoll, investigate the jungle grass just south to drop into the dungeon, cross the monkeybars north with the greegree equipped, then continue north through the passage. Mount a stunted demonic gorilla, set a banana-baited deadfall on a boulder, and re-set after each 1,000 xp catch - one interaction every 25-30 seconds. Bring a royal seed pod plus baskets of bananas (an inventory of baskets lasts ~50 minutes). 51,000 xp/hr at 60 rising to 110,000 at 99.

hints.note: Rare monkey tail on catch; damaged monkey tails are the normal byproduct.
Interaction every 25-30 s - pairs with off-screen tasks.

label: Bank: gear up for combat-spell training
detail: Equip a staff of air (free air runes, autocasts your strike/bolt line) and withdraw the catalytic runes for the best combat spell you can cast - mind runes for strikes, chaos runes for bolts (counts ??). Under 30 Defence bring a few food. From Magic+Attack 30, swap to a smoke battlestaff if owned: +10% accuracy and damage on standard-book spells.

hints.note: Re-set autocast at each new strike/bolt unlock.

label: Go to the Sand Crabs on the Hosidius south shore
detail: From the Hosidius bank run south to the beach and stand on a tile where two or three crab mounds wake at once. No quest needed. If Bone Voyage is done, Ammonite Crabs on Fossil Island are the stronger (100 hp) version of the same loop.

hints.note: Crab shores are classic hotspots; Rock Crabs are usually quieter, the Gemstone Crab (Children of the Sun) is fully safe.

label: Autocast combat spells on crabs until Magic 25
detail: Let the crabs pile on and autocast your best strike/bolt spell. They stay aggressive for 10 minutes; when they stop attacking, run about a minimap-length away and walk back to re-aggro. Stick with Fire Strike if bolt runes are too dear. 1-25 is 7,842 xp (Experience table).

hints.note: From Magic 21, Low Alch junk drops between kill sets (see the optional atom).
Spawn layouts repeat across worlds.

label: From 21, Low Alchemy junk drops between kill sets (optional)
detail: Cast Low Level Alchemy (31 xp, one cast per 3 ticks) on unwanted equipment drops. Cost per cast is 3 fire + 1 nature; swap to a fire staff while alching and only the natures are consumed.

label: Alt: Fire spells on Ice Giants (100% Fire weakness)
detail: White Wolf Mountain or the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon; tuck behind a rock safespot. Ice Giants have 70 hp and 1 Magic, and fire spells deal double damage against the 100% weakness - Fire Strike hits up to 16, Fire Bolt up to 24 (30 with Chaos gauntlets from Family Crest). Faster than crabs, less AFK.

hints.note: Both named areas have line-of-sight blockers; re-cast when they path around.

label: Bank: withdraw the Low Alchemy loadout
detail: Equip a fire battlestaff so each cast only eats the nature rune, then withdraw ~1,371 nature runes (42,497 band xp / 31 xp per cast - derived from the Experience table) and a noted stack of your own fodder: smithed bronze/iron pieces from the smithing lane or banked junk drops. Never GE-bought fodder.

label: Cast Low Level Alchemy until Magic 43
detail: One cast every 3 ticks, 31 xp, ~1,371 casts for the band. Run it on top of something else - agility laps, quest walking, the crab aggro loop - or stand in the Mage Training Arena's Alchemist's Playground (Magic 7+ to enter; no coins allowed inside) where the same clicking also pays pizazz points toward its rewards.

hints.note: Stackable runes + noted fodder mean this loop rides on any walking-heavy activity.
31 xp/cast, up to 60,000/h stationary per the page.

label: Alt: run Arceuus Library book requests until Magic 43
detail: In the Grand Library, take customers' book requests, pull the right book from the shelves (Kourend Library plugin highlights them once a few are found) and hand it in - 15x your current Magic level in xp per delivery, zero rune cost. Xp per book grows as you level, so this alt improves the longer you stay.

hints.note: The page itself says the method is only really workable with the plugin's shelf highlighting.

label: Alt: spam Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Emerald) from 27
detail: 37 xp per cast on a set of 10 emerald bolts; 1 cosmic + 1 nature per cast with an air staff covering the 3 airs. Up to 203,500/h manually spam-clicking the spell (~5,500 casts/h); autocast is about a third of that. Bolts must be your own smithed+fletched+tipped stock under gather-not-GE, which caps how long this alt can run.

hints.note: Each cast enchants a set of 10; holding space + clicking casts every tick.

label: Mine 2,195 iron ore and 4,390 coal for the superheat loop
detail: Each steel bar takes 1 iron ore + 2 coal (Steel bar recipe), and the page's 2,195 casts for 43-55 sets the totals. Mine at whichever iron+coal site your Mining band already uses and bank there (site choice ??) - this stock is shared supply with the smithing lane, so over-mine rather than under.

hints.note: This IS mining training - the same ore feeds train-smithing-40's anvil work and this band's casts.

label: Bank: fire staff on, withdraw natures + 9 bars' worth of ore
detail: Equip the fire battlestaff (covers the 4 fire runes per cast), keep ~2,195 nature runes rolling, and fill the inventory in 1-iron+2-coal triples - 27 slots = 9 bars per inventory. Superheat needs no furnace, so the whole loop lives at the bank booth.

hints.note: 1 iron + 2 coal per bar over 27 free slots (derived from the recipe).

label: Superheat steel bars until Magic 55
detail: Cast Superheat Item on the iron ore every 3 ticks - 53 Magic xp plus 17.5 Smithing xp per bar, 2,195 casts across the band per the page, up to 97,000 Magic xp/h with focus. Deposit bars, redraw ore, repeat. KEEP every bar: they are the high-alch fodder and anvil stock for the next bands.

hints.note: Passive Smithing xp on every bar - xref train-smithing-40, same recipe, shared stock.
Bars feed the 55-70 alch loop and the anvil lane; never drop or sell short.

label: Alt: spam Camelot Teleport from 45
detail: With an air staff equipped, click Camelot Teleport over and over - 55.5 xp per cast, ~80,000/h, and the page prices the whole 45-55 stretch at 1,895 law runes. No product, pure xp; useful when the ore bank runs dry.

label: Alt: Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Ruby) from 49
detail: 59 xp per cast on sets of 10 ruby bolts, 1 cosmic + 1 blood per cast with a fire staff covering the 5 fires; up to 324,500/h manually spam-cast. The fastest option in the band on paper, but only as deep as your own ruby-bolt stock.

label: Bank: withdraw the tele-alch loadout
detail: Fire staff on; withdraw ~1,387 law runes and ~1,387 nature runes (167,168 xp for 55-62 at 120.5 xp per alch+teleport cycle - derived) plus your noted alch fodder: the superheated steel bars and smithed items from the earlier bands, never a GE batch.

label: Tele-alch at Camelot until Magic 62
detail: Cast High Alchemy on the noted stack, hit the spellbook F-key, click Camelot Teleport - both spells land inside the same 5 ticks (65 + 55.5 xp per cycle, up to 144,600/h). Filter combat spells out of the book so alch and teleport sit close together. No Desert Treasure I yet? Just keep this loop running all the way to 70.

hints.note: 120.5 xp per cycle; Ardougne pays slightly more xp for one extra law per cycle.
Camelot cheapest; Fortis needs Twilight's Promise but sits closest to High Alch on the book.

label: Switch to Ancient Magicks (Desert Treasure I done)
detail: Ancient Magicks unlock on completing Desert Treasure I, and the book itself demands 50+ Magic. Swap spellbooks (altar mechanics ??), then set autocast Smoke Burst on an ancient-capable weapon - a plain ancient staff works short-term; kodai/nightmare staff/ancient sceptre are the page's upgrade path.

hints.note: Stays until you swap back; standard-book utility (alch/teleports) is unavailable meanwhile.

label: Bank: withdraw Smoke Burst runes and target-specific protection
detail: Per Smoke Burst cast: 4 chaos + 2 death + 2 fire + 2 air (total casts to 70 ?? - damage-dependent). Pack for the target: dust devils need Slayer 65 (their drops help refund runes); Temple Spiders want Prayer 43 for Protect from Melee or blood spells to out-heal; TzHaar-Ket asks for a fire cape to enter the inner circle grind.

label: Smoke Burst stacked monsters until Magic 70
detail: Lure a multi-combat pile and autocast Smoke Burst into it: dust devils in the Catacombs of Kourend (Slayer 65, cheap alternative to monkeys, valuable drops), Temple Spiders in the eastern Forthos Dungeon (low-Slayer accounts; herbs/seeds/alchables pay the rune bill), or TzHaar-Ket in Mor Ul Rek with a fire cape (slower, obsidian drop chances). At 70, swap autocast to Ice Burst (4 chaos + 2 death + 4 water) and roll straight into the next band.

hints.note: Bursts pay per target hit - the bigger the stack, the cheaper the xp.
No per-spot in-band rate on the page; damage rolls drive cast counts.
Three page-named spots; pick by your Slayer/Prayer/fire-cape gates.

label: Alt: no Desert Treasure I - tele-alch on to 70
detail: Skip the bursting checkpoint entirely and keep the Camelot tele-alch cycle running from 62 to 70 (same loadout and pace as before; ~403,823 more xp). This is the honest fallback until DT1 is routed.

label: Bank: ancient staff, damage gear, and burst/barrage runes
detail: Autocast weapon first (ancient staff short-term; kodai wand tops the page's list - 15% magic damage, 15% rune-save, free water runes; nightmare staff, ancient sceptre, blue moon spear are the alternatives), then magic-damage gear (occult from 70). Runes per cast: Ice Burst 4 chaos + 2 death + 4 water; Ice Barrage (94) 4 death + 2 blood + 6 water. Hourly totals ?? - damage-dependent.

hints.note: Re-set autocast to Ice Barrage the moment 94 lands (or when heart-boosted).

label: Burst/barrage your Slayer task until Magic 94
detail: Take stackable tasks - dust devils, Greater Nechryael, Warped Jellies, smoke devils - lure the pile into one square and autocast Ice Burst into it (Ice Barrage from 94, or earlier via a saturated heart boost from 82). Task drops usually cover the rune bill or better. Keep passive alchs/Magic Imbue rolling between tasks; the page's own ideal is passive xp to 82 before the heart-boost pivot.

hints.note: This IS Slayer training too - one of the page's most efficient dual-skill loops.
Burstable tasks depend on your master's table; block/skip shapes the rate.
AoE spells pay per stacked target.

label: Alt: head into Kruk's Dungeon on Ape Atoll
detail: Requires Monkey Madness II progressed to the point of reaching Kruk's Dungeon. Bring the full burst loadout - the monkeys spawn in large numbers with a long aggression range, so the stack forms on its own.

label: Alt: Ice Burst/Barrage Maniacal monkeys until Magic 94
detail: Let the monkeys (combat 140, 65 hp, 1 Magic defence, aggressive - infobox) pile on and burst the stack. Build for max magic damage first, prayer bonus second; accuracy barely matters at 1 Magic defence. Active: ~310,000/h burst, ~400,000/h barrage. Auto-retaliate AFK: 250,000+/h burst, 320,000+/h barrage. Two alt accounts stacking monkeys makes it near-idle (page's own suggestion).

hints.note: Page range: spell tier x active-vs-AFK.
Page: rune cost is not recouped here, unlike on-task bursting.

label: Alt: Blood Burst/Barrage the Bandit Camp lodge (68+)
detail: Stand exactly two tiles west of the door inside The Big Heist Lodge wearing a Saradomin or Zamorak item - every bandit in range aggros and self-stacks. Defensive-autocast Blood Burst (150,000-235,000/h) or Blood Barrage (230,000-305,000/h) at ~1,200 casts/h; the blood spells' life leech out-heals the incoming damage, so it's near-AFK until the 20-minute timer. Melee-defence + magic-damage gear recommended.

hints.note: The page's top rates are the defensive-autocast figures.
Interact before the 20-min timer or auto retaliate stops and the leech healing with it.

label: Alt: Plank Make mahogany logs from 86 (Dream Mentor)
detail: On the Lunar book, autocast Plank Make on a bank-adjacent inventory of mahogany logs: ~90,000/h fully idle (an inventory runs ~90s), ~166,000/h manual-casting, or 180,000+/h slotting a Magic Imbue in after every 7th cast (Imbue needs Lunar 82). Small profit per plank, and the planks bank straight into the Construction lane. Source logs from your Miscellania kingdom (post-Royal Trouble) or own chopping - the page itself flags bulk-buying as the method's downside.

hints.note: Every cast is also a Construction plank - the two lanes share this loop.
Page figure for the idle variant; manual roughly doubles xp/h.

label: Equip your best pickaxe
detail: No-bank checkpoint: every ore gets dropped, so carry nothing but the pickaxe you can wield.

label: Go to the Lumbridge Swamp training mine
