detail: Follow the path leading south from the Lumbridge graveyard into the swamp; the training mine (five copper and five tin rocks together) sits in the south-east corner near the fishing spots.

mapMarkers.label: East Lumbridge Swamp mine (infobox map pin)

label: Mine copper and tin, dropping the ore, until Mining 15
detail: Work whichever of the ten rocks is up -- both give 17.5 xp/ore -- and drop each full inventory where you stand. Rocks respawn in 2.4s so you rarely wait.

hints.note: Power-mine for max xp. If you want early Smithing stock instead, mine equal copper+tin and smelt bronze bars at the Al Kharid furnace on the way to its bank (the mine page recommends exactly this loop via the crossbow shortcut).

label: Equip your best pickaxe
detail: No-bank checkpoint: the iron is dropped, not carried, so bring only the pickaxe.

label: Go to the Al Kharid mine iron triangle
detail: The mine sits just north of Al Kharid, beside its bank and furnace; three of its nine iron rocks form a triangle you can mine without moving. Scorpions roam the mine but the page calls the spot very low-risk.

hints.note: The page lists 16 triangle sites; hop worlds or switch site if yours is taken (Resource Area is level 51 Wilderness -- skip it).

label: Stand in the iron triangle and drop-mine until Mining 30
detail: Mine all three rocks from the one tile (35 xp/ore), dropping ore while the rocks respawn. Wear Varrock armour 1+ if owned for its 10% double-ore chance.

hints.note: The page says banking iron below 60 slows xp a lot and the ore is not worth much.

label: Equip the best pickaxe you can now wield
detail: Upgrade the pickaxe as levels allow, then keep the no-bank triangle loop going.

label: Keep drop-mining the iron triangle until Mining 45
detail: Same triangle loop as the prior band: mine all three rocks from one tile, drop while they respawn.

hints.note: Drop for max xp -- OR bank at the adjacent Al Kharid bank if this route's Smithing/Magic bands (train-smithing-40, train-magic-43 superheat) still need iron: the banked ore here is the same non-GE stock they consume.

label: Teleport to the Motherlode Mine
detail: Rub a skills necklace and pick the Mining Guild: it lands you outside the guild gate just south-west of the Motherlode entrance -- 60 Mining is NOT needed for this way in. Bring a pickaxe to clear the rockfalls blocking the tunnels.

hints.note: Skills necklace is fastest; otherwise enter the Dwarven Mine via the house east of the Falador Party Room, or the camp south of Ice Mountain.

label: Bank: keep only pickaxe + hammer at the in-mine chest
detail: Use the bank chest next to Prospector Percy: deposit everything except your pickaxe and a hammer (for repairing the water-wheel struts when they break). One occupied slot means 26 pay-dirt per trip.

label: Run the pay-dirt loop until Mining 45
detail: Mine ore veins (60 xp each) until your inventory is full of pay-dirt, deposit it into the hopper by the water wheels, repair struts with your hammer when the wheels stop, and repeat. When the sack is full, empty it and bank the cleaned ores and golden nuggets at the chest. Lower level only for now (upper needs Mining 57).

hints.note: With only 1 slot used (hammer), 4 full pay-dirt trips fill the sack (7 with the nugget-bought upgraded sack).
A vein's 23-27s deplete timer starts when the FIRST player mines it -- quieter worlds give you the whole timer, though struts break un-repaired more often.
Nuggets come from cleaned pay-dirt at an uncited rate; save 100 for the upper level unlock at 57, then the Prospector kit (2.5% bonus xp).

label: Bank: withdraw the 3-tick granite loadout
detail: Withdraw: best pickaxe, a big stack of swamp tar (the setup inventory shows ~1000) plus a clean guam or marrentill to start each 3-tick cycle, and desert-heat protection for the quarry -- one of: waterskins refilled with the lunar spell Humidify, a desert amulet 4, a hitpoints cape with regen bracelet, or a circlet of water. Wear Varrock armour 2+ and any prospector pieces owned.

label: Teleport to the Bandit Camp Quarry (or Cape Conch mine)
detail: Quarry: camulet teleport to Enakhra's Temple, exit, short run south-west -- or teleport straight to the entrance after the hard Desert Diary; without Enakhra's Lament use Pharaoh's sceptre to the Ancient Pyramid and run west, or the Bedabin Camp carpet and run south. Cape Conch (no desert heat, partial Troubled Tortugans): fairy ring cjq, then with 61 Agility the rocks + stepping-stone shortcuts south-east to the mine, otherwise sail/charter to The Great Conch and take the dock rowboat east.

hints.note: Cape Conch is the page's preferred site (no desert-heat damage) if Troubled Tortugans is partially done.

label: 3-tick mine granite (3t4g) until Mining 60
detail: Use swamp tar on your clean herb, then immediately click the next granite rock -- timed right you roll for granite every 3 ticks. Rotate around four rocks continuously, dropping 1-2 granite between mines (not full inventories). Without tick manipulation this method is not worth doing.

hints.note: Drop between mines; moving to the next rock grants a second resource roll if the first fails, so late clicks cost xp.
The page recommends dropping only 1-2 pieces at a time so you never click the next rock late.

label: Teleport to the Motherlode Mine
detail: Skills necklace to the Mining Guild gate, short run to the entrance; pickaxe + hammer only (bank the rest at the in-mine chest).

label: At Mining 57: pay Percy 100 golden nuggets to open the upper level
detail: One-time unlock (Mining 57, no boosts): the upper level's 64 veins sit closer together and deplete far slower (36-40s vs 23-27s). Its ladder is north of the bank chest; the upper hopper costs a further 50 nuggets. The training page says to unlock it as soon as it becomes available.

label: Run the pay-dirt loop until Mining 60
detail: Same loop as before -- veins to full pay-dirt inventory, hopper, repair struts, empty the sack, bank ores + nuggets. Move up to the upper level as soon as it is unlocked. Per-level table: 33,000 xp/hr at 50, 45,000 at 61.

hints.note: 1-slot inventory (hammer only) = 4 trips per sack, 7 with the upgraded sack.

label: Teleport to the Motherlode Mine
detail: Skills necklace to the Mining Guild gate, run south-west to the entrance; clear rockfalls with your pickaxe.

label: Bank: keep only pickaxe + hammer at the in-mine chest
detail: If you skipped the last band's ALT: pay Percy 100 golden nuggets for the upper level first (Mining 57 needed). Then strip the inventory to pickaxe + hammer -- or a gem/coal bag with an off-hand Imcando hammer equipped -- so each trip carries 26-27 pay-dirt.

label: Run the upper-level pay-dirt loop until Mining 75
detail: Mine the upper level's clustered veins to a full pay-dirt inventory, hopper it, repair struts as needed, empty the sack and bank ores + nuggets. Use the 54-Agility dark-tunnel shortcut by the bank chest (medium Falador Diary) to cut the hopper run. Per-level table: 45,000 xp/hr at 61, 48,000 at 70.

hints.note: 4 trips per sack with the 1-slot inventory; 7 with the upgraded sack.
Spend nuggets on the Prospector kit (2.5% bonus xp, cost uncited here) and the sack/hopper upgrades; the prospector helmet is a hard Falador Diary requirement.
Quieter worlds give whole vein timers but fewer strangers repairing struts.

label: Teleport to the granite quarry
detail: Same loadout and travel as the 45-60 granite checkpoint: tar + herb + heat protection, camulet/diary teleport to the Bandit Camp Quarry, or fairy ring cjq to Cape Conch.

label: 3-tick mine granite until Mining 75
detail: Same 3t4g cycle: tar on herb, click the next of four rocks, drop 1-2 granite between mines. Table: 103,000 xp/hr at 65, 109,000 at 75. An infernal pickaxe adds passive Smithing xp (~960,000 Mining xp per charge).

hints.note: Drop 1-2 at a time between mines.

label: Travel to the Volcanic Mine and pay Petrified Pete
detail: Fastest: the volcanic mine teleport sold in Petrified Pete's Ore Shop. Otherwise digsite pendant to the Digsite, barge to Fossil Island, then east and up the rope anchor (64 Agility); or pendant to House on the Hill and the Mycelium network to Verdant Valley, east below the lava, then north. Entry costs 30 numulite each time, or a one-time 3,000 for permanent access (Mining 50 required).

hints.note: Buy the dedicated teleport from Pete's shop once you run this regularly.

label: Mine the lava-channel boulder each run until Mining 75
detail: Mine the giant boulder as it shrinks and floats north; each success gives xp + points and a fragment chance that rises as it shrinks (1/20 attached down to 1/3 small). ALWAYS leave alive via the rope exit -- dying or teleporting out disintegrates your fragments and forfeits the end-of-run bonus (~3.8 xp per point from Pete; ~5.5 xp/point overall). Rewards table at 75: 65,200-75,000 xp/hr depending on pickaxe tier.

hints.note: Fragment tier scales with Mining level (mithril at 55, adamantite at 70, runite at 85); fragments auto-convert to xp + shop points via Pete.

label: Bank: withdraw the endgame granite loadout
detail: Withdraw ~1000 swamp tar + a clean guam/marrentill, and your heat protection (desert amulet 4 / Humidify waterskins / circlet of water / HP cape + regen bracelet). Wear the full prospector kit -- Varrock armour 4 doubles as the jacket -- plus a celestial ring; use an infernal pickaxe if affordable (one charge lasts ~960,000 Mining xp and pays passive Smithing xp). Pickaxe tier otherwise does not matter for 3-tick rolls.

hints.note: Page tip: small resizable-Modern client, camera south, data orbs off -- minimises mouse travel between inventory and rocks.

label: Teleport to the Bandit Camp Quarry (or Cape Conch mine)
detail: Camulet to Enakhra's Temple and run south-west, or straight to the entrance with the hard Desert Diary; Cape Conch via fairy ring cjq + the 61-Agility shortcuts if Troubled Tortugans is partially done (no desert heat there).

label: 3-tick mine granite until Mining 99
detail: The endgame loop: tar on herb, click the next of four rocks, drop 1-2 granite between mines, never miss the movement-stall second roll. Table: 109,000 xp/hr at 75 climbing to 126,000 at 99; ~134,000 max-efficiency ceiling, 120,000-125,000 realistic.

hints.note: 1-2 pieces per drop, between mines.

label: Go to the blast mine in northern Lovakengj
detail: Run north from Xeric's Inferno (Xeric's talisman), from the jewellery of jubilation teleport (Kharedst's memoirs / book of the dead), or from Lovakengj minecart station.

hints.note: All three land south of the mine; run north.

label: Stock dynamite from Thirus at the mine
detail: Buy dynamite from Thirus beside the blast mine (named non-GE vendor; price/stock uncited here). Budget around 330 per hour of blasting.

label: Or make your own dynamite
detail: Combine volcanic sulphur, juniper charcoal, saltpetre and a pot into a dynamite pot, then add a ball of wool (per-batch quantities uncited here). Self-sufficient alternative to buying from Thirus.

label: Run the blast loop until Mining 99
detail: Chisel a hard-rock cavity (20 Mining xp), pop dynamite in, light it with the tinderbox and step 2+ tiles clear (or take ~15 damage), scoop the blasted ore within 3 minutes and drop it in the ore sack by a working operator, then collect noted ore + the ore xp (33 coal / 66 gold / 120 mithril / 190 adamantite / 260 runite) from the brown-haired operator on the east side. You mine ore as if 10 levels higher, so runite flows from 75. Wear weight-reducing gear; the prospector kit boosts the collection xp even if not worn while blasting. Refill dynamite and bank ores at the on-site chests.

hints.note: The sack jams at 900 of any single ore type; the operator warns you -- collect before blasting more.
Higher Mining level (and the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary's +10%) shifts blasts toward better ores; a dragon pickaxe special can boost the roll.

label: Travel to the Volcanic Mine
detail: Volcanic mine teleport (Pete's Ore Shop) or digsite pendant routes; 30 numulite per entry unless the 3,000 permanent pass is paid.

label: Run Volcanic Mine boulders until Mining 99
detail: Mine the boulder, exit alive via the rope every run. From 85, runite fragments (150 xp, 70 points each) dominate the value. At 99 the rewards table reads 79,300/84,000/94,000 xp/hr for rune/dragon/crystal pickaxe; well-coordinated teams see 85,000-95,000.

hints.note: Runite fragments unlock at Mining 85.

label: Teleport to the Motherlode Mine
detail: Skills necklace to the Mining Guild gate; pickaxe + hammer loadout at the in-mine chest.

label: Run the upper-level pay-dirt loop until Mining 99
detail: Lowest-effort road to 99: veins to full pay-dirt, hopper, sack, bank. With the full upgrade set (dragon pickaxe, prospector kit, upper level + Super Hopper): 59,000 xp/hr at 90, 64,000 at 99.

hints.note: 7 with the upgraded sack.

label: Bank: withdraw the Ape Atoll camping loadout
detail: Withdraw food (count ??), prayer potions to open the session (the monkeys' 1-dose prayer potion drops sustain it after that), and a light source for the lower level.

label: Go to the maniacal monkeys in Kruk's Dungeon
detail: Kruk's Dungeon on Ape Atoll, visited during Monkey Madness II (the route's quest-mm/Monkey Madness I gate contradicts the page -- flagged, not reconciled). Stand inside a dense spawn cluster on either level so the aggressive monkeys pile on.

label: Rotate combat styles between Accurate and Aggressive
detail: This camp trains Attack and Strength together: hold Accurate while pushing an Attack target, then flip to Aggressive for Strength, alternating per session so both stats climb toward 99.

hints.note: One style toggle per sub-goal; the chip stays until changed.

label: Camp maniacal monkeys until Attack 99 and Strength 99
detail: Collapsed grind loop. Combat level 140, max hit 18, only 10 Defence; extremely dense and aggressive so kills chain themselves. Common 1-dose prayer potion drops outpace Protect-prayer upkeep; every kill drops small ninja monkey bones for later Prayer training.

hints.note: Prayer potions drop more often than they are used here.

label: Travel to Nightmare Zone (north of Yanille)
detail: Take the Minigame teleport straight to Nightmare Zone once its five-quest entry bar is met; otherwise Watchtower teleport and run east, a Yanille player-owned house, fairy ring CLS or CIQ, or ring of dueling to Castle Wars and walk.

quests: Any 5 quests from the Nightmare Zone requirement list (Nightmare_Zone.s3)

hints.note: Minigame teleport only once requirements are met.

label: Fund Dominic's coffer
detail: Deposit coins into Dominic's coffer in multiples of 1,000 (session total ??); every dream's fee comes out of it.

label: Run your first dream on real potions to seed points
detail: With no points yet, bring super combat potions plus prayer potions or food and fight a hard endurance dream (killing bosses up to Elvarg) or the Melee (Prayer) setup with protection prayers until the run ends - those points bankroll every absorption run after.

hints.note: One or two seeded games usually cover the first absorption stock.

label: Buy absorption doses at the barrels
detail: Spend points on absorption doses (1,000 points each; barrels hold 255 per potion) and withdraw 28 doses per dream, with a dwarven rock cake in the inventory.

hints.note: Drinks herb-cleaning fast, no hit delay.

label: AFK normal rumbles until Attack, Strength, and Defence 80
detail: Start a normal customisable rumble, Guzzle the rock cake to 1 Hitpoints, sip absorptions, and flick Rapid Heal at least once a minute to stay at 1; rotate the attack style to whichever stat lags (Accurate/Aggressive/Defensive) and restock doses between dreams. Normal rumble is the Strategies page's best xp-and-AFK balance on absorptions; six hours is the session cap.

items: dwarven rock cake or locator orb

hints.note: One toggle each time the lagging stat changes.
Only the one-minute Rapid Heal flick needs attention.
Stops passive regen lifting you off 1 HP.

label: Bury every bone your kills drop until Prayer 22
detail: No separate trip and no bank: while working the early melee bands at the Lumbridge chicken coop and cow field, right-click Bury each bones drop between kills. A regular bone gives 4.5 xp buried; the band needs 5,624 xp (~1,250 bones if burial does it all). The Restless Ghost + Priest in Peril + Recruitment Drive + Holy Grail pay 14,531 Prayer xp (level 1 to 30), so any of those quests landing first shrinks or erases this loop.

hints.note: Runs inside the train-attack/strength/defence kill loops - zero added travel or time.
Bury immediately instead of banking - bones are not worth the inventory churn this early.

label: Top up from banked bones if the band is not done
detail: If quest xp plus kill-drops have not reached Prayer 22 by the time you leave the early combat zones, stand at any bank, withdraw banked bones 28 at a time, and bury them beside the booth until 22.

hints.note: Full-inventory withdraw-bury cycles; one bank round per 28 bones.

label: Kill Hill Giants and bank big bones until you hold ~2,981
detail: Hill Giants always drop big bones (100% drop). Two F2P camps: the Edgeville Dungeon giants, entered through the house north-east of Barbarian Village with a brass key (bank at Edgeville), or the Giants' Plateau east of Al Kharid past the gap in the gate (no key). The Bone Yard in the Wilderness also has free big-bone ground spawns if you would rather pick than fight. Threshold math: ~2,981 bones covers the band by pure burial; only ~852 are needed at a gilded altar, or ~426 at the Chaos altar (105 xp average each) - size your stock to the offering method you will actually use.

hints.note: The page itself flags Edgeville Dungeon as usually crowded on F2P worlds - hop, or switch to the Giants' Plateau / Bone Yard spawns.
Hill Giants (combat 28, low Defence) double as a level 30-50 melee training block - stack this gather onto a combat band.

label: Un-note dragon bones at the Elder Chaos druid (50 coins each)
detail: Fast-strategy restock, repeated between offering rounds: carry the stock as noted bones plus coins, and pay the Elder Chaos druid just outside the temple's south wall 50 coins per bone to un-note an inventory at a time. This is what the 860,000 xp/hr figure assumes; it raises what you risk to player killers. The low-risk alternative skips this atom entirely: bring one unnoted inventory per trip and suicide back to a Ferox Enclave/Edgeville respawn (grab the Wine of Zamorak telegrab table or let the Chaos Fanatic finish you) for ~2,000 bones offered/hr = 500,000 xp/hr on dragon bones.

hints.note: Heavy PKer traffic? Drop to the suicide strategy (500,000 xp/hr, one unnoted inventory risked at a time) instead of carrying the noted stack.

label: Equip your best throwing darts (or a shortbow with the best arrows you can fire)
detail: Darts beat everything for damage-per-cost at crabs per the page's weapon rundown; a shortbow with your best usable arrows works too. Make your own ammo instead of buying it: smith dart tips or fletch arrows (shafts + feathers + tips). Speak to the Ranged combat tutor once to toggle auto-equip so picked-up ammo re-arms itself.

hints.note: Rapid is the fastest xp per the page's general notes; leave it on for every ranged band.
The Ranged combat tutor toggles whether picked-up ammunition equips automatically.

label: Head to the sand-crab beach on the southern Hosidius coast
detail: The crabs disguise themselves as 'Sandy rocks' along the southern Hosidius shoreline. Walk the beach until two or three sandy rocks sit within a tile or two of each other -- that cluster is your camp. No quest requirement to fight them.

hints.note: The training page cites no specific transport; use whatever Kourend access you have.

label: Camp the crab cluster until Ranged 30
detail: Turn Auto Retaliate on, stand where 2-3 crabs wake at once, and fire on Rapid while they pile onto you. After ~10 minutes they go passive -- run about a minimap's length away and back to reset their aggression, then re-camp. Repeat to Ranged 30. If the pile hurts too much (page recommends ~30 Defence before camping), use a spot with fewer spawns.

hints.note: Crabs must re-engage you automatically or the camp dies.
~10-minute aggro windows; pair with low-attention tasks between reset runs.
Sand crabs are usually crowded; rock crabs near Rellekka are quieter (50 HP each), and the Gemstone Crab near Tal Teklan is shared -- it cannot be crashed.

label: After Animal Magnetism, equip Ava's attractor
detail: Animal Magnetism opens at Ranged 30; Ava's attractor then recovers 60% of your fired ammo, roughly halving dart/arrow burn for the rest of the grind. Don't pair it with a metallic body -- the device stops recovering ammo over one.

label: Keep camping the Hosidius crabs until Ranged 40
detail: Same beach, same loop: Auto Retaliate on, Rapid style, 2-3 crabs piled on you, minimap-length reset run every ~10 minutes. This band is pure repetition -- crabs stay worthwhile all the way to 70.

hints.note: ~10-minute aggro windows; reset run, re-camp.
Hop or switch crab species if the beach is taken.

label: Faster, costlier option: cannon the ogres east of Castle Wars until Ranged 40
detail: With Dwarf Cannon done, assemble your multicannon among the ogres east of Castle Wars, load steel cannonballs, and keep re-loading as it rotates while you pick off ogres with your own weapon. The cannon max-hits 30 with steel cannonballs no matter your level -- the page's fastest xp until 45, ~40,000 xp/hr from the cannon alone. Smith your own cannonballs (ammo mould, Smithing 35) rather than buying.

hints.note: Castle Wars ogres get crowded; the Combat Training Camp ogres (needs Biohazard) are usually quieter.

label: Bank: withdraw a fresh ammo stack and upgrade your kit
detail: Withdraw your next ammo stack (amount ??) and light food. At Ranged 50 swap Ava's attractor for the accumulator (72% ammo recovery) and step up your dart/arrow tier; per the page, body and legs are the armour slots worth upgrading first.

label: Crab camp until Ranged 55
detail: Default lane: back to the crab cluster -- Auto Retaliate on, Rapid, reset the aggro window every ~10 minutes with a minimap-length run. Cheap and near-AFK; take this lane whenever the MM2 chinning gate is closed.

hints.note: Long band (129,412 xp) -- pair with low-attention tasks.
Hop worlds or switch species before walking off.

label: Fast lane prep: box-trap your own chinchompa stack
detail: If Monkey Madness II chapter II is started, gather chins with Hunter box traps instead of buying: the Hunter guide's current spots are carnivorous chinchompas in the Tlati Rainforest (Hunter 63) and black chinchompas at level 32-36 Wilderness (Hunter 73); plain grey chinchompa trap level ??. Bank the catch between trips. Stack size needed for the band: ??.

hints.note: Catch rate scales with Hunter level; no per-hour catch figure fetched.

label: Fast lane from 45: chin stacked maniacal monkeys until Ranged 55
detail: Enter Kruk's Dungeon on Ape Atoll (MM2 chapter II started), pray Protect from Melee, let the monkeys stack on you, and throw chinchompas on Medium fuse (the chin version of Rapid) until 55. Page rates under ideal setups: 290,000 xp/hr at 45; 360,000 grey / 430,000 red at 55. The monkeys drop 1-dose prayer potions -- pick them up and the prayer cost is nearly zero.

hints.note: Medium fuse is Rapid for chinchompas; Longrange only if you want Defence xp.
Rates assume the monkeys are stacked on you with Protect from Melee up; their 1-dose prayer-pot drops sustain it.
The prayer-pot drops are the fuel -- grab them.

label: Smelt your cannonball stock at a furnace
detail: With an ammo mould in your pack, smelt steel bars into steel cannonballs at any furnace (Smithing 35; a double ammo mould doubles the pace). Stock size for the band: ?? -- the page is blunt that if you cannot afford cannonballs it is better to go earn them than to slay without a cannon.

hints.note: Double ammo mould doubles output per smelt per the Smithing guide (27,648 vs 13,824 xp/h).

label: Bank: withdraw the cannon parts, cannonballs, and task gear
detail: Withdraw all four dwarf multicannon pieces (base, stand, barrels, furnace), your cannonball stock, and your normal Slayer task loadout and food. You must have completed Dwarf Cannon to own and place one.

label: Cannon every eligible Slayer task until Ranged 70
detail: At each task spot that allows a cannon, plant it where the monsters cluster, keep it loaded, and fight the task as normal -- the cannon's kills pay Ranged xp on top of your own. Multi-combat tasks shine (the page names dagannoth and kalphite tasks, where the cannon does most of the damage); a melee task can take nearly twice as long without one. Some monsters are cannon-immune -- sand crabs among them. Repeat task after task to Ranged 70.

hints.note: Ranged rides along with Slayer here -- the page pegs the passive total at roughly 2-4M Ranged xp by 99 Slayer.

label: No task running? Active-cannon ogres or ice trolls until Ranged 70
detail: Pure cannoning: the ogres east of Castle Wars need no extra quests (~40,000 xp/hr from the cannon alone, often crowded). After The Fremennik Trials, the ice trolls north of Jatizso roughly pay back their cannonball cost in drops -- stand on the coal rocks west of the eastern mining icon so they cannot reach you, and bring runes for Telekinetic Grab to lift the loot.

hints.value: coal rocks west of the eastern Jatizso mining icon
hints.note: The trolls hit hard un-safespotted; keep backup food.
Biohazard unlocks the Combat Training Camp ogres, usually quieter than Castle Wars.

mapMarkers.label: Coal-rocks safespot (ice trolls, north of Jatizso)

label: Fastest: keep chinning maniacal monkeys to Ranged 70
detail: Same Kruk's Dungeon loop as the last band -- Protect from Melee, monkeys stacked, Medium fuse. Page brackets: 360,000-430,000 xp/hr at 55 and 470,000-690,000 at 65 by chinchompa tier (the table has no level-70 row).

label: Hunter lane: trap the chin stack that feeds this band
detail: This band burns chins in bulk -- the page's rate table assumes 1,970 thrown per hour. Trap them yourself with box traps: the Hunter guide's current spots are carnivorous chinchompas in the Tlati Rainforest (Hunter 63, best from 80) and black chinchompas at level 32-36 Wilderness (Hunter 73, fastest but PK risk). Bank the stack as it grows; total needed ??.

hints.note: Catch rate scales with Hunter level and spot; no per-hour figure fetched for this pairing.
Wilderness black chins carry PK risk; the Varlamore rainforest spot is the safe alternative.

label: Bank: withdraw the chinning loadout
detail: Withdraw your chinchompas, divine ranging potions (count ??), and your highest ranged-strength gear -- Void with the ranger helm (Elite Void if unlocked) against these low-defence monkeys, otherwise blessed d'hide or Hueycoatl hide. Bring only a light prayer stock: the monkeys' 1-dose prayer-pot drops sustain Protect from Melee once you are in the loop.

label: Travel to Ape Atoll and drop into Kruk's Dungeon
detail: Get to Ape Atoll and enter Kruk's Dungeon -- accessible once Monkey Madness II chapter II is started. Transport means ??: the training page cites none, so use your fastest Ape Atoll access.

hints.note: No transport cited on the training page.

label: Chin stacked maniacal monkeys until Ranged 99
detail: Pray Protect from Melee plus Rigour (Eagle Eye is ~5-7% slower), let the monkeys stack on you, and throw chinchompas on Medium fuse until 99. Page rates under ideal setups climb from 570,000-830,000 xp/hr at 75 to 740,000-1,030,000 at 99 by chin tier (level 70 sits between table rows). Grab the 1-dose prayer potions as they drop -- they are the fuel that makes the prayer cost near zero.

hints.note: Medium fuse = Rapid for chins; Longrange only to train Defence.
Rates assume stacked monkeys; a bonecrusher necklace (hard Morytania Diary) can replace prayer-pot pickup.

label: Cheaper alternative: grind Pest Control and spend the points on Ranged xp
detail: Take the minigame teleport (20-minute cooldown) or the squire on the Port Sarim docks south of the Lady Lumbridge to the Void Knights' Outpost. Board the highest lander your combat level allows (40/70/100 for novice/intermediate/veteran), fight pests and portals actively enough to earn points each round, and spend commendations on Ranged xp 100 points at a time for the 10% bonus. Page rates at 26 veteran games/hr: 76,600 xp/hr at 70-73 up to 157,100 at 98-99 with hard Combat Achievements.

hints.note: Spending 100 points at once pays 10% more xp per point.
Minigame teleport is direct but has a 20-minute cooldown.

label: Mine 1,946+ rune essence via Aubury's teleport
detail: Bank at Varrock east bank; Aubury's rune shop is just south. Right-click Aubury and pick Teleport (Rune Mysteries required). One click on an essence outcrop keeps mining until your inventory is full; step into a portal to land back beside Aubury, deposit, repeat. 1,946 essence covers 1-27 at the Air Altar's 5 xp per essence (derived from the cumulative XP table).

hints.note: Aubury (Varrock east) has the shortest bank loop in F2P; Sedridor sits in the Wizards' Tower basement.

mapMarkers.label: Rune essence mine (via NPC teleport only)

label: Bank: withdraw 28 rune essence, wear the air tiara
detail: At Falador east bank put on the air tiara (frees all 28 slots for essence and makes the altar entrance left-click) and withdraw 28 rune essence. No tiara yet? Keep the air talisman in your inventory and take 27 essence instead — you can make the tiara at the altar by using the talisman on it with a plain tiara along (25 xp).

hints.note: Tiara worn = 28 essence per lap; talisman carried = 27.

label: Run to the Air Altar ruins south of Falador
detail: Leave Falador through the south gate; the mysterious ruins sit north-west of the first T-junction you reach (2984,3291). The closest bank is Falador east.

hints.note: Ring of the elements teleports straight to the altar if owned.

label: Craft air runes until Runecraft 27
detail: Enter the ruins (left-click while wearing the tiara, or use the talisman on them), click the altar to craft the whole inventory into air runes, leave through the exit portal, and run back to Falador east bank for the next 28 essence. Roughly 70 bank laps at 5 xp per essence.

hints.note: Falador hard diary opens the Crafting Guild bank chest; a skills necklace teleport there shortens the lap.

label: Mine 5,740+ pure essence (Mining 30+)
detail: Same essence-mine loop as before: at Mining 30+ the outcrops yield pure essence, which every members altar needs. Wizard Distentor in the Yanille Wizards' Guild (Magic 66 to enter) has the shortest bank round-trip; Wizard Cromperty in East Ardougne is next best; Aubury still works. 5,740 essence covers 27-44 at 8 xp per essence (derived).

hints.note: Distentor (Wizards' Guild) is the page-stated best bank loop for members; Magic 66 gate.

label: Bank: withdraw the Zanaris loadout
detail: Wield the dramen (or lunar) staff, wear or carry the cosmic tiara/talisman, take every essence pouch you own, and fill the rest with pure essence.

hints.note: Fill pouches at the bank, empty them at the altar for a second craft per lap.

label: Enter Zanaris
detail: Fairy ring BKS lands at the main Zanaris portal (rings unlock partway into Fairytale II); without rings, walk into the small hut in the middle of Lumbridge Swamp while wielding the dramen/lunar staff. Lost City must be complete.

hints.note: BKS is fastest once fairy rings are open; the swamp hut needs the staff wielded.

label: Craft cosmic runes until Runecraft 44
detail: The mysterious ruins are in southern Zanaris just outside the shady grove (2407,4376). Take the jutting-wall shortcut (46 Agility; 66 for the advanced one — 4 damage on a fail). Craft your inventory plus pouches, then bank through the market's one-way fairy ring to Al Kharid bank and re-enter via BKS. 8 xp per essence; from 59 each essence gives two cosmics with no extra xp.

hints.note: The market fairy ring is one-way to Al Kharid bank; the Abyss also reaches this altar if you accept Wilderness risk.

label: Mine 21,360+ pure essence
detail: Keep the essence-mine loop running (Distentor/Cromperty/Aubury teleports, one click mines a full inventory, portal back, bank). 21,360 essence covers 44-59 at the Nature Altar's 9 xp per essence (derived) — this stock cost is exactly why GotR or lava is worth considering instead for this band.

label: Bank: withdraw the nature-run loadout
detail: Wear the nature tiara (or carry the talisman), wield the dramen/lunar staff for fairy rings, take every essence pouch, and fill the rest with pure essence.

label: Fairy ring CKR to Karamja, run to the Nature Altar ruins
detail: CKR drops you close by; the mysterious ruins are north of Shilo Village (2868,3018). With the Achievement diary cape you can instead teleport to Kaleb Paramaya and take the 79-Agility rocks shortcut.

hints.note: The Abyss also reaches this altar (Wilderness risk).

label: Craft nature runes until Runecraft 59
detail: Enter the ruins (left-click with the tiara worn), craft your inventory plus pouches, then head back out via the fairy ring network to a bank and repeat. 9 xp per essence; the page names no adjacent bank, so budget the lap time (bank route ??).

hints.note: If the stock/lap grind stalls, this band sits inside GotR's 40-50/50-75 buckets and lava's 50-row — both bank-adjacent loops.

label: Stock pure essence and an equal earth-rune stack
detail: Lava crafting burns one earth rune per essence, so the full 59-75 band needs about 91,670 of each (derived at 10.5 xp/essence). Mine essence on the Distentor/Cromperty/Aubury loop. Earth runes must also be gathered/produced, not bought — craft them at the Earth Altar or take them from minigame payouts (route ??). If that stock is unrealistic, Guardians of the Rift (methods[1]) self-supplies essence in-round at a flat 40,000 xp/hr for this exact band.

hints.note: GotR needs no banked essence stock and this band sits wholly inside its 40,000 xp/hr bucket.

label: Bank: withdraw the lava-lap loadout
detail: Equip the binding necklace (guarantees every combination batch; 16 charges, one per batch). Take: the earth-rune stack, 1-3 earth talismans (skip them entirely at Magic 82 + Lunar Diplomacy by casting Magic Imbue), every essence pouch, ring of the elements (or ring of dueling to the Emir's Arena), a bank teleport (Crafting cape / amulet of eternal glory / a stack of charged glories), stamina potions, and pure essence in every remaining slot.

hints.note: Keep one equipped; destroy a near-dead one on the way to the bank and equip fresh while banking.
Turn on automatic vial smashing via a barbarian guard so stamina vials never clog slots.

label: Teleport to the Fire Altar ruins
detail: Ring of the elements goes straight to the altar (page-preferred); ring of dueling lands at the Emir's Arena with the ruins just west (3312,3254), slightly farther on average and degradable.

label: Craft lava runes until Runecraft 75
detail: Enter the ruins (fire tiara worn, or hat of the eye attuned to one), then USE the earth-rune stack on the altar — plain-clicking it makes ordinary fire runes. Craft, empty each pouch, craft again, teleport to your bank, rebuild the inventory and repeat. Repair degrading pouches with NPC Contact while running to the altar (Magic 82 + Lunar) or with Apprentice Cordelia at the Temple of the Eye. 10.5 xp per essence.

hints.note: Cast NPC Contact for pouch repairs after clicking the ruins, never while standing at the bank.
One charge per combination batch; 3 charges per lap at 75+.

label: Play Guardians of the Rift until the Raiments of the Eye set and colossal pouch are yours
detail: Minigame teleport (or portal in the Wizards' Tower basement; bank chest just north of it). Each round: mine guardian fragments, craft guardian essence at the workbench, imbue it through the active elemental/catalytic portal, power the Great Guardian, keep barriers up. Rewards fund the Raiments set (10% more runes per piece, +20% set bonus = 60% total) and the abyssal needle that combines your pouches into the colossal pouch (40 essence). Pearl count needed: ??.

hints.note: Reward-roll dependent; both unlocks multiply every later essence, so front-load this.

label: Keep pure essence stocked for the endgame grind
detail: Path-dependent totals, all derived from cited per-essence xp: lava 75->95 needs ~720,109 essence (+equal earth runes); wrath 95->99 needs ~532,860; lava straight to 99 needs ~1,126,097. Mine on the Distentor/Cromperty/Aubury loop, or lean on GotR (methods[1]) which supplies its own essence in-round.

hints.note: No banked stock needed at GotR; 50,000-70,000 xp/hr across this band per its bucket table.

label: Bank: withdraw the Magic Imbue lava loadout
detail: Steam battlestaff wielded, binding necklace on, rune pouch with astral/cosmic/air (Magic Imbue + NPC Contact), all pouches (colossal if owned), the earth-rune stack, ring of the elements, a bank teleport (Crafting cape / eternal glory), stamina potions, pure essence everywhere else. Full Raiments worn for 60% more runes.

hints.note: Barbarian guard toggle; keeps stamina vials from wasting slots.

label: Craft lava runes until Runecraft 95
detail: Same Fire Altar lap as the last band but imbued: cast Magic Imbue before crafting (no talismans needed), use the earth runes on the altar, empty pouches, craft again, bank-teleport, repeat; repair pouches with NPC Contact while running in. Cited rows: 79,962 xp/hr at 75, 100,752 at 85, 102,060 at 99 (colossal pouch, Raiments).

hints.note: Magic Imbue and NPC Contact both cast on the move; click the ruins first, then cast.

label: Craft wrath runes until Runecraft 99 (profit branch)
detail: Needs Runecraft 95 + Dragon Slayer II. Fill the colossal pouch and inventory with pure essence, teleport to the Myths' Guild with the mythical cape, climb down the Mythic Statue, run south through the Corsair Cove Dungeon past the chromatic dragons (bring dragonfire protection), enter the ruins (2445,2824; wrath or catalytic tiara — the Abyss can NOT reach this altar), craft (8 xp/essence), bank-teleport (Crafting cape or dueling ring) and repeat. 75 runs/hr = 39,600 xp/hr, 85 = 44,880; roughly 95-107 hours 95->99, strongly profitable.

hints.note: Lock the mythical cape and pouch in bank settings, keep essence/staminas/NPC-Contact runes beside the Deposit-inventory button — one-click rebuilds.
House pool or Nardah restores HP + run energy between runs.

label: Keep crafting lava runes until Runecraft 99 (speed branch)
detail: Stay on the Magic Imbue lava lap: 102,060 xp/hr at 99 with the colossal pouch and Raiments — the fastest non-runner finish, at a gp cost instead of wrath's profit.

hints.note: Same imbue-and-repair-on-the-move lap as 75-95.

label: Withdraw your best melee set and a small stack of food
detail: Turael-tier assignments are deliberately weak monsters, so a basic melee loadout plus ~10 low-tier food covers every task in the pool; no task-specific gear is needed at this tier.

label: Go to Turael in Burthorpe
detail: Turael (Aya after While Guthix Sleeps) is the any-level starting Slayer master, based in Burthorpe; his shop also stocks basic Slayer equipment.

label: Ask Turael for a Slayer assignment
detail: Take a task; Turael awards 0 Slayer points per completion, so this tier is purely for levels. Masters assign from a weighted pool scaled to your combat level.

hints.note: Every Slayer master has a right-click Assignment option to grab/check a task without dialogue; the difficulty chat option toggles combat-level task checking on or off.

label: Kill each assigned batch, re-task with Turael immediately, repeat until Slayer 20
detail: Clear the assignment, walk straight back for the next one -- the pool is all easy monsters, so task turnover speed matters more than which monster you draw. Alternate with Spria in Draynor Village (needs A Porcine of Interest) if you want a second any-level task pool. Band total is 4,470 xp (levels 1-20).

hints.note: Task rolls vary; Turael's whole pool is low-level, so clear whatever is assigned rather than spending points on skips.

Natural history quiz, RFD's Mountain Dwarf subquest, A Porcine of Interest, and The General's Shadow pay 5,000 combined lump Slayer xp with no Slayer gate -- enough to cover this entire band by themselves.
Early task loot is near-worthless; don't detour to bank it, get back to Turael for the next assignment.

label: Withdraw melee gear, food, and a teleport toward Edgeville
detail: Mid-tier tasks hit harder than Turael's pool; bring your current best melee set and a fuller food stack before heading down the Edgeville Dungeon.

label: Go to Vannaka in the Edgeville Dungeon
detail: Requires 40 combat or 99 Slayer per the master-access table -- no quest gate, which is why this chain runs him as primary over Mazchna.

label: Talk to Vannaka for a Slayer task
detail: 8 Slayer points per task per the master-access table.

label: Complete Slayer tasks until Slayer 50
detail: Kill the assigned batch, re-task, repeat -- the target monster is genuinely randomised per assignment, not a fixed camp. Band total is 96,863 xp (levels 20-50).

hints.note: Vannaka's assignable-monster pool and per-task quantity aren't restated from the page here; left ?? rather than listing a guessed subset.
Royal Trouble, Wanted!, Lair of Tarn Razorlor, and The Heart of Darkness pay 23,000 combined lump Slayer xp across this band's own gates (Slayer 40/none/40/48).
The Dwarf Cannon quest unlocks the dwarf multicannon, which the page's recommended-quests list names for speeding tasks up at the cost of cannonballs.

label: Alt: run Mazchna's tasks from Canifis instead
detail: 6 points per task; requires Priest in Peril plus 20 combat or 99 Slayer. This is the band's continuity method -- take it when Morytania access is already open and you prefer its pool.

label: Bank and gear per assignment: combat set, food, cannon and/or barrage runes
detail: Re-kit at the bank for whatever was assigned: dwarf multicannon plus cannonballs for cannonable tasks (Dwarf Cannon quest), Ancient Magicks runes for barrage tasks (Desert Treasure I), otherwise your best melee/ranged set and food.

label: Go to Duradel in Shilo Village
detail: Duradel needs the Shilo Village quest plus 100 combat and 50 Slayer (or 99 Slayer); 15 points per task and the page's pick for fastest xp. Rotate a second, lower master for cheap filler tasks if points allow.

hints.note: Karamja gloves 3 teleport near Shilo Village for fast re-tasking; gloves 4 go directly to Duradel. Fairy rings (Fairytale II started) and slayer rings cover most task sites.

label: Take a task from Duradel
detail: Use the Assignment option; skip or block poor tasks with Slayer points rather than grinding them.

label: Grind tasks to Slayer 75, prioritising the page's 'Do' picks in range
detail: Best tasks reachable in this band per the Task-summary table: Bloodveld (Slayer 50 -- cannon mutated bloodvelds in the Meiyerditch Laboratories, up to 100,000 xp/hr with Venator bow, 80,000 with melee), Dust devils (65 -- barrage in the Catacombs of Kourend, 100,000-110,000 xp/hr), Dagannoth (85,000), Kalphites (cannon the soldiers, 75,000), Ankou (barrage in the Catacombs, 55,000), Fire giants (40,000, use Water spells for the Magic xp). Skip or block the table's poor performers. Band total is 1,109,088 xp (levels 50-75).

hints.note: Barrage tasks (Dust devils, Ankou) double as Magic training; Ancient Magicks requires Desert Treasure I.
Troubled Tortugans, Shadows of Custodia, The Path of Glouphrie, Perilous Moons, Champions' Challenge, and The Fremennik Exiles pay 168,348 combined lump Slayer xp at gates from 48 to 60.
Task rolls are weighted, not chosen; bank points from completion milestones to skip/block poor tasks. Turael boosting (taking in-between tasks from Turael) trades xp for faster points.
Catacombs barrage spots run crowded; hop worlds or take the Meiyerditch bloodveld cannon task instead.

label: Alt: task from Nieve beside the Stronghold Slayer Cave
detail: Nieve (Tree Gnome Stronghold) assigns from combat 85 -- no quest needed; Steve replaces her only after Monkey Madness II. She stands next to the Stronghold Slayer Cave, the magic trees, and the stronghold's southern bank, so re-tasking and re-banking are steps apart; 12 points per task (15 with the Elite Western Provinces Diary, matching Duradel).

label: Withdraw barrage runes, prayer supplies, food -- and stone-proof boots for Karuulm tasks
detail: Standard endgame kit is Ancient Magicks runes plus prayer potions and food. Any task inside the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon (wyrms and kin) additionally needs boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots against the floor heat unless the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is done.

label: Go to Konar quo Maten at Mount Karuulm
detail: Konar needs 75 combat or 99 Slayer; 18 points per task (20 with the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary) and she is the only master who assigns hydras. Rotate with Duradel (Shilo Village, 15 points, the page's fastest-xp pool) between milestone tasks.

hints.note: Fairy rings and slayer rings reach most endgame task sites; NPC Contact (Lunar Diplomacy) takes new assignments without travelling, though the rewards screen still needs a visit.

label: Take a task from Konar quo Maten
detail: Use the Assignment option; keep skips/blocks funded from milestone points so the rotation stays on the high-rate tasks.

label: Grind the endgame task rotation to Slayer 99, barraging the top tasks
detail: The Task-summary's top picks in this range: Smoke devils (Slayer 93 -- ~150,000 xp/hr barraged, the page's stated best Slayer rate in the game, rune costs covered by drops), Nechryael (80 -- ~100,000 xp/hr barraged in the Catacombs), Abyssal demons (85 -- 80,000 barraged or 53,000 low-effort Venator bow; do for whip money, block for pure xp), TzHaar (~100,000 with Blood Barrage), Araxytes (92 -- 100,000 cannon+Venator). On a wyrm task (62, Karuulm lower level): wear the stone-proof boots, no cannon placement is possible there, and attacking from distance locks wyrms to their magic attack. Band total is 11,824,010 xp (levels 75-99).

hints.note: Every top task here peaks via Magic barraging, so this band doubles as heavy Magic training; Ancient Magicks needs Desert Treasure I.
Wyrms only use their magic attack when hit from range -- Ranged plus Protect from Magic (or high magic defence) makes the task safe; a tile-lure safespot also exists per their page.
Turael boosting (cheap in-between tasks from Turael) accelerates points at an xp cost; boss tasks cost 200 points to unlock and add a flat 5,000 Slayer xp each, but their hourly xp is generally poor.
Nechryael and dust devil spots in the Catacombs run crowded; hop worlds rather than sharing spawns.

label: Withdraw the dwarf multicannon, cannonballs, combat gear, and food
detail: The cannon (Dwarf Cannon quest reward) is what makes this task fast; bring the four cannon pieces, a cannonball stack, and your normal combat set.

hints.note: Cannonballs per task aren't page-stated, and the Task-summary warns kalphite cannoning runs at a coin loss -- bring what the trip budget allows.

label: Travel to the Kalphite Cave
detail: The locations table names the Kalphite Cave as the site with the highest kalphite density and no listed disadvantage.

label: Set the cannon among the kalphite soldiers and clear tasks while assigned
detail: Place the cannon where soldier spawns cluster, keep it loaded, and finish stragglers by hand -- ~75,000 Slayer xp/hr per the Task-summary, a 'Do'-tier task. Slayer xp only flows while kalphites are your active assignment, so run this whenever the task comes up rather than camping off-task.

hints.note: This row only pays Slayer xp while kalphites are assigned; between assignments, continue the band's master rotation.

label: Withdraw the dwarf multicannon, cannonballs, your melee or Venator-bow set, and food
detail: Mutated bloodvelds are cleared fastest with the cannon backing either the Venator bow or melee; re-kit fully before the trip since the labs are a long way from a bank.

label: Travel to the Meiyerditch Laboratories
detail: The Task-summary's own listed drawback is that the trip takes a while -- plan full-length trips rather than short hops.

label: Cannon mutated bloodvelds while assigned, toward the row's Slayer 85 ceiling
detail: Set the cannon among the mutated bloodveld spawns and attack alongside it -- ~100,000 xp/hr with the Venator bow or 80,000 with melee. Meiyerditch is the location where drops actually cover the cannonball bill; the same task cannoned in the Stronghold Slayer Cave loses money, and Buccaneers' Laboratory is the page's other viable cannon site.

hints.note: Pick up the drops -- at this location they cover the cannon's running cost per the Task-summary.
Slayer xp flows only while bloodvelds are the active assignment; weave this row in whenever the task is rolled.

label: Alt from Slayer 75: gargoyles in the Slayer Tower, rock hammer in inventory
detail: Attack gargoyles normally and finish each with the rock hammer when its health runs low (any Slayer master sells the hammer for 500 coins). ~30,000 xp/hr -- a profit task, not an xp task; no cannon works inside the tower, the Morytania diaries add bonus Slayer xp there on task, and Grotesque Guardians can be fought on the same assignment.

hints.note: The tower's gargoyle floor runs crowded; hop worlds rather than splitting spawns.

label: Bank: withdraw a hammer and a pickaxe
detail: Grab a hammer (the anvil's only tool) and a pickaxe -- every ore in this chain is self-mined, never bought. The smithing anvil sits just south of the west Varrock bank; the ore comes from the Al Kharid mine, which has a bank and furnace right by it.

label: Mine copper and tin ore at the Al Kharid mine, in equal counts
detail: Both rocks are level-1 Mining (17.5 xp each) in the mine just north of Al Kharid -- an F2P mine beside a bank and furnace. One copper + one tin makes one bronze bar, so keep the two counts matched.

hints.note: Banks Mining xp on the side (17.5 xp per ore, both rocks).

label: Smelt the ore into bronze bars at the Al Kharid furnace
detail: 1 copper ore + 1 tin ore -> 1 bronze bar: Smithing 1, 6.2 xp per bar, F2P. The furnace is steps from the Al Kharid bank per the mine's own page -- smelt, bank the bars, repeat until your ore is gone.

label: Smith the bronze ladder at the West Varrock anvil until Smithing 15
detail: Withdraw bars + hammer at the west Varrock bank and smith the highest-tier bronze item you have bars for at the anvil just south: daggers (1 bar) to 5, scimitars (2 bars) to 9, then warhammers (3 bars) through 15 -- 13,900 / 25,700 / 36,200 xp/h per the page's own table. The coin loss on low-level items is small; the page notes the whole 1-40 anvil stretch takes under an hour. Shortcut: The Knight's Sword alone awards 12,725 Smithing xp in under 10 minutes (page's questing section), overshooting this entire band.

label: Bank: withdraw hammer and pickaxe at the Al Kharid bank
detail: Same two tools as the last band. The mine -> furnace -> bank loop stays inside Al Kharid; only the anvil trips go to west Varrock.

label: Mine copper/tin, then iron, at the Al Kharid mine
detail: Copper + tin feed the bronze platebody bracket (18-24). From 24, switch to the mine's iron rocks (Mining 15, 35 xp each) -- three iron rocks are minable there without moving, per the mine's own page. Bars are never bought: the coarse row's GE option is dropped for self-mined ore. Iron smelting fails half the time without a ring of forging, so mine roughly double the iron you need.

label: Smelt bronze, then iron bars at the Al Kharid furnace
detail: Bronze bar: 1 copper + 1 tin, Smithing 1. Iron bar: 1 iron ore, Smithing 15, 12.5 xp -- but only a 50% success per ore at a normal furnace without a ring of forging.

hints.value: 50% smelt success without ring of forging
hints.note: A ring of forging removes the failure at a normal furnace; otherwise budget ~2 iron ore per bar.

label: Smith bronze platebodies, then iron warhammers, at the West Varrock anvil until Smithing 30
detail: Finish the bronze warhammer bracket to 18, then bronze platebodies (5 bars, 52,100 xp/h) from 18-24, then iron warhammers (3 bars, 72,300 xp/h) from 24 through 30 -- the page's own 1-40 item ladder.

label: Bank: withdraw hammer + banked iron ore/coal
detail: Withdraw a hammer plus your banked iron ore and coal (all own-mined, non-GE). Coal only matters for the 39-40 steel warhammer tail; 30-39 runs on iron bars alone.

label: Mine iron ore (and coal for the steel tail) at the Al Kharid mine
detail: Iron rocks are Mining 15; the same mine's coal rocks need Mining 30, per its own rock table. 1 iron + 2 coal per steel bar at a standard furnace -- the identical recipe train-magic-43's Superheat loop consumes, so double-stock if that step is queued in this segment.

label: Smelt bars, then smith iron platebodies (steel warhammers from 39) at the West Varrock anvil until Smithing 40
detail: Each bank cycle: smelt at a furnace first -- iron bars carry 30-39 (ring of forging, or ~2x ore for the 50% failure), steel needs 1 iron + 2 coal -- then anvil-smith iron warhammers to 33, iron platebodies (5 bars, 104,200 xp/h) from 33-39, and steel warhammers (3 bars, 108,500 xp/h) for 39-40, per the page's own ladder table.

hints.note: Superheat Item (Magic 43+) smelts the same bars for passive Smithing xp -- xref: training:train-magic-43 (same recipe, already in this segment).

label: Bank: withdraw pickaxe + hammer
detail: Pickaxe equipped for mining, hammer for the anvil. This checkpoint walks the gather-compliant anvil chain (methods[2]), not the coarse row's Blast Furnace gold pick -- the page itself says that method costs money via Grand Exchange gold ore.

label: Mine iron ore and coal (own-mined, never bought)
detail: 1 iron + 2 coal per steel bar, 5 bars per platebody. The Al Kharid mine covers both rocks (iron Mining 15, coal Mining 30) without needing the Mining Guild's level-60 gate, and has a bank and furnace beside it.

label: Smelt steel bars at the Al Kharid furnace (1 iron + 2 coal each)
detail: Steel smelting never fails (only iron does). Smelt, bank, repeat until the ore stock is bars.

label: Smith steel platebodies at an anvil until Smithing 60
detail: Steel platebodies unlock at Smithing 48 (the page's armour table starts there, 144,000 xp/h): from 40-48, smith the best steel item you have bars for -- the fetched sections state no rate for that stretch. 5 steel bars per platebody. No goldsmith gauntlets needed, unlike the coarse row's own Blast Furnace gold-bar pick.

hints.note: Banked platebodies feed the passive High Alchemy embed (steps.jsonl embed-alch-smithing, Magic 55) instead of GE sale.

label: Mine mithril ore and coal at the Al Kharid mine (2 coal per ore for the Blast Furnace)
detail: Mithril rocks need Mining 55 (two sit in this mine); coal rocks Mining 30, per the mine's own rock table. The Blast Furnace uses half the coal of a normal furnace: 1 mithril ore + 2 coal per bar (vs 4), so provision at a 1:2 ratio. Nearing Smithing 70, start stockpiling adamantite ore too (Mining 70 rocks in the same mine; 3 coal each at the Furnace) for the next band.

label: Get to the Blast Furnace in Keldagrim
detail: Use the Minigame Teleport to Blast Furnace, or the minecart from the Grand Exchange to Keldagrim. Keldagrim access requires The Giant Dwarf started: talk to the Dwarven Boatman inside the dungeon east of Rellekka once.

hints.note: Both routes need The Giant Dwarf started (Dwarven Boatman, east of Rellekka).

label: Bank chest: withdraw ore + stamina doses; wear ice gloves and bring a coal bag if owned
detail: The page recommends ice gloves (to cool the bar dispenser), a coal bag, weight-reducing clothing, and stamina potions for Blast Furnace work; how to obtain the gloves/bag is not covered in the fetched sections (??). The bank chest sits beside the conveyor belt.

label: Run the conveyor loop -- smelt mithril bars at the Blast Furnace until Smithing 70
detail: Each trip: withdraw ore at the bank chest, deposit it onto the conveyor belt, collect finished bars at the dispenser, re-bank. Use an official Blast Furnace world, where dwarf NPCs keep the furnace running for a 72,000 coins/hour fee (at Smithing 60+ the under-60 Foreman payment no longer applies). Adamant bars unlock at exactly 70, the top of this band. The section's rate table is an unexpanded template in the wikitext, so xp/h stays ?? (matches the coarse row's own note).

label: Mine adamantite ore + coal (switch to runite ore at Smithing 85)
detail: Adamantite rocks (Mining 70; two at the Al Kharid mine) cover 70-85: 1 ore + 3 coal per bar at the Blast Furnace (6 at a normal furnace). From Smithing 85, rune bars open: 1 runite ore + 4 coal at the Furnace (8 normal). No runite rocks exist at Al Kharid, and no fetched page pins a runite site or its Mining gate (??).

mapMarkers.label: Al Kharid mine (adamantite + coal; no runite here)

label: Get to the Blast Furnace in Keldagrim
detail: Minigame Teleport or the Grand Exchange minecart; Keldagrim access carries over from the prior band's Giant Dwarf start.

hints.note: Same two routes as the previous band.

label: Bank chest: withdraw ore + stamina doses; wear ice gloves and bring a coal bag if owned
detail: Same loadout as the previous band: ice gloves, coal bag, weight-reducing gear, stamina potions (the page's recommendations; sourcing not covered in the fetched sections, ??). Bank chest beside the conveyor.

label: Run the conveyor loop -- adamant bars, then rune bars from 85, until Smithing 99
detail: Same trip cycle: bank chest -> conveyor belt -> bar dispenser -> bank. Rune bars require Smithing 85 even at the Blast Furnace, so 70-85 stays on adamant. The non-gold rate table is an unexpanded template (xp/h ??, matches the coarse row's note). Page-stated alternates if the Furnace loop stalls: gold bars with goldsmith gauntlets + Smithing cape, 410,000 xp/h (420,000 with 0-tick banking); anvil adamant platebodies from 88, 240,000 xp/h; 3-bar rune items (platelegs/plateskirts/2h swords) from 95 with a Kovac's grog boost, 210,000 xp/h.

label: Walk to the Lumbridge East Farm chicken pen
detail: Cross the bridge east of Lumbridge Castle and follow the path north-east to the fenced chicken pen (Lumbridge East Farm). No bank setup needed -- chickens need no food or gear. This pen is free-to-play per the Chicken page's own location table.

label: Set your combat style to Aggressive
detail: Open the combat tab and pick the Aggressive style so melee damage xp goes to Strength (not Attack/Defence).

hints.note: Re-toggle to Accurate/Defensive when running the sibling Attack/Defence bands over this same pen.

label: Kill chickens until Strength 10
detail: Collapsed grind loop. No food needed at this HP/damage level; chickens are non-aggressive so kills are near-instant.

hints.note: Bury bones on the spot for early Prayer xp, or bank them if passing through Lumbridge.

label: Alt: run Waterfall Quest for an instant jump to Strength ~30
detail: Start at Almera's house north-east of Baxtorian Falls; the full walkthrough is tracked separately (oppgran:atoms:quest-waterfall-quest, starting at wf-01-talk-almera-start). Finishing awards 13,750 Attack xp + 13,750 Strength xp in one turn-in -- enough to skip this band and most of band 30, and it pairs with the sibling Attack bands.

label: Walk to the cow field by the Lumbridge windmill
detail: Head to the cow field north of the windmill, north-west of Lumbridge -- quieter than the classic east-Lumbridge pen. No bank setup needed; cows are non-aggressive and require no food.

label: Set your combat style to Aggressive
detail: Open the combat tab and pick the Aggressive style so melee damage xp goes to Strength (not Attack/Defence).

label: Kill cows until Strength 30
detail: Collapsed grind loop. Cows are non-aggressive and low-Defence so no food is needed. ctr-02-kill-cows' own until stops at Strength 20 (shared Attack/Defence routing) -- continue on the same cows past that point to reach Strength 30.

hints.note: Cowhide banking is optional -- skip it if inventory churn slows kills.

label: Bank: deposit cow loot
detail: Deposit cowhides/bones/coins if any were banked during the grind (Al Kharid or Lumbridge Castle top-floor bank).

label: Alt: sail to the Rock Crabs on Waterbirth Island
detail: Reached via Jarvald's boat once The Fremennik Trials is started (or a 1,000gp toll); crabs also line the shore north of Rellekka.

label: Alt: kill Rock Crabs until Strength 30
detail: Very high Hitpoints with low Defence/Attack so little food is needed; aggro resets after roughly 10-15 minutes -- walk away and back to reset.

label: Walk to Barbarian Village
detail: South of Edgeville, west of Varrock. No bank setup needed -- the village fishing spot and range let you catch and cook trout/salmon for food on-site; Edgeville bank sits just north if you would rather withdraw.

label: Set your combat style to Aggressive
detail: Open the combat tab and pick the Aggressive style so melee damage xp goes to Strength (not Attack/Defence).

label: Kill barbarians until Strength 40
detail: Collapsed grind loop. ctr-05-kill-barbarians' own until is 30/30/30 across all three melee stats -- continue on the same barbarians past that point for Strength 40 alone. Light food recommended once damage picks up.

hints.note: Barbarian Village fishing spot + range sit beside the huts -- restock food between kill sets.

label: Bank: deposit barbarian loot
detail: Deposit bones/coins and any weapon/armour drops at Edgeville bank, just north.

label: Alt: walk to the Sand Crabs on the Hosidius shore
detail: Beach along the southern Hosidius coast; a bank chest sits nearby, and the Avium Savannah beach spot is significantly less crowded.

mapMarkers.label: Sand Crabs east of the Hosidius vinery

label: Alt: kill Sand Crabs until Strength 40
detail: ctr-07a-sand-crabs' own until is 50/50/50 -- this row stops earlier, at Strength 40. Very high Hitpoints with low Defence/Attack so minimal food is needed; run two spots away and back to reset aggro.

hints.note: Crab spots are the classic contested hotspot -- hop worlds before walking to another beach.

label: Bank: withdraw the Hill Giant loadout at Edgeville
detail: Withdraw a brass key (unlocks the Edgeville Dungeon door -- source separately if not owned), food (count ??), and your best weapon equipped. The Edgeville Dungeon Hill Giant spot is free-to-play per its own location table.

label: Go to the Hill Giant room in Edgeville Dungeon
detail: Entrance is the ruined house with a trapdoor north-east of Barbarian Village, west of the Cooks' Guild; unlock the giants' door with the brass key.

label: Kill Hill Giants until Strength 60
detail: Collapsed grind loop on Aggressive style. Aggressive to players below combat 57 (max hit 4); always drops big bones.

hints.note: Big bones always drop -- bank for the Prayer band or bury on the spot.
Edgeville Dungeon is usually crowded on F2P worlds.

label: Bank: deposit Hill Giant loot
detail: Deposit big bones, coins, and any weapon/armour drops at Edgeville bank.

label: Alt: descend to the Flesh Crawlers (Stronghold of Security level 2)
detail: Enter the Stronghold hole in the centre of Barbarian Village and descend to the Catacomb of Famine. No food needed at these stats -- crawlers hit low and aggro stacks; no bank loadout required beyond your weapon.

hints.note: Doors ask account-security questions; any correct answer opens them.

label: Alt: kill Flesh Crawlers until Strength 60
detail: ctr-06-stronghold-crawlers' own until is 40/40/40 -- continue on the same crawlers past that point to Strength 60. Near-AFK: stand in a spawn pack and let them stack; the Catacomb of Famine spot is free-to-play per the Flesh Crawler page's own location table.

hints.note: Room contested: hop; spawn clusters are identical across worlds.

label: Bank: withdraw the Moss Giant loadout
detail: Withdraw food (count ??) and your best weapon/armour for the style being trained.

label: Go to the Moss giants west of the Fishing Guild
detail: Surface spot west of the Fishing Guild, Kandarin -- members=Yes for this specific location per the Moss giant page's own table; no key or quest gate, unlike the Catacombs of Kourend or Varrock Sewers alternatives on the same page.

mapMarkers.label: Moss giants west of the Fishing Guild

label: Kill Moss giants until Strength 70
detail: Collapsed grind loop on Aggressive style. Always drops big bones; level 42, max hit 6, Crush attack, 50% Fire weakness. A real player likely trains Attack/Strength/Defence concurrently here by rotating styles -- this band models the Strength share.

hints.note: Big bones always drop -- bank for Prayer training or bury on the spot.
Popular training spot; hop worlds if contested.

label: Bank: deposit Moss Giant loot
detail: Deposit big bones, coins, and any drops -- the Fishing Guild bank is the closest.

label: Alt: grind Wilderness Slayer tasks until Strength 70
detail: Take tasks from the Wilderness Slayer master and kill them on Aggressive style; trains combat and Slayer simultaneously (Slayer helm accuracy/damage bonuses) but carries PK risk. No xp/hr figure stated on the cited section.

label: Bank: withdraw the Nightmare Zone loadout at Yanille
detail: Withdraw the rumble gear -- Dharok's set (optimal once 92+ Hitpoints) or, otherwise, full Blood Moon armour + Dual macuahuitl, or Obsidian armour + Berserker necklace + Toktz-Xil-Ak -- plus coins to fund the dream coffer (amount ??). Absorption/overload potions are bought inside with NMZ reward points, not carried in.

label: Go to Nightmare Zone
detail: The enclosure sits north of Yanille, north-west of the bank; entry needs 5 of Nightmare Zone's accepted quests completed (see methods[].reqs.quests).

hints.note: Minigame teleport is direct once NMZ requirements are met; Watchtower Teleport lands west, run east.

label: Talk to Dominic Onion to set up a rumble dream
detail: Speak to Dominic inside the NMZ enclosure, pay the coffer, and pick a customisable rumble; if grouping, invite the other participants inside the enclosure before he begins.

label: Customise the rumble boss list
detail: Toggle the boss selection for your gear setup; note the page's warning that enabling the Dream Mentor bosses while the Desert Treasure I bosses are disabled applies a large (83.33%) point penalty -- enable them together or not at all.

hints.note: Disabling bosses reduces points per kill; keep the selection consistent across dreams.

label: Drink the Dream potion to enter the rumble
detail: Drinking the Dream potion Dominic provides begins the dream; grouped players are prompted to join once the host drinks.

label: Kill rumble bosses until Strength 80
detail: Collapsed grind loop. Page calls this the fastest solo Attack/Strength xp/hr in the game once geared (Dharok's set (optimal once 92+ Hitpoints) or, otherwise, full Blood Moon armour + Dual macuahuitl, or Obsidian armour + Berserker necklace + Toktz-Xil-Ak). Overload/absorption potions bought with NMZ points reduce food/potion costs; deaths are safe (only arena-dropped loot is lost). Bosses respawn endlessly until you die or leave. The Strategies subpage cites ~50,000-80,000 melee xp/hr at stats 50-75 on Hard customisable rumbles with overloads, scaling ~800-1,000 xp/hr per Attack/Strength level as gear improves.

label: Alt: enter Scurrius' lair in the Varrock Sewers
detail: Climb down the manhole just east of Varrock Palace; the lair is east of the sewers entrance, entered by climbing through the broken bars (leave by crossing the sewage water; ~15s delay before rejoining).

label: Alt: kill Scurrius until Strength 80
detail: Group-instance boss aimed at combat level 60-90 that teaches prayer switching and positioning; grants more xp than normal kills, especially with rat bone weapons -- the page calls the rates competitive with Nightmare Zone and sand crabs. The bone mace is smithed from Scurrius' spine (1/33 drop, one player per kill).

hints.note: Only one player may receive a spine per kill; the rat bone weapon bonus xp starts once you smith the bone mace.

label: Bank: withdraw the Kruk's Dungeon loadout
detail: Withdraw food (count ??), prayer potions to start the session (the monkeys' own 1-dose prayer potion drops sustain it), and a light source for the lower level.

label: Go to the maniacal monkeys in Kruk's Dungeon
detail: Kruk's Dungeon on Ape Atoll, visited during Monkey Madness II (note: the route gates this on quest-mm/Monkey Madness I -- a held-data vs wiki-page mismatch, flagged rather than reconciled). Dense spawn clusters sit on both the Lower and Upper Levels.

label: Set your combat style to Aggressive
detail: Open the combat tab and pick the Aggressive style so melee damage xp goes to Strength (not Attack/Defence).

label: Kill maniacal monkeys until Strength 99
detail: Collapsed grind loop. Extremely dense, highly aggressive spawn (combat level 140, max hit 18, only 10 Defence); commonly drops 1-dose prayer potions -- more than you drink, so Protect-prayer upkeep pays for itself. Every kill drops small ninja monkey bones.

hints.note: Prayer potions drop more often than they are used here; the monkey bones stack up for Prayer training.

label: Bank: deposit maniacal monkey loot
detail: Deposit prayer potions, monkey bones, and any other kept drops.

label: Alt: walk to the Sulphur Naguas in Neypotzli
detail: Ancient Prison, through the south-west entrance of the Neypotzli antechamber; requires partial completion of Perilous Moons. Sun icons on the floor mark each nagua's respawn spot -- stand where several overlap so they stay aggressive to you.

label: Alt: kill Sulphur Naguas until Strength 99
detail: Naguas have -4 flat armour (every successful hit does 4 extra damage), which favours fast or multi-hit weapons. They hit twice per attack, and after five attacks raise their weapon for a special: step out of melee range within three ticks or lose 5 prayer points. Brew moonlight potions to restore prayer and boost melee stats while camping here.

hints.note: The page notes a cooking-stove safespot, though free supplies inside Neypotzli usually make it unnecessary.

label: Go to the Men and Women around Lumbridge Castle
detail: Start in the Lumbridge Castle courtyard - Men and Women wander there and by the general store. No bank loadout for this whole band: everything you steal gets dropped. With Lumbridge respawn you can simply die to refill Hitpoints; or trap the Man beside the Draynor Village Agility Course start inside his house so he never wanders off.

hints.value: trap him inside the house at the rooftop-course start
hints.note: He stays on one tile - zero repositioning between picks.

mapMarkers.label: Man/Woman spawn cluster (Lumbridge, near the general store) - marker reused from existing train-thieving-20 row
Man/Woman spawn cluster (Edgeville, near the bank) - marker reused from existing train-thieving-20 row

label: Pickpocket Men/Women until Thieving 5
detail: Spam-click Pickpocket on a Man or Woman - 8 xp per success, 49 successful picks reaches level 5. A failed pick stuns you ~4.8s and deals 1 damage; just keep clicking through it.

hints.note: Options > controller icon > NPC 'Attack' options: Hidden makes Pickpocket the left-click for every pickpocket method from here on.
Man pickpocket chance table; 4.8s stun + 1 damage on a fail.

label: At 5, head to the eastern bakery stall in the East Ardougne market
detail: Make your way to the East Ardougne market square (travel means: ?? - the training page cites none; any Ardougne route works). The target is the EASTERN of the bakery stalls - stand directly under the baker so the patrolling guards never flag you.

hints.note: The page's pictured safespot - guards cannot catch you from there.

label: Steal from the bakery stall until Thieving 20, dropping the food
detail: Steal from the stall the instant it restocks and drop everything - up to 19,200 xp/hr. Tea and silk stalls respawn slower, so stay on the bakery. The page's stall band runs to 25, but this step ends at 20 - the H.A.M. Hideout takes over next.

hints.note: Power-steal: drop loot between respawns; keep a few cakes only if you want free low-tier food.

label: Go to the H.A.M. Hideout trapdoor west of Lumbridge
detail: Fastest per the wiki: rub a charged amulet of glory to Draynor Village and run east (~33 ticks); or Lumbridge Teleport, west through the castle and out the gate, then north-west (~41 ticks). Climb down the trapdoor. No bank loadout needed - keep inventory space free for robe pieces and wear nothing you fear losing.

hints.note: Page orders these ~33 / ~37 / ~41 ticks.

mapMarkers.label: H.A.M. Hideout (marker reused from existing train-thieving-38 row; no more-precise fetched pin)

label: Pickpocket H.A.M. members until Thieving 38
detail: Pickpocket the robed cultists - 22.2 xp per success (level 15 requirement). A failed pick concusses you for 1-3 damage, and THREE concussions in one visit gets you booted from the camp or locked in the jail cell (lockpick the door or teleport out). After two fails, step out of the hideout and back in - leaving resets the concussion count to zero. Wear every H.A.M. robe piece you steal: each lowers ejection chance ~4% (~28% for all seven) though none of it raises pickpocket success.

hints.note: H.A.M. Member pickpocket chance table; 4s stun, 1-3 damage on a fail.
Resets the 3-concussion ejection counter; high Agility makes 'partially avoided' blows not count at all.
Equip robe pieces as they drop - the anti-ejection set builds itself.
One shared hideout instance per world.

label: Go to the two fruit stalls in the easternmost coastal house of Hosidius
detail: Head to the house closest to the Hosidius beach on the far east side - it holds TWO fruit stalls a few tiles apart with no guard dogs patrolling. Travel means: ?? (no teleport cited on the training page). No bank loadout: the fruit gets dropped.

mapMarkers.label: Fruit stall (eastern coastal house pair) - from Thieving_training.s20 {{Map}} pin
Fruit stall (eastern coastal house pair) - from Thieving_training.s20 {{Map}} pin
Fruit stall (Hosidius market - guard dogs patrol here) - from Thieving_training.s20 {{Map}} pin

label: Steal from both fruit stalls until Thieving 49, dropping fruit as you bounce between them
detail: Alternate between the two stalls, stealing the instant each restocks, and drop the fruit while running between them - up to 42,750 xp/hr (34,200 if you camp one stall). Eat the strange fruits you steal, or sip stamina potions, to keep run energy topped up.

hints.note: Strange fruit restores run energy. Want the produce instead? Use the market stall with 15-20 baskets - slower xp.
Lure the dogs slightly north, then stand directly south of the stall - the page's pictured trap.

label: At 49, move up to Port Piscarilius and set up the two guard lures
detail: Run north-east from Hosidius into Port Piscarilius. Before your first heist, lure the two guards away from the bridges so you can cross unseen - the loop does not work without this one-time setup (the Stealing artefacts page details the pull spots).

label: Bank: withdraw lockpick + stamina potions, wear graceful
detail: Withdraw a lockpick (required for the house drawers) and a stack of stamina potions; wear full graceful or your lightest gear. Bring Kharedst's memoirs or the book of the dead if owned - its Fisher's Flute teleport shortcuts the return leg of every heist (recharge the book at the Old Memorial).

hints.note: The page's rate table assumes this teleport plus stamina potions.

label: Run Captain Khaled's artefact heists until Thieving 55
detail: Loop: talk to Captain Khaled for a house assignment; run (or Fisher's Flute teleport) toward the assigned house; picklock the door and steal the artefact from its drawers; smuggle it back past the patrolling guards; hand it in and take the next job. 500-1,000 coins per heist. Getting caught tanks the rate - wait out patrol gaps rather than forcing a crossing.

hints.note: Khaled hands out the target house and takes the hand-in.
Page: waiting for an opening beats risking a catch.
Page pairs heist running with move-friendly actions: fletching ammo, High Alchemy, gem cutting, Bake Pie.

label: Travel to Pollnivneach (Kharidian Desert)
detail: Pollnivneach is the desert town The Feud takes place in, south of Al Kharid. Travel means: ?? - the training page cites none. You must have played The Feud at least through Ali the Operator's pickpocketing chapter: that is where the blackjack technique is taught and the oak blackjack equipped, and blackjacking stays locked without it.

label: Bank: withdraw blackjack + noted inventory-blocking food
detail: Loadout: a blackjack of ANY type, plus NOTED Saradomin brews (or pies/curries) - unnote them at the Banknote Exchange Merchant beside the Pollnivneach general store. Wear full rogue equipment if owned: double loot, no extra xp (unlocked from the Rogues' Den wall safe at 50 Thieving). Keep the inventory FULL at all times - with a full pack you cannot accidentally true-pickpocket a conscious bandit and eat the stun.

hints.note: Page: keep the empty vial after each brew sip so the inventory stays full.

label: Or: buy jugs of wine from Faisal at The Asp & Snake Bar
detail: Cheaper food alternative to brews: buy jugs of wine from Faisal, the barman at The Asp & Snake Bar in southern Pollnivneach. The wine rate column runs slightly under the brew column but skips the banknote unnoting round-trips.

label: Blackjack the scimitar-wielding Pollnivnian bandits until Thieving 65
detail: Lure a NON-bearded, scimitar-wielding level-56 bandit into Ali the Dyer's small house in northern Pollnivneach, out of the other bandits' sight. Loop: Knock-Out, then Pickpocket TWICE while he is unconscious - the timing is right when xp drops land every 2 game ticks. Failed knock-out? Instantly try the knock-out again, or 'pickpocket' with your full inventory to reset his aggression without a real pick. If he starts attacking, unequip the blackjack (or swap weapons) and attempt a knock-out to cancel combat, wait a moment, re-equip and resume. The house ladder is a quick aggro reset.

hints.note: Page setup: hide NPC attack options, resizable + zoomed in, camera angled so right-click lands on Pickpocket; Menu Entry Swapper can make Pickpocket left-click on the unconscious bandit.

hints.value: trap the bandit so he cannot walk through you
hints.note: Knock him out, dart around him, stand back in front - he stays trapped and never re-teleports while the loop continues.
Page rates (resupply included): 136k/121k brews/wines at 55 up to 230k/209k at 65 - expect less while learning.

label: Head to southern Pollnivneach, by The Asp & Snake Bar
detail: Menaphite Thugs stand in the southern part of town; one can be lured into the SOUTH room of Ali the Dyer's house right next to the bar. Coming straight from the 55-65 bandit block, you are already in town - just walk south.

label: Bank: restock the blackjack loadout (noted brews or bar wines)
detail: Same loadout as the bandit block: blackjack, a full inventory of blocking food - unnote noted brews at the Banknote Exchange Merchant by the general store, or buy jugs of wine from Faisal at the bar - and rogue equipment for double loot. Resupply time is already baked into the page's rate table.
