label: Blackjack Menaphite Thugs until Thieving 91
detail: The identical Knock-Out then double-Pickpocket rhythm from the bandits, now on the thugs by the bar: keep the inventory full, re-knock instantly on a failed knock-out (or full-inventory 'pickpocket' to clear aggression), weapon-swap out of combat if he connects. At 91 you choose a finisher: stay on thugs or switch to Pyramid Plunder.

hints.value: lure the thug into the south room beside the bar
hints.note: Same trap discipline as the bandits: he must not be able to walk through you.
Page rates climb 230k to 257k (brews) across 65-90; wines run slightly under.
The 45-91 stretch pays ~2.5M coins, ~5M with full rogue equipment.

label: Finisher A: stay on Menaphite Thugs until Thieving 99
detail: Ride the exact same loop to 99 - 265,000/261,000 xp/hr (brews/wines) at 99 and up to 270,000-275,000 at maximum efficiency. Click-intensive, but zero re-positioning or new unlocks needed.

label: Finisher B: from 91, run Pyramid Plunder rounds in Sophanem until 99
detail: Fastest Thieving xp outside the Wilderness from 91: 270,000 xp/hr, roughly 335 games from 91 to 99. Access: start Icthlarin's Little Helper for Sophanem, or teleport straight to Jalsavrah with a charged pharaoh's sceptre (a sceptre teleport to the guardian mummy is what the top rate assumes; recharge it with the noted golden artefacts you loot, and Desert Diary tiers add charges - no sceptre means completing Contact! for the bank near the pyramid). Bring Saradomin brews, stamina potions, and antipoison (araxyte venom sacs save slots). Each round: push to the LAST room, loot its golden chest and ALL its urns, opening the golden chests along the way; spend leftover time on second-to-last-room urns. Do not bank the artefacts - keep them for sceptre recharges.

hints.note: The sceptre teleport straight to the guardian mummy is the top-rate assumption.
You may loot a sceptre from the golden chests while training - keep or sell.
Artefacts recharge the sceptre; banking them tanks the rate and they are not worth much.

label: Go to a regular-tree cluster near a bank
detail: Head to any cluster of regular trees close to a bank (Lumbridge or Varrock both work) — the page notes regular trees are found almost everywhere.

hints.note: Each regular tree gives only a single log before it disappears, so pick a spot with several trees.

label: Chop regular trees until Woodcutting 15
detail: Chop regular trees until Woodcutting 15 (25 xp/log; the page states 97 logs from a fresh account).

hints.note: The page's fastest-xp guidance is to drop every log rather than bank or process them.

label: Buy a steel axe if not already carrying a better one
detail: Buy a steel axe (Woodcutting 6 / Attack 5 to wield) from Bob's or Lunami's axe shops (the Axe page's named vendors); skip if you already own iron or better.

label: Equip the steel axe
detail: Wield the steel axe before chopping.

label: Chop oak trees until Woodcutting 30
detail: Chop oak trees near a bank until Woodcutting 30 (37.5 xp/log; the page's level-99 benchmark for oak is 40,000 xp/hr).

hints.note: Drop every log for the fastest rate.
Join any Forestry event that spawns at your oak spot for bonus xp and anima-infused bark before returning to chopping.

label: Alt: chop oak at a named Forestry-event spot
detail: Alternative: park at an oak spot and join every Forestry event that spawns, trading a little raw xp/hr for anima-infused bark currency.

hints.note: Official members Forestry worlds cited by the page; more players means more events.

label: Buy a mithril axe if not already carrying a better one
detail: Buy a mithril axe (Woodcutting 21 / Attack 20 to wield) from Lunami.

label: Equip the mithril axe
detail: Wield the mithril axe before chopping.

label: Chop willow trees until Woodcutting 45
detail: Chop willows near a bank until Woodcutting 45 (67.5 xp/log; the page's level-99 benchmark for willow is 74,000 xp/hr).

hints.note: Keep dropping logs for the fastest rate.
If Draynor willows are crowded, the Guild pond (7 willows, opens at Woodcutting 60) or Seers' Village are the page's other listed spots.

label: Alt: chop teak trees (members) instead of willow
detail: Alternative from level 35: teak (members) beats willow on flat xp/hr with no tick manipulation needed at this band.

label: Buy an adamant axe if not already carrying a better one
detail: Buy an adamant axe (Woodcutting 31 / Attack 30 to wield) from Lunami.

label: Equip the adamant axe
detail: Wield the adamant axe before chopping.

label: Chop maple trees until Woodcutting 60
detail: Chop maples near a bank until Woodcutting 60 (100 xp/log, 110 with the medium Kandarin Diary; the page's level-99 benchmark for maple is 48,000 xp/hr).

hints.note: Drop every log for the fastest rate.
The Guild opens at 60 with 13 maples by its bank chest; Seers' Village is the page's top pick before then.

label: Alt: keep chopping teak trees (members) instead of maple
detail: Alternative: teak keeps outpacing maple on flat xp/hr through this band.

label: Go to the Woodcutting Guild
detail: Travel to the Woodcutting Guild in the south-western corner of Hosidius (members-only; 60 Woodcutting to enter, boostable) — its yews sit by the bank chest and it grants an invisible +7 level boost.

label: Buy a rune axe from Perry
detail: Buy a rune axe (Woodcutting 41 / Attack 40 to wield) from Perry's Chop-chop Shop inside the Guild — the page notes it's the only shop in the game that sells them.

label: Equip the rune axe
detail: Wield the rune axe before chopping.

label: Chop yew trees until Woodcutting 75
detail: Chop yews until Woodcutting 75 (175 xp/log; the page's level-99 benchmark for yew is 47,000 xp/hr with the Guild's +7 boost).

hints.note: Drop every log — the page's power-xp path stays drop, not bank, even though yew sells well.
Forestry events never spawn inside the Woodcutting Guild — this only applies at outside yew spots such as the Seers' Village church.

label: Alt: chop teak trees up to level 65
detail: Alternative up to level 65 only: teak without tick manipulation beats yew; past 65 the page points to sulliuscep instead.

label: Alt: chop sulliuscep from level 65
detail: Alternative from level 65: chop the single choppable sulliuscep cycling through Fossil Island's Tar Swamp (World 321) — low-effort compared to teak tick manipulation.

hints.note: Tar monsters and spine mushrooms attack in the swamp; the page suggests a Hitpoints cape + regen bracelet (plus antipoison for spine-mushroom poison) to avoid carrying food.
These byproducts feed later Prayer training via the mycelium pool, per the page.

label: Chop redwood trees until Woodcutting 99
detail: From level 88 (dragon axe special attack + Lightbearer + Preserve) or level 90 normally, chop redwoods in the Woodcutting Guild and drop every log — the page's cited rate at this tier.

hints.note: Dropping beats banking or fletching the logs into arrow shafts for raw xp/hr, per the page.
Preserve extends the dragon-axe special's temporary level boost; needed until level 89 per the page, after which the Lightbearer alone keeps up.

label: Alt: chop magic trees for profit
detail: Alternative for profit: magic logs, ideally at the Woodcutting Guild spot for its level bonus and bank proximity.

label: Alt: 1.5-tick teak woodcutting for the fastest raw xp
detail: Alternative for raw speed: 1.5-tick teak woodcutting on Fossil Island with the best felling axe and Forester's rations — the page's fastest Woodcutting xp in the game, though click-intensive.

hints.note: Set up a 3-tick cycle (e.g. swamp tar on a clean herb) and alternate tiles next to the hardwood patch for the 1.5-tick chance at two logs.
Teak Forestry events spawn south of Civitas illa Fortis and on Isle of Souls/Prifddinas for a social/AFK variant instead of tick manipulation.
